`[ℱ]_r · [𝒢]_s = ∑ₚ (-1)ᵖ [Torₚ^{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒢)]_{r + s - dX}`.

The intersection product of cycles is the one of Tag 0B08, the bilinear extension of the
Section 43.14 product of two closed subvarieties, and the right-hand side is the alternating sum
of Tag 0AZR.
declarations.statement:
theorem torFormula (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsVariety k f] (hX : IsRegular X)
    (F G : X.Modules) (hFc : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F)
    (hGc : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent G) (r s n dX : ℕ)
    (hdX : topologicalKrullDim X = (dX : WithBot ℕ∞)) (hrs : r + s = dX + n)
    (hFr : topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp F : Set X) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hGs : topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp G : Set X) ≤ (s : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hFG : topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp F ∩ SheafOfModules.supp G : Set X) ≤
      (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isRegular hX
    letI := hFc
    letI := hGc
    letI := isFiniteType_of_isCoherent F
    letI := isFiniteType_of_isCoherent G
    have hFr' := schemeDeltaDimension_reducedSupport_le_of_topologicalKrullDim_le k f F r hFr
    have hGs' := schemeDeltaDimension_reducedSupport_le_of_topologicalKrullDim_le k f G s hGs
    have hn : ∀ w ∈ SheafOfModules.supp F ∩ SheafOfModules.supp G,
        relativeDimension (fieldChowSituation k).dimensionFunction f w ≤ (n : ℤ) := fun _w hw =>
      relativeDimension_le_of_topologicalKrullDim_le (fieldChowSituation k) (fun _ _ => rfl) f
        ((SheafOfModules.isClosed_supp F).inter (SheafOfModules.isClosed_supp G)) hFG hw
    AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly
        (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation k) f F (r : ℤ) hFr')
        (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation k) f G (s : ℤ) hGs') ∧
      torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation k) f hX (n : ℤ)
          (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation k) f F (r : ℤ) hFr')
          (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation k) f G (s : ℤ) hGs')
        = intersectionProductCycle (fieldChowSituation k) f hX F G hFc hGc (n : ℤ)
            (torSheafDeltaDimension_le_of_forall_mem_inter (fieldChowSituation k) f hX F G hFc
              hGc (n : ℤ) hn)
declarations.comment: the whole lemma in the case `r + s ≥ dim X`, the expected dimension being a natural number `n`; every case, `r + s < dim X` included, is `Stacks.Intersection.ReductionToDiagonal.torFormula_integerDimension`. Here: the properness of `[ℱ]_r` and `[𝒢]_s` and the Tor formula `[ℱ]_r · [𝒢]_s = ∑ₚ (-1)ᵖ [Torₚ^{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒢)]_{r + s - dim X}`, for a nonsingular variety over an algebraically closed field — the chapter's own convention, Tag 0AZ8 — under the source's own three dimension bounds, read as bounds on the topological dimension of the two supports and of their intersection. `WithBot ℕ∞` has no subtraction, so `n = r + s - dim X` is the relation `r + s = dim X + n`. The left-hand side is the intersection product of Tag 0B08 for the Section 43.14 product of two closed subvarieties, and the right-hand side the alternating sum of Tag 0AZR.

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.length_tor_ne_top
declarations.doc:
**Finiteness of the individual terms of `χ(M, N)`.** Let `A` be a regular local ring and let
`M`, `N` be nonzero finite `A`-modules with `M ⊗_A N` supported in the maximal ideal. Then
`length_A Torᵢ^A(M, N)` is finite for every `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem length_tor_ne_top {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (M N : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M] [Nontrivial M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module.Finite A N] [Nontrivial N]
    (hMN : Module.support A (M ⊗[A] N) ⊆ {IsLocalRing.closedPoint A}) (i : ℕ) :
    Module.length A (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)).obj
      (ModuleCat.of A N)) ≠ ⊤
declarations.comment: finiteness of each term `length_A Tor_i^A(M, N)` of the sum `χ(M, N)`

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.torEulerCharacteristic_eq_sum_range
declarations.doc:
**Finiteness of the number of nonzero terms of `χ(M, N)`.** Over a regular local ring of
dimension at most `d`, the alternating sum defining `χ(M, N)` is the finite sum over `i = 0, …, d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem torEulerCharacteristic_eq_sum_range {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A]
    (M N : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ringKrullDim A ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    torEulerCharacteristic A M N =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), (-1 : ℚ) ^ i *
        ((Module.length A (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A N))).toNat : ℚ)
declarations.comment: the sum `χ(M, N)` has finitely many nonzero terms: `Tor_i = 0` for `i > dim A`

declarations.name: Stacks.SerreIntersection.torEulerCharacteristic_eq_zero_of_field
declarations.doc:
**Serre's vanishing for a regular local ring containing a field.** Let `A` be a regular local
ring containing a field and let `M`, `N` be nonzero finite `A`-modules with `M ⊗_A N` supported in
the closed point. If `dim Supp M + dim Supp N < dim A`, then `χ(M, N) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem torEulerCharacteristic_eq_zero_of_field (F : Type v) [Field F] [Algebra F A]
    (M N : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M] [Nontrivial M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module.Finite A N] [Nontrivial N]
    (hMN : Module.support A (M ⊗[A] N) ⊆ {closedPoint A})
    (hlt : Module.supportDim A M + Module.supportDim A N < ringKrullDim A) :
    Stacks.Intersection.torEulerCharacteristic A M N = 0
declarations.comment: (1) when A contains a field: r + s < dim A gives χ(M, N) = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.SerreIntersection.torEulerCharacteristic_pos_of_field
declarations.doc:
**Serre's positivity for a regular local ring containing a field.** Let `A` be a regular
local ring containing a field and let `M`, `N` be nonzero finite `A`-modules with `M ⊗_A N`
supported in the closed point. If `dim Supp M + dim Supp N = dim A`, then `χ(M, N) > 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem torEulerCharacteristic_pos_of_field (F : Type v) [Field F] [Algebra F A]
    (M N : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M] [Nontrivial M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module.Finite A N] [Nontrivial N]
    (hMN : Module.support A (M ⊗[A] N) ⊆ {closedPoint A})
    (heq : Module.supportDim A M + Module.supportDim A N = ringKrullDim A) :
    0 < Stacks.Intersection.torEulerCharacteristic A M N
declarations.comment: (2) when A contains a field: r + s = dim A gives χ(M, N) > 0

declarations.name: Stacks.SerreIntersection.supportDim_add_supportDim_le
declarations.doc:
**Serre's dimension inequality** [Serre, *Algèbre locale*, V.B.6]. Let `A` be a regular local
ring and let `M`, `N` be nonzero finite `A`-modules with `M ⊗_A N` supported in the closed point.
Then `dim Supp M + dim Supp N ≤ dim A`.

The statement passes to the completion; a complete regular local ring either contains a field
(`supportDim_add_supportDim_le_of_field`) or has a Cohen coefficient ring
(`supportDim_add_supportDim_le_of_isCohenRing`), by the Cohen structure theorem (Stacks 032A).
declarations.statement:
theorem supportDim_add_supportDim_le {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A]
    (M N : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M] [Nontrivial M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module.Finite A N] [Nontrivial N]
    (hMN : Module.support A (M ⊗[A] N) ⊆ {closedPoint A}) :
    Module.supportDim A M + Module.supportDim A N ≤ ringKrullDim A
declarations.comment: Serre's inequality r + s ≤ dim A

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.CycleFlatPullback.flatPullback_coherentSheafCycleProduct_integerDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B0Y**, with the expected dimension an integer. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a
flat morphism of nonsingular varieties over an algebraically closed field `K` — the chapter's
convention, Tag 0AZ8 — and set `e = dim X - dim Y`. Let `ℱ` and `𝒢` be coherent sheaves on `Y`
with `dim Supp ℱ ≤ r`, `dim Supp 𝒢 ≤ s` and `dim(Supp ℱ ∩ Supp 𝒢) ≤ r + s - dim Y`. Then the
cycles `[f^*ℱ]_{r+e}` and `[f^*𝒢]_{s+e}` intersect properly and

`f^*([ℱ]_r · [𝒢]_s) = [f^*ℱ]_{r+e} · [f^*𝒢]_{s+e}`.

The products are taken in the integer dimensions `r + s - dim Y` downstairs and
`r + s - dim Y + e` upstairs, every value included, the negative ones too. `WithBot ℕ∞` has no
subtraction, so the third bound is written `dim(Supp ℱ ∩ Supp 𝒢) + dim Y ≤ r + s`; when
`r + s < dim Y` it says that the supports are disjoint, and both sides are then `0`
(`flatPullback_coherentSheafCycleProduct_eq_zero_of_add_lt`).
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullback_coherentSheafCycleProduct_integerDimension (K : Type u) [Field K]
    [IsAlgClosed K] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    [IsVariety K sX] [IsVariety K sY] (hX : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular X)
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX)
    (F G : Y.Modules) (hFc : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F)
    (hGc : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent G) (r s dY e : ℕ)
    (hdY : topologicalKrullDim Y = (dY : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (he : topologicalKrullDim X = topologicalKrullDim Y + (e : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hFr : topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp F : Set Y) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hGs : topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp G : Set Y) ≤ (s : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hFG : topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp F ∩ SheafOfModules.supp G : Set Y) +
      (dY : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞) + (s : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType f := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isVariety_comp K sX sY f hbase
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isRegular hY
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isRegular hX
    letI := hFc
    letI := hGc
    letI := isFiniteType_of_isCoherent F
    letI := isFiniteType_of_isCoherent G
    letI := AlgebraicGeometry.isCoherent_pullback f F
    letI := AlgebraicGeometry.isCoherent_pullback f G
    have hFrY := schemeDeltaDimension_reducedSupport_le_of_topologicalKrullDim_le K sY F r hFr
    have hGsY := schemeDeltaDimension_reducedSupport_le_of_topologicalKrullDim_le K sY G s hGs
    have hFrX := schemeDeltaDimension_reducedSupport_le_of_topologicalKrullDim_le K sX
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) (r + e)
      (topologicalKrullDim_supp_pullback_le K sX sY f hbase e he F r hFr)
    have hGsX := schemeDeltaDimension_reducedSupport_le_of_topologicalKrullDim_le K sX
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G) (s + e)
      (topologicalKrullDim_supp_pullback_le K sX sY f hbase e he G s hGs)
    AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly
        (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation K) sX ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F)
          ((r + e : ℕ) : ℤ) hFrX)
        (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation K) sX ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G)
          ((s + e : ℕ) : ℤ) hGsX) ∧
      (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
          (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) ((r : ℤ) + s - dY)
          ⟨torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K) sY hY ((r : ℤ) + s - dY)
              (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation K) sY F (r : ℤ) hFrY)
              (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation K) sY G (s : ℤ) hGsY),
            torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_mem_cyclesOfDimension (fieldChowSituation K) sY hY
              ((r : ℤ) + s - dY) _ _⟩).1 =
        torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K) sX hX ((r : ℤ) + s - dY + e)
          (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation K) sX ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F)
            ((r + e : ℕ) : ℤ) hFrX)
          (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation K) sX ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G)
            ((s + e : ℕ) : ℤ) hGsX)
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, in every case of the integer expected dimension `r + s - dim Y`, the case `r + s < dim Y` included: both that `[f^*ℱ]_{r+e}` and `[f^*𝒢]_{s+e}` intersect properly and the identity `f^*([ℱ]_r · [𝒢]_s) = [f^*ℱ]_{r+e} · [f^*𝒢]_{s+e}`, for a flat morphism of nonsingular varieties over an algebraically closed field — the chapter's own convention, Tag 0AZ8 — under the source's own three dimension bounds on `Supp ℱ`, `Supp 𝒢` and their intersection. `WithBot ℕ∞` has no subtraction, so `dim(Supp ℱ ∩ Supp 𝒢) ≤ r + s - dim Y` is spelled `dim(Supp ℱ ∩ Supp 𝒢) + dim Y ≤ r + s`, as proper intersection is in Tag 0AZQ, and the products are taken in the integer dimensions `(r : ℤ) + s - dim Y` and `(r : ℤ) + s - dim Y + e`. Both products are the Section 43.17 product of cycles `AlgebraicGeometry.TorFormula.torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct` (Tag 0B08). The proof is the source's: Tag 0B0W downstairs and upstairs, Tag 0AZF on each Tor summand, and the comparison `f^*Torᵢ(ℱ, 𝒢) ≅ Torᵢ(f^*ℱ, f^*𝒢)` from Tag 079U and the exactness of `f^*`, which is `AlgebraicGeometry.TorFormula.pullbackTorSheafIso`, proved in this library, so the statement carries no hypothesis beyond the source's.

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.CycleFlatPullback.intersectProperly_flatPullback
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a flat morphism of varieties over a field `K` with `dim X = dim Y + e`,
let `α` be an `r`-cycle and `β` an `s`-cycle on `Y`, and assume `α` and `β` intersect properly.
Then the flat pullbacks `f^*α` and `f^*β` intersect properly.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectProperly_flatPullback (K : Type u) [Field K] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [IsVariety K sX] [IsVariety K sY]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX) (e : ℕ)
    (he : topologicalKrullDim X = topologicalKrullDim Y + (e : WithBot ℕ∞)) (r s : ℕ)
    (α : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) sY (r : ℤ))
    (β : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) sY (s : ℤ))
    (hαβ : AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly α.1 β.1) :
    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType f := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isVariety_comp K sX sY f hbase
    AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly
      (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
        (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (r : ℤ) α).1
      (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
        (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (s : ℤ) β).1
declarations.comment: the first conclusion only, that `f^*α` and `f^*β` intersect properly, proved unconditionally and without assuming nonsingularity; the second conclusion `f^*(α · β) = f^*α · f^*β` is neither proved nor stated, needing the Tor formula of Stacks 0B0W — see the implementation notes

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.CycleFlatPullback.flatPullback_torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_eq_integerDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B0Z**, with the expected dimension an integer. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a
flat morphism of nonsingular varieties over an algebraically closed field `K` — the chapter's
convention, Tag 0AZ8 — with `dim X = dim Y + e`. Let `α` be an `r`-cycle and `β` an `s`-cycle on
`Y` which intersect properly. Then `f^*α` and `f^*β` intersect properly and

`f^*(α · β) = f^*α · f^*β`.

The products are taken in the integer dimensions `r + s - dim Y` downstairs and
`r + s - dim Y + e` upstairs, every value included. When `r + s < dim Y`, proper intersection
forces every component of `α` to be disjoint from every component of `β`, and both sides are
then `0` (`flatPullback_torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_eq_zero_of_add_lt`).
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullback_torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_eq_integerDimension
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [IsVariety K sX] [IsVariety K sY] (hX : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular X)
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX)
    (e dY r s : ℕ)
    (hdY : topologicalKrullDim Y = (dY : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (he : topologicalKrullDim X = topologicalKrullDim Y + (e : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (α : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) sY (r : ℤ))
    (β : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) sY (s : ℤ))
    (hαβ : AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly α.1 β.1) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType f := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isVariety_comp K sX sY f hbase
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sY
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly
        (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
          (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (r : ℤ) α).1
        (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
          (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (s : ℤ) β).1 ∧
      (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
          (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) ((r : ℤ) + s - dY)
          ⟨torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K) sY hY ((r : ℤ) + s - dY)
              α.1 β.1,
            torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_mem_cyclesOfDimension (fieldChowSituation K) sY hY
              ((r : ℤ) + s - dY) α.1 β.1⟩).1 =
        torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K) sX hX ((r : ℤ) + s - dY + e)
          (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
            (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (r : ℤ) α).1
          (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
            (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (s : ℤ) β).1
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, in every case of the integer expected dimension `r + s - dim Y`, the case `r + s < dim Y` included: both that `f^*α` and `f^*β` intersect properly and the identity `f^*(α · β) = f^*α · f^*β`, for an `r`-cycle `α` and an `s`-cycle `β` intersecting properly on `Y` and a flat morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of nonsingular varieties over an algebraically closed field — the chapter's own convention, Tag 0AZ8 — with `dim X = dim Y + e`. The products are the Section 43.17 product of cycles of Tag 0B08, taken in the integer dimensions `(r : ℤ) + s - dim Y` downstairs and `(r : ℤ) + s - dim Y + e` upstairs.

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.CycleFlatPullback.flatPullback_torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B0Z.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a flat morphism of nonsingular varieties
over an algebraically closed field `K` — the chapter's convention, Tag 0AZ8 — with
`dim X = dim Y + e`. Let `α` be an `r`-cycle and `β` an `s`-cycle on `Y` which intersect
properly. Then `f^*α` and `f^*β` intersect properly and

`f^*(α · β) = f^*α · f^*β`.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullback_torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_eq (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    [IsVariety K sX] [IsVariety K sY] (hX : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular X)
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX)
    (e dY r s n : ℕ) (hdY : topologicalKrullDim Y = (dY : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (he : topologicalKrullDim X = topologicalKrullDim Y + (e : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hrs : r + s = dY + n)
    (α : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) sY (r : ℤ))
    (β : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) sY (s : ℤ))
    (hαβ : AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly α.1 β.1) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType f := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isVariety_comp K sX sY f hbase
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sY
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly
        (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
          (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (r : ℤ) α).1
        (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
          (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (s : ℤ) β).1 ∧
      (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
          (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (n : ℤ)
          ⟨torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K) sY hY (n : ℤ) α.1 β.1,
            torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_mem_cyclesOfDimension (fieldChowSituation K) sY hY
              (n : ℤ) α.1 β.1⟩).1 =
        torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K) sX hX ((n : ℤ) + (e : ℤ))
          (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
            (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (r : ℤ) α).1
          (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
            (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (s : ℤ) β).1
declarations.comment: the whole lemma in the case `r + s ≥ dim Y`, the product being graded by a natural number `n`; every case, `r + s < dim Y` included, is `flatPullback_torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_eq_integerDimension`. Here: both that `f^*α` and `f^*β` intersect properly and the identity `f^*(α · β) = f^*α · f^*β`, for a flat morphism of nonsingular varieties over an algebraically closed field — the chapter's own convention, Tag 0AZ8 — with `dim X = dim Y + e`. The products are the Section 43.17 product of cycles of Tag 0B08, graded so that an `r`-cycle and an `s`-cycle multiply into dimension `n` with `r + s = dim Y + n`, `WithBot ℕ∞` having no subtraction. The source's `[V] = [𝒪_V]_r` is `AlgebraicGeometry.TorFormula.coherentSheafCycle_structureSheafAt` and its `f^*[V] = [f^*𝒪_V]_{r+e}` is Tag 0AZF, so the pulled-back components are cycles of coherent sheaves; bilinearity of the product then reduces the identity to one pair of components, where it is Tag 0B0W upstairs.

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.ProjectionFormula.intersectProperly_coherentSheafCycle_pushforward_unconditional
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a flat proper morphism of varieties over a field with `dim X = dim Y + e`,
let `ℱ` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module whose support has dimension at most `r` and `𝒢` a coherent
`𝒪_Y`-module whose support has dimension at most `s`, and assume that `Supp(ℱ)` and
`f^{-1}(Supp(𝒢))` meet in dimension at most `r + (s + e) - dim X`. Then the cycles
`f_*[ℱ]_r = [f_*ℱ]_r` and `[𝒢]_s` intersect properly.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectProperly_coherentSheafCycle_pushforward_unconditional (K : Type u) [Field K]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [IsVariety K sX]
    [IsVariety K sY] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] [IsProper f] (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX) (e : ℕ)
    (he : topologicalKrullDim X = topologicalKrullDim Y + (e : WithBot ℕ∞)) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsCoherent] (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsCoherent] (r s : ℕ)
    (hFr : schemeDeltaDimension (fieldChowSituation K)
      ((reducedSupport F).subschemeι ≫ sX) ≤ ((r : ℤ) : EInt))
    (hGs : schemeDeltaDimension (fieldChowSituation K)
      ((reducedSupport G).subschemeι ≫ sY) ≤ ((s : ℤ) : EInt))
    (hFG : topologicalKrullDim
        (SheafOfModules.supp F ∩ f.base ⁻¹' SheafOfModules.supp G : Set X) +
      topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞) + ((s + e : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sY
    haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.ProperCoherenceWitness.isCoherent_pushforward f F
    AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly
      (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation K) sY ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)
        (r : ℤ)
        (schemeDeltaDimension_reducedSupport_pushforward_le (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase
          F hFr))
      (coherentSheafCycle (fieldChowSituation K) sY G (s : ℤ) hGs)
declarations.comment: the properness clause for `α = [ℱ]_r` and `β = [𝒢]_s`

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.ProjectionFormula.properPushforward_intersectionProductCycleGroup_unconditional
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a flat proper morphism of nonsingular varieties over a field. For a
coherent `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ` and a coherent `𝒪_Y`-module `𝒢`, proper pushforward carries the
intersection product of `ℱ` and `f^*𝒢` to the intersection product of `f_*ℱ` and `𝒢`:

`f_*(∑ᵢ (-1)ⁱ [Torᵢ^{𝒪_X}(ℱ, f^*𝒢)]_n) = ∑ᵢ (-1)ⁱ [Torᵢ^{𝒪_Y}(f_*ℱ, 𝒢)]_n`.

Taking `n = r + s - dim Y`, for supports of dimension at most `r` and `s` and `e = dim X - dim Y`,
this is `f_*([ℱ]_r · [f^*𝒢]_{s+e}) = [f_*ℱ]_r · [𝒢]_s`, that is `f_*(α · f^*β) = f_*(α) · β`.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforward_intersectionProductCycleGroup_unconditional (K : Type u) [Field K]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [IsVariety K sX]
    [IsVariety K sY] (hX : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular X) (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] [IsProper f] (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX) (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F) (G : Y.Modules)
    (hG : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent G) (n : ℤ)
    (hFn : ∀ i : ℕ,
      haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType f := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isVariety_comp K sX sY f hbase
      haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
      haveI := isCoherent_torSheaf_of_isRegular X hX F ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G) hF
        (isCoherent_pullback f G) i
      schemeDeltaDimension (fieldChowSituation K)
        ((reducedSupport (torSheaf X F ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G) i)).subschemeι ≫ sX)
          ≤ (n : EInt)) :
    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType f := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isVariety_comp K sX sY f hbase
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sY
    properPushforward (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase n
        (intersectionProductCycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) sX hX F
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G) hF (isCoherent_pullback f G) n hFn) =
      intersectionProductCycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) sY hY
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F) G
        (@AlgebraicGeometry.ProperCoherenceWitness.isCoherent_pushforward _ _ f _ _ F hF) hG n
        (schemeDeltaDimension_reducedSupport_torSheaf_pushforward_le_of_bound K sX sY hX hY f
          hbase F hF G hG n hFn)
declarations.comment: the identity `f_*(α) · β = f_*(α · f^*β)` for `α = [ℱ]_r` and `β = [𝒢]_s`, both products read by the Tor formula `∑ᵢ (-1)ⁱ [Torᵢ]_n` of Stacks 0AZR

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.ProjectionFormula.properPushforward_torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B10.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a flat proper morphism of nonsingular
varieties over an algebraically closed field `K` — the chapter's convention, Tag 0AZ8 — with
`dim X = dim Y + e`. Let `α` be an `r`-cycle on `X` and `β` an `s`-cycle on `Y`, and assume that
`α` and `f^*β` intersect properly. Then `f_*α` and `β` intersect properly and

`f_*(α) · β = f_*(α · f^*β)`.

The products are the intersection product of cycles of Tag 0B08 in dimension
`n = r + s - dim Y`, an integer: on `X` the same `n` is `r + (s + e) - dim X`. When `n < 0` the
supports of `f_*α` and `β` are disjoint and both products vanish, as there are no cycles of
negative dimension.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforward_torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_eq (K : Type u) [Field K]
    [IsAlgClosed K] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    [IsVariety K sX] [IsVariety K sY] (hX : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular X)
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] [IsProper f]
    (hbase : f ≫ sY = sX) (e dY r s : ℕ) (n : ℤ)
    (hdY : topologicalKrullDim Y = (dY : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (he : topologicalKrullDim X = topologicalKrullDim Y + (e : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hrs : (r : ℤ) + (s : ℤ) = (dY : ℤ) + n)
    (α : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) sX (r : ℤ))
    (β : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) sY (s : ℤ))
    (hαβ : haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType f := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isVariety_comp K sX sY f hbase
      AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly α.1
        (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
          (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (s : ℤ) β).1) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType f := locallyOfFiniteType_of_isVariety_comp K sX sY f hbase
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sY
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly
        (properPushforward (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase (r : ℤ) α).1 β.1 ∧
      (properPushforward (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase n
          ⟨torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K) sX hX n α.1
              (flatPullback (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase e
                (relativeDimension_of_flat_of_isVariety K sX sY f hbase e he) (s : ℤ) β).1,
            torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_mem_cyclesOfDimension (fieldChowSituation K) sX hX
              n _ _⟩).1 =
        torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K) sY hY n
          (properPushforward (fieldChowSituation K) sX sY f hbase (r : ℤ) α).1 β.1
declarations.comment: the whole lemma: both that `f_*α` and `β` intersect properly and the identity `f_*(α) · β = f_*(α · f^*β)`, for arbitrary cycles `α ∈ Z_r(X)` and `β ∈ Z_s(Y)` and every `r`, `s`, under the source's assumption that `α` and `f^*β` intersect properly, for a flat proper morphism of nonsingular varieties over an algebraically closed field — the chapter's own convention, Tag 0AZ8 — with `dim X = dim Y + e`. The products are the Section 43.17 product of cycles of Tag 0B08 in dimension `n = r + s - dim Y`, an integer.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CosimplicialObject.uliftCoyoneda_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0B13** (with `C[n]` as `uliftCoyoneda.obj (op n)`).
For every object `n` of `Δ` the cosimplicial set `C[n] = uliftCoyoneda.obj (op n)` is
`k ↦ Mor_Δ(n, k)`, with `φ : k ⟶ l` acting by `α ↦ α ≫ φ`; the family `n ↦ C[n]` is a simplicial
object in cosimplicial sets, with `ψ : n ⟶ m` acting by `α ↦ ψ ≫ α`; and `C[n]` corepresents
evaluation in degree `n`, in that `γ ↦ γ_n(id_n)` is a bijection `Mor(C[n], U) → Uₙ` for every
cosimplicial set `U`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem uliftCoyoneda_spec :
    (∀ n k : SimplexCategory, (uliftCoyoneda.{u}.obj (op n)).obj k = ULift.{u} (n ⟶ k)) ∧
    (∀ (n k l : SimplexCategory) (φ : k ⟶ l) (α : ULift.{u} (n ⟶ k)),
      ((uliftCoyoneda.{u}.obj (op n)).map φ α).down = α.down ≫ φ) ∧
    (∀ (n m k : SimplexCategory) (ψ : n ⟶ m) (α : ULift.{u} (m ⟶ k)),
      ((uliftCoyoneda.{u}.map ψ.op).app k α).down = ψ ≫ α.down) ∧
    (∀ (n : SimplexCategory) (U : CosimplicialObject (Type u)),
      Function.Bijective fun γ : uliftCoyoneda.{u}.obj (op n) ⟶ U =>
        γ.app n (ULift.up (𝟙 n)))
declarations.comment: C[n] is Mathlib's uliftCoyoneda.obj (op n), dual to Δ[n] = SSet.stdSimplex.obj n of Tag 0176; the statement records its terms and structure maps, the simplicial structure of the family in n, and the corepresentability that characterises it

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialObject.power
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0B15.** `Hom(U, V)`, the simplicial object of maps from a cosimplicial set `U` into a
simplicial object `V` of `C`. Its degree `n` part is the power `Hom(U, V)_n = ∏_{u ∈ U_n} V_n`, the
object of `C` whose `X`-valued points are the maps `U_n → Mor_C(X, V_n)`, and for `φ : [m] ⟶ [n]`
in `Δ` the structure map `Hom(U, V)_n ⟶ Hom(U, V)_m` is the morphism whose `u`-th component, for
`u ∈ U_m`, is the projection to the `U(φ)(u)`-th factor followed by `V(φ)`; on `X`-valued points it
is `f ↦ V(φ) ∘ f ∘ U(φ)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def power (V : SimplicialObject C) (U : CosimplicialObject (Type w))
    [∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ, HasProduct fun _ : U.obj n.unop => V.obj n] :
    SimplicialObject C
declarations.comment: the finiteness and nonemptiness of the `U_n` are replaced by the existence of the products they index, which is all they are used for; dual to `CosimplicialObject.power` of Tag 019V

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.Hypercovering.power_cosk_unit_isProjection
declarations.doc:
The `(n + 1)`-st matching map of `Hom(C[k], T)` is, functorially in `T`,
a projection of finite powers of `T`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem power_cosk_unit_isProjection
    {D : Type u} [Category.{v} D] [HasFiniteLimits D]
    (k n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    letI : ∀ F : SimplicialObject.Truncated D n,
        (SimplexCategory.Truncated.inclusion n).op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension F :=
      fun F =>
        (hasPointwiseRightKanExtension_of_hasBinaryProducts_or_hasFiniteConnectedLimits
            (C := D)).2 (fun _ => inferInstance) n hn F;
    letI : ∀ m : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ,
        Fintype ((uliftCoyoneda.{w}.obj (op ⦋k⦌)).obj m.unop) :=
      fun m => by
        rw [CosimplicialObject.uliftCoyoneda_spec.1 ⦋k⦌ m.unop]
        exact Fintype.ofFinite _;
    ∃ S : Finset ((uliftCoyoneda.{w}.obj (op ⦋k⦌)).obj ⦋n + 1⦌),
      ∃ e : ∀ T : D,
          (((SimplicialObject.cosk n).obj
            (((SimplicialObject.const D).obj T).power
              (uliftCoyoneda.{w}.obj (op ⦋k⦌)))).obj (op ⦋n + 1⦌)) ≅
            ∏ᶜ fun _ : ↥S => T,
        (∀ T : D,
          (((SimplicialObject.coskAdj n).unit.app
            (((SimplicialObject.const D).obj T).power
              (uliftCoyoneda.{w}.obj (op ⦋k⦌)))).app
              (op ⦋n + 1⦌)) ≫ (e T).hom =
            eqToHom (SimplicialObject.power_obj
              ((SimplicialObject.const D).obj T)
              (uliftCoyoneda.{w}.obj (op ⦋k⦌)) (op ⦋n + 1⦌)) ≫
              Limits.Pi.map' (fun s : ↥S => (s : _)) (fun _ => 𝟙 T)) ∧
        (∀ (T T' : D) (f : T ⟶ T')
          (g : (((SimplicialObject.const D).obj T).power
              (uliftCoyoneda.{w}.obj (op ⦋k⦌))) ⟶
            (((SimplicialObject.const D).obj T').power
              (uliftCoyoneda.{w}.obj (op ⦋k⦌)))),
          (∀ m : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ,
            g.app m = Limits.Pi.map (fun _ => f)) →
          (((SimplicialObject.cosk n).map g).app (op ⦋n + 1⦌)) ≫ (e T').hom =
            (e T).hom ≫ Limits.Pi.map (fun _ : ↥S => f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionMultiplicity_eq_one_and_exists_isOpen_smoothAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0B1I.** Let `X` be a nonsingular variety over a perfect field `k`, let `V` and `W` be
the closed subschemes of `X` cut out by the quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals `IV` and `IW`, and
let `ζ` be the generic point of an irreducible component `Z` of the scheme-theoretic intersection
`V ∩ W`, with image `ξ` in `X`. Assume that `V` and `W` intersect properly along `Z`, in the local
form `dim 𝒪_{X, ξ} ≤ dim 𝒪_{V, ξ} + dim 𝒪_{W, ξ}`, and that the multiplicity of `Z` in `V ∩ W`
is one. Then the intersection multiplicity is `e(X, V · W, Z) = 1`, and there is an open
neighbourhood of `ξ` in `X` over which both `V` and `W` are smooth: `V` and `W` are smooth in a
general point of `Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectionMultiplicity_eq_one_and_exists_isOpen_smoothAt (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [PerfectField k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType p]
    (IV IW : X.IdealSheafData) (ζ : genericPoints (IV ⊔ IW).subscheme)
    (hX : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk ((IV ⊔ IW).subschemeι ζ.1)))
    (hproper : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk ((IV ⊔ IW).subschemeι ζ.1)) ≤
      ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk ((IV ⊔ IW).subschemeι ζ.1) ⧸
          IdealSheafData.stalk IV ((IV ⊔ IW).subschemeι ζ.1)) +
        ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk ((IV ⊔ IW).subschemeι ζ.1) ⧸
          IdealSheafData.stalk IW ((IV ⊔ IW).subschemeι ζ.1)))
    (hmult : Stacks.Chow.componentMultiplicity (IV ⊔ IW).subschemeι ζ = 1) :
    Stacks.Intersection.intersectionMultiplicity IV IW ((IV ⊔ IW).subschemeι ζ.1) = 1 ∧
      ∃ U : X.Opens, (IV ⊔ IW).subschemeι ζ.1 ∈ U ∧
        (∀ v : IV.subscheme, IV.subschemeι v ∈ U →
          InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt (IV.subschemeι ≫ p) v) ∧
        (∀ w : IW.subscheme, IW.subschemeι w ∈ U →
          InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt (IW.subschemeι ≫ p) w)
declarations.comment: both conclusions, at the generic point of the component

declarations.name: IsRegularLocalRing.localIntersectionMultiplicity_eq_one_of_length_quotient_sup_eq_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0B1I, the multiplicity-one case of the Tor formula.** Let `A` be a regular local ring
and let `I`, `J` be ideals with `Module.length A (A ⧸ (I ⊔ J)) = 1` and
`dim A ≤ dim (A ⧸ I) + dim (A ⧸ J)`. Then the intersection multiplicity of the pair computed by
the Tor formula is `1`. Geometrically, for `A` the local ring of a nonsingular variety `X` at the
generic point of an irreducible component `Z` of `V ∩ W`, with `I` and `J` the local ideals of two
closed subvarieties intersecting properly and `Z` of multiplicity one in `V ∩ W`, this says
`e(X, V · W, Z) = 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localIntersectionMultiplicity_eq_one_of_length_quotient_sup_eq_one {A : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (I J : Ideal A)
    (hmult : Module.length A (A ⧸ (I ⊔ J)) = 1)
    (hproper : ringKrullDim A ≤ ringKrullDim (A ⧸ I) + ringKrullDim (A ⧸ J)) :
    I.localIntersectionMultiplicity (A ⧸ J) = 1
declarations.comment: the Tor-formula multiplicity, in local form at the generic point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.TorFormula.torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_apply_eq_one
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a nonsingular variety over a field `k` of dimension `d`, let `r, s ≥ 0` and let `Y`,
`Z` be the closed subschemes cut out by `IY`, `IZ`, with `dim Y ≤ r` and `dim Z ≤ s`, whose cycles
`[Y]_r = ∑ nᵢ [Yᵢ]` and `[Z]_s = ∑ mⱼ [Zⱼ]` intersect properly. Let `Y_{i₀}` and `Z_{j₀}` be
components of the two cycles, with generic points `y₀` and `z₀`, and let `T` be the closure of a
point `t` of `Y_{i₀} ∩ Z_{j₀}` (for instance the generic point of an irreducible component of it)
along which the multiplicity of `Y ∩ Z`, `length_{𝒪_{X, t}} 𝒪_{X, t} ⧸ (𝓘_Y + 𝓘_Z)_t`, is `1`. Then

1. the coefficient of `T` in `[Y]_r · [Z]_s` is `1`,
2. `Y` and `Z` are nonsingular at `t`,
3. `n_{i₀} = 1` and `m_{j₀} = 1`, and
4. `T` is contained in no other component of `[Y]_r` and in no other component of `[Z]_s`.
declarations.statement:
theorem torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_apply_eq_one
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ (fieldChowSituation k).S)
    [IsVariety k sX] (hX : IsRegular X) {d : ℕ} (hd : topologicalKrullDim X = d) (r s : ℕ)
    (IY IZ : X.IdealSheafData) (hY : topologicalKrullDim IY.subscheme ≤ r)
    (hZ : topologicalKrullDim IZ.subscheme ≤ s)
    (hprop : AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly
      (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) sX
        IY.subschemeι r).1
      (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) sX
        IZ.subschemeι s).1)
    {y₀ z₀ t : X}
    (hy₀ : (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) sX
      IY.subschemeι r).1 y₀ ≠ 0)
    (hz₀ : (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) sX
      IZ.subschemeι s).1 z₀ ≠ 0)
    (ht : t ∈ closure ({y₀} : Set X) ∩ closure ({z₀} : Set X))
    (hmult : Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk t)
      (X.presheaf.stalk t ⧸ IdealSheafData.stalk (IY ⊔ IZ) t) = 1) :
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sX
    torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation k) sX hX ((r + s : ℤ) - d)
        (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) sX
          IY.subschemeι r).1
        (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) sX
          IZ.subschemeι s).1 t = 1 ∧
      (∀ ζ : IY.subscheme, IY.subschemeι ζ = t →
        IsRegularLocalRing (IY.subscheme.presheaf.stalk ζ)) ∧
      (∀ ζ : IZ.subscheme, IZ.subschemeι ζ = t →
        IsRegularLocalRing (IZ.subscheme.presheaf.stalk ζ)) ∧
      (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) sX
        IY.subschemeι r).1 y₀ = 1 ∧
      (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) sX
        IZ.subschemeι s).1 z₀ = 1 ∧
      (∀ y, (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) sX
        IY.subschemeι r).1 y ≠ 0 → t ∈ closure ({y} : Set X) → y = y₀) ∧
      (∀ z, (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) sX
        IZ.subschemeι s).1 z ≠ 0 → t ∈ closure ({z} : Set X) → z = z₀)

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.ReductionToDiagonal.torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_assoc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B1L.** Let `X` be a nonsingular variety over an algebraically closed
field — the convention of the chapter, Tag 0AZ8 — of dimension `dX`, and let `U`, `V`, `W` be
closed subvarieties, namely the reduced closures of three points `u`, `v`, `w`, of dimensions
`r`, `s`, `t`. Assume `U`, `V`, `W` intersect properly pairwise and that

`dim (U ∩ V ∩ W) ≤ dim U + dim V + dim W - 2 dim X`.

Then `U` and `V · W` intersect properly, `U · V` and `W` intersect properly — so that the two
iterated products are defined, as the source's statement presupposes — and, as cycles on `X`,

`U · (V · W) = (U · V) · W`.

Here `V · W` and `U · V` are the products of Section 43.14 (Tag 0AZR) in dimensions
`s + t - dX` and `r + s - dX`, and the outer products are their bilinear extension of Tag 0B08 in
dimension `r + s + t - 2 dX`; the three expected dimensions are integers, so that the
configurations in which one of them is negative are included.
declarations.statement:
theorem torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_assoc [DecidableEq X] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [IsAlgClosed k] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsVariety k f] (hX : IsRegular X)
    (u v w : X) (dX r s t : ℕ)
    (hdX : topologicalKrullDim X = (dX : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hu : topologicalKrullDim (closure ({u} : Set X)) = (r : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hv : topologicalKrullDim (closure ({v} : Set X)) = (s : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hw : topologicalKrullDim (closure ({w} : Set X)) = (t : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (huv : AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectProperly
      ⟨closure {u}, isIrreducible_singleton.closure, isClosed_closure⟩
      ⟨closure {v}, isIrreducible_singleton.closure, isClosed_closure⟩)
    (hvw : AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectProperly
      ⟨closure {v}, isIrreducible_singleton.closure, isClosed_closure⟩
      ⟨closure {w}, isIrreducible_singleton.closure, isClosed_closure⟩)
    (_huw : AlgebraicGeometry.IntersectProperly
      ⟨closure {u}, isIrreducible_singleton.closure, isClosed_closure⟩
      ⟨closure {w}, isIrreducible_singleton.closure, isClosed_closure⟩)
    (huvw : topologicalKrullDim
        (↥(closure ({u} : Set X) ∩ closure ({v} : Set X) ∩ closure ({w} : Set X))) +
          ((2 * dX : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ((r + s + t : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isRegular hX
    AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single u (1 : ℤ))
        (torSubvarietyProductOfBound (fieldChowSituation k) f hX ((s : ℤ) + t - dX)
          (torSupportBound_of_intersectProperly_of_eq k f hX v w hdX hv hw hvw)) ∧
      AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly
        (torSubvarietyProductOfBound (fieldChowSituation k) f hX ((r : ℤ) + s - dX)
          (torSupportBound_of_intersectProperly_of_eq k f hX u v hdX hu hv huv))
        (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single w (1 : ℤ)) ∧
      torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation k) f hX ((r : ℤ) + s + t - 2 * dX)
          (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single u 1)
          (torSubvarietyProductOfBound (fieldChowSituation k) f hX ((s : ℤ) + t - dX)
            (torSupportBound_of_intersectProperly_of_eq k f hX v w hdX hv hw hvw)) =
        torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation k) f hX ((r : ℤ) + s + t - 2 * dX)
          (torSubvarietyProductOfBound (fieldChowSituation k) f hX ((r : ℤ) + s - dX)
            (torSupportBound_of_intersectProperly_of_eq k f hX u v hdX hu hv huv))
          (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single w 1)
declarations.comment: the whole lemma: `U · (V · W) = (U · V) · W` as cycles on `X`, for three closed subvarieties of a nonsingular variety over an algebraically closed field — the chapter's own convention, Tag 0AZ8 — intersecting properly pairwise and satisfying the displayed dimension bound, together with the properness of the two outer intersections that the statement presupposes. Closed subvarieties are their generic points, so `U`, `V`, `W` are the reduced closures of three points and `[U]` is the prime cycle at `u`. The inner products `V · W` and `U · V` are the Section 43.14 product of Tag 0AZR in the integer expected dimensions `dim V + dim W - dim X` and `dim U + dim V - dim X`, and the outer products the bilinear extension of Tag 0B08 in dimension `dim U + dim V + dim W - 2 dim X`. `WithBot ℕ∞` has no subtraction, so the displayed bound is spelled `dim (U ∩ V ∩ W) + 2 dim X ≤ dim U + dim V + dim W`, as proper intersection is in Tag 0AZQ.

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.finsum_alternating_length_tor_assoc_of_isRegularLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0B1L: associativity of intersections, at a point.** Let `A` be a regular local ring
of dimension at most `n` — the local ring of a nonsingular variety `X` at the generic point of a
component `Z` of `U ∩ V ∩ W` — and let `M`, `N`, `P` be finite `A`-modules whose supports meet
only in the maximal ideal, which is what it means for `Z` to be isolated in `U ∩ V ∩ W`. Then

`∑ᵢⱼ (-1)ⁱ⁺ʲ length Torᵢᴬ(M, Torⱼᴬ(N, P)) = ∑ᵢⱼ (-1)ⁱ⁺ʲ length Torᵢᴬ(Torⱼᴬ(M, N), P)`,

both sums being finite. For `M`, `N`, `P` the local rings of `U`, `V`, `W` the two sides are the
coefficients of `Z` in `U · (V · W)` and in `(U · V) · W`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finsum_alternating_length_tor_assoc_of_isRegularLocalRing (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsRegularLocalRing A] (M N P : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M] [Module.Finite A N]
    [Module.Finite A P] (n : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim A ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hsupp : Module.support A M ∩ Module.support A N ∩ Module.support A P ⊆
      {IsLocalRing.closedPoint A}) :
    (∑ᶠ pq : ℕ × ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (pq.1 + pq.2) * ((Module.length A
        (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) pq.1).obj M).obj
          (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) pq.2).obj N).obj P))).toNat : ℤ))
      = ∑ᶠ pq : ℕ × ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (pq.1 + pq.2) * ((Module.length A
        (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) pq.1).obj
          (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) pq.2).obj M).obj N)).obj P)).toNat : ℤ)
declarations.comment: the associativity `U · (V · W) = (U · V) · W` in local form at the local ring `A` of the ambient nonsingular variety at the generic point of a component of the triple intersection. By the Tor formula of Stacks 0B0W the coefficient of such a component in `U · (V · W)` is the alternating double sum `∑ᵢⱼ (-1)^(i+j) length_A Torᵢ^A(𝒪_U, Torⱼ^A(𝒪_V, 𝒪_W))` and its coefficient in `(U · V) · W` is the right-associated sum; what is proved here is that those two sums agree, for arbitrary finite `A`-modules in place of the three local rings whose supports meet only in the maximal ideal. That support condition is the local form of the source's hypotheses that `U`, `V`, `W` meet properly pairwise and that `dim (U ∩ V ∩ W) ≤ dim U + dim V + dim W - 2 dim X`, which the source uses for exactly this purpose: to bound the dimensions of the supports of the sheaves appearing in the two sums. Every length in the two sums is then finite, since a `Tor` module of finite modules over a Noetherian ring is finite by Stacks 0AZ4 and its support lies in the intersection of the two supports, so each iterated `Tor` module is a finite module supported in the maximal ideal. The identity of the two sums is the claim the source's proof establishes, by the double-complex spectral sequence of Homology Section 012X in the form of More on Algebra Example 0662 (in the library as `CochainComplex.DerivedTensorSpectralSequence.exists_derived_tensor_spectral_sequences`) together with the additivity of length on short exact sequences.

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.finsum_alternating_length_tor_assoc_quotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0B1L for three closed subvarieties, at a point.** The case of the three local rings
`A ⧸ I`, `A ⧸ J`, `A ⧸ K` of closed subvarieties `U`, `V`, `W` cut out at the point by the
ideals `I`, `J`, `K`: the two iterated alternating sums of lengths of `Tor` modules agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem finsum_alternating_length_tor_assoc_quotient (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsRegularLocalRing A] (I J K : Ideal A) (n : ℕ)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hfinL : ∀ p q : ℕ, Module.length A
      (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).obj
        (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) q).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ J))).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ K)))) ≠ ⊤)
    (hfinR : ∀ p q : ℕ, Module.length A
      (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p).obj
        (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) q).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ J)))).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ K))) ≠ ⊤) :
    (∑ᶠ pq : ℕ × ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (pq.1 + pq.2) * ((Module.length A
        (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) pq.1).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).obj
          (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) pq.2).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ J))).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ K))))).toNat : ℤ))
      = ∑ᶠ pq : ℕ × ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (pq.1 + pq.2) * ((Module.length A
        (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) pq.1).obj
          (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} A) pq.2).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ J)))).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ K)))).toNat : ℤ)
declarations.comment: the associativity `U · (V · W) = (U · V) · W` in local form, for the three local rings `A ⧸ I`, `A ⧸ J`, `A ⧸ K` of the subvarieties at the generic point of a component of the triple intersection; the two sides are the coefficients of that component in the two iterated products, by the Tor formula of Stacks 0B0W. See `Stacks.Intersection.finsum_alternating_length_tor_assoc_of_isRegularLocalRing` for what is and is not carried.

declarations.name: Stacks.Intersection.intersectionProduct_zeroFibre_eq_properPushforward_zeroSection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B1M.** Let `X ⟶ P` be a closed immersion of nonsingular varieties over
an algebraically closed field `K`, of dimensions `d` and `p`, and let `C' ⊆ P × 𝐏¹` be a closed
subvariety of dimension `r + 1` such that

1. the zero fibre `C = C'_0` (the scheme-theoretic fibre `zeroFiber sP C'`) has dimension `r`,
2. `C'` intersects `X × 𝐏¹` properly,
3. `[C]_r` intersects `X` properly.

Then `[C]_r · X`, an `(r + d - p)`-cycle on `P`, is the pushforward of a cycle `α` on `X`, and
`C' · X × 𝐏¹`, an `(r + d - p + 1)`-cycle on `P × 𝐏¹`, is the pushforward of a cycle `β` on
`X × 𝐏¹`; and for any such `α` and `β`, the cycle `β` intersects `X × 0` properly and

`α = pr_{X,*}(β · X × 0)`.

The intersection products are those of Tag 0B08, `X × 𝐏¹ ⟶ P × 𝐏¹` is the base change of `ι`,
`X × 0` is the image of the zero section, and `pr_X` is the first projection.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectionProduct_zeroFibre_eq_properPushforward_zeroSection
    [IsAlgClosed K] {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [IsVariety K sP]
    (ι : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [IsVariety K (ι ≫ sP)] (hX : IsRegular X)
    (hP : IsRegular P) (d p r : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim X = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hp : topologicalKrullDim P = (p : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (C' : (projectiveLineProduct sP).IdealSheafData) [IsIntegral C'.subscheme]
    (hC' : topologicalKrullDim (C'.support : Set (projectiveLineProduct sP)) =
      ((r + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (h1 : topologicalKrullDim ((zeroFiber sP C').support : Set P) = (r : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (h2 : topologicalKrullDim ↥((C'.support : Set (projectiveLineProduct sP)) ∩
          Set.range (familyBaseChange sP ι).base) +
        topologicalKrullDim (projectiveLineProduct sP) ≤
      topologicalKrullDim (C'.support : Set (projectiveLineProduct sP)) +
        topologicalKrullDim (Set.range (familyBaseChange sP ι).base))
    (h3 : AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly
      (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation K) sP
        (zeroFiber sP C').subschemeι (r : ℤ)).1
      (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (ι.base (genericPoint X)) (1 : ℤ))) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian P := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isRegular hP
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian (projectiveLineProduct sP) :=
      isLocallyNoetherian_of_isRegular (isRegular_projectiveLineProduct sP hP)
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian (projectiveLineProduct (ι ≫ sP)) :=
      isLocallyNoetherian_of_isRegular (isRegular_projectiveLineProduct (ι ≫ sP) hX)
    (∃ α : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) (ι ≫ sP) ((r : ℤ) + d - p),
        (properPushforward (fieldChowSituation K) (ι ≫ sP) sP ι rfl _ α).1 =
          torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K) sP hP ((r : ℤ) + d - p)
            (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation K) sP
              (zeroFiber sP C').subschemeι (r : ℤ)).1
            (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (ι.base (genericPoint X)) 1)) ∧
      (∃ β : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K)
          (pullback.fst (ι ≫ sP) (relativeProjectiveLine (Spec (.of K)) ↘ Spec (.of K)) ≫ ι ≫ sP)
          ((r : ℤ) + d - p + 1),
        (properPushforward (fieldChowSituation K) _
            (pullback.fst sP (relativeProjectiveLine (Spec (.of K)) ↘ Spec (.of K)) ≫ sP)
            (familyBaseChange sP ι) (familyBaseChange_comp_structure K sP ι) _ β).1 =
          torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K)
            (pullback.fst sP (relativeProjectiveLine (Spec (.of K)) ↘ Spec (.of K)) ≫ sP)
            (isRegular_projectiveLineProduct sP hP) ((r : ℤ) + d - p + 1)
            (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single
              (C'.subschemeι.base (genericPoint C'.subscheme)) 1)
            (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single
              ((familyBaseChange sP ι).base (genericPoint (projectiveLineProduct (ι ≫ sP)))) 1))
        ∧
      ∀ (α : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K) (ι ≫ sP) ((r : ℤ) + d - p))
        (β : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation K)
          (pullback.fst (ι ≫ sP) (relativeProjectiveLine (Spec (.of K)) ↘ Spec (.of K)) ≫ ι ≫ sP)
          ((r : ℤ) + d - p + 1)),
        (properPushforward (fieldChowSituation K) (ι ≫ sP) sP ι rfl _ α).1 =
          torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K) sP hP ((r : ℤ) + d - p)
            (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation K) sP
              (zeroFiber sP C').subschemeι (r : ℤ)).1
            (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (ι.base (genericPoint X)) 1) →
        (properPushforward (fieldChowSituation K) _
            (pullback.fst sP (relativeProjectiveLine (Spec (.of K)) ↘ Spec (.of K)) ≫ sP)
            (familyBaseChange sP ι) (familyBaseChange_comp_structure K sP ι) _ β).1 =
          torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K)
            (pullback.fst sP (relativeProjectiveLine (Spec (.of K)) ↘ Spec (.of K)) ≫ sP)
            (isRegular_projectiveLineProduct sP hP) ((r : ℤ) + d - p + 1)
            (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single
              (C'.subschemeι.base (genericPoint C'.subscheme)) 1)
            (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single
              ((familyBaseChange sP ι).base (genericPoint (projectiveLineProduct (ι ≫ sP)))) 1) →
        AlgebraicCycle.IntersectProperly β.1
            (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single
              ((zeroSection (ι ≫ sP)).base (genericPoint X)) 1) ∧
          α = properPushforward (fieldChowSituation K)
            (pullback.fst (ι ≫ sP) (relativeProjectiveLine (Spec (.of K)) ↘ Spec (.of K)) ≫ ι ≫ sP)
            (ι ≫ sP) (pullback.fst (ι ≫ sP) (relativeProjectiveLine (Spec (.of K)) ↘ Spec (.of K)))
            rfl ((r : ℤ) + d - p)
            ⟨torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct (fieldChowSituation K)
                (pullback.fst (ι ≫ sP) (relativeProjectiveLine (Spec (.of K)) ↘ Spec (.of K)) ≫
                  ι ≫ sP)
                (isRegular_projectiveLineProduct (ι ≫ sP) hX) ((r : ℤ) + d - p) β.1
                (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single
                  ((zeroSection (ι ≫ sP)).base (genericPoint X)) 1),
              torFormulaCycleIntersectionProduct_mem_cyclesOfDimension _ _ _ _ _ _⟩
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, for a closed immersion of nonsingular varieties over an algebraically closed field and a closed subvariety `C'` of `P × 𝐏¹` presented as an integral closed subscheme: clause (1) is the dimension of the scheme-theoretic zero fibre, clause (2) the Tag 0AZQ inequality for `C'` and `X × 𝐏¹`, clause (3) proper intersection of the cycles `[C]_r` and `[X]`. The conclusion states that the two products are pushforwards of cycles `α` on `X` and `β` on `X × 𝐏¹`, that `β` and `X × 0` intersect properly, and that `α = pr_{X,*}(β · X × 0)` for every such `α` and `β`.
