`Rf_*(M~)` with `(M_R)~` (`AlgebraicGeometry.derivedTildeCompDerivedQuasicoherentPushforwardIso`,
[Stacks, Tag 0DJK]). Then the trace `Tr_{f, K~} : Rf_* a(K~) ⟶ K~` of [Stacks, Tag 0AWG] is
derived sheafification of the map `RHom_R(S, K) ⟶ K` which is the counit of the derived
restriction–Hom adjunction `Dualizing.AnyModel.derivedHomAdjunction`.

That counit is the map induced by the `R`-module map `R ⟶ S`: on complexes it is evaluation at
`1`, `Hom_R(S, K) ⟶ Hom_R(R, K) = K`
(`Dualizing.AnyModel.derivedHomAdjunction_counit_app`); the statement with that substituted is
`AlgebraicGeometry.qcqsTrace_specMap_app_derivedTilde_Qh`.
declarations.statement:
theorem qcqsTrace_specMap_app_derivedTilde (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) :
    (Stacks.Duality.qcqsTrace (Spec.map φ)).app ((derivedTilde R).obj K) =
      (derivedQuasicoherentPushforward (Spec.map φ)).map
          ((derivedTildeCompTwistedInverseImageIsoDerivedHom φ).hom.app K) ≫
        (derivedTildeCompDerivedQuasicoherentPushforwardIso φ).hom.app
          ((Dualizing.AnyModel.derivedHom.{u, u, u, u, u} φ.hom).obj K) ≫
        (derivedTilde R).map
          ((Dualizing.AnyModel.derivedHomAdjunction φ.hom).counit.app K)
declarations.comment: the trace map Tr_f of f = Spec(S) → Spec(R) is, under a(K~) ≅ RHom_R(S, K)~ and Rf_*(M~) ≅ (M_R)~, the map RHom_R(S, K) → K of the derived restriction–Hom adjunction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.qcqsTrace_specMap_app_derivedTilde_Qh
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0B6L, on complexes: the trace is induced by `R ⟶ S`.** Let `φ : R ⟶ S`,
`f = Spec φ`, and let `K` be a complex of `R`-modules. Through the comparison
`Hom_R(S, K) ⟶ RHom_R(S, K)` and the identifications of
`AlgebraicGeometry.qcqsTrace_specMap_app_derivedTilde`, the trace `Tr_{f, K~}` is derived
sheafification of the map `Hom_R(S, K) ⟶ K`, `g ↦ g(1)`, that is of precomposition with the
`R`-module map `R ⟶ S` followed by `Hom_R(R, K) = K`. When `K` is K-injective the comparison is an
isomorphism (`Dualizing.AnyModel.isIso_derivedHomComparison_app_of_isKInjective`), so this
computes `Tr_{f, K~}` itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem qcqsTrace_specMap_app_derivedTilde_Qh
    (K : HomotopyCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    (derivedQuasicoherentPushforward (Spec.map φ)).map
        ((derivedTilde S).map
            ((Dualizing.AnyModel.derivedHomComparison φ.hom).app K) ≫
          (derivedTildeCompTwistedInverseImageIsoDerivedHom φ).inv.app
            (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K)) ≫
      (Stacks.Duality.qcqsTrace (Spec.map φ)).app
        ((derivedTilde R).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K)) =
    (derivedTildeCompDerivedQuasicoherentPushforwardIso φ).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
          (((ModuleCat.coextendScalars.{u, u, u} φ.hom).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≫
      (derivedTilde R).map
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} φ.hom).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app
            (((ModuleCat.coextendScalars.{u, u, u} φ.hom).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Qh.map
            ((Dualizing.homotopyAdjunction (ModuleCat.restrictCoextendScalarsAdj.{u} φ.hom)
              (.up ℤ)).counit.app K))
declarations.comment: on complexes: through Hom_R(S, K) → RHom_R(S, K), the trace is the map Hom_R(S, K) → K induced by R → S, an isomorphism for K K-injective

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.rightAdjointToDerivedSheafHom_comp_derivedEvaluationAtOne_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6M (Example 48.9.8).** Let `i : Z ⟶ W` be a closed immersion and let
`a` be a right adjoint of `Ri_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_Z) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_W)`. Then the trace `Ri_* a(K) ⟶ K` —
the counit of `a` — is the comparison map of [Stacks, Tag 0A9X] pushed forward, followed by the
identification of [Stacks, Tag 0A77], followed by the map
`R ℰom_{𝒪_W}(i_* 𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ K` induced by the unit `𝒪_W ⟶ i_* 𝒪_Z`.

This is the diagram of the source with its quasi-coherence hypothesis discharged by
[Stacks, Tag 08D5] part (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem rightAdjointToDerivedSheafHom_comp_derivedEvaluationAtOne_of_isClosedImmersion
    (a : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory W ⥤ quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Z)
    (adj : closedImmersionQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward i ⊣ a)
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory W) :
    (modulePushforward (closedQuotient i).i).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((rightAdjointToDerivedSheafHom i
            (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_isClosedImmersion i) a adj).app K) ≫
        (closedQuotient i).derivedModulePushforwardDerivedSheafHomExactSupportIso.hom.app K.obj ≫
          (closedQuotient i).derivedEvaluationAtOne.app K.obj =
      (closedImmersionPushforwardModelIso i).hom.app ((a.obj K).obj) ≫
        (adj.counit.app K).hom
declarations.comment: the example, with no hypothesis beyond the closed immersion and the right adjoint: that Ri_* carries D_QCoh(O_Z) into D_QCoh(O_W) is Tag 08D5 part (1), and the commutativity holds for every K in D_QCoh(O_W), so neither the Noetherian hypothesis of the source nor boundedness of K appears

declarations.name: RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.ClosedQuotientMorphismOfRingedSpaces.evaluationAtOne
declarations.doc:
The map `ℰom_{𝒪_X}(i_* 𝒪_Z, -) ⟶ 𝟭` induced by the unit `𝒪_X ⟶ i_* 𝒪_Z`, that is,
evaluation of a local homomorphism at the section `1`: the counit of the adjunction of
[Stacks, Tag 0A75] read through its internal Hom identification.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def evaluationAtOne :
    S.homSheafFromPushforwardStructureSheaf ⟶ 𝟭 (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.X))
declarations.comment:
the last arrow of the triangle: the map `R Eom_{O_X}(i_* O_Z, K) ⟶ K` induced
by the unit `O_X ⟶ i_* O_Z`, here underived

declarations.name: RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.ClosedQuotientMorphismOfRingedSpaces.derivedEvaluationAtOne
declarations.doc:
The map `R ℰom_{𝒪_X}(i_* 𝒪_Z, -) ⟶ 𝟭` on `D(𝒪_X)` induced by the unit `𝒪_X ⟶ i_* 𝒪_Z`: the
transformation out of the right derived functor which restricts to evaluation at one.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedEvaluationAtOne :
    S.derivedHomSheafFromPushforwardStructureSheaf ⟶
      𝟭 (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.X)))
declarations.comment:
the last arrow of the triangle, constructed from the underived evaluation at the
section `1` by the universal property of the right derived functor

declarations.name: RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.ClosedQuotientMorphismOfRingedSpaces.derivedModulePushforwardDerivedSheafHomExactSupportIso_hom_comp_derivedEvaluationAtOne
declarations.doc:
**The triangle of [Stacks, Tag 0B6M] on all of `D(𝒪_X)`.** The trace `Ri_* R ℰom(𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ K`
— the counit of [Stacks, Tag 0A76] — is the isomorphism of [Stacks, Tag 0A77] followed by the
map `R ℰom_{𝒪_X}(i_* 𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ K` induced by the unit `𝒪_X ⟶ i_* 𝒪_Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedModulePushforwardDerivedSheafHomExactSupportIso_hom_comp_derivedEvaluationAtOne :
    S.derivedModulePushforwardDerivedSheafHomExactSupportIso.hom ≫ S.derivedEvaluationAtOne =
      S.derivedModulePushforwardSheafHomExactSupportAdjunction.counit
declarations.comment:
the triangle at the level of ringed spaces: the trace of Tag 0A76 is the
isomorphism of Tag 0A77 followed by the map induced by the unit `O_X ⟶ i_* O_Z`. Stated for
every closed quotient morphism of ringed spaces and all of `D(O_X)`, so neither a Noetherian
hypothesis nor boundedness of `K` appears

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.rightAdjointToDerivedSheafHom_comp_derivedEvaluationAtOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6M (Example 48.9.8).** Let `i : Z ⟶ W` be a closed immersion and let
`a` be a right adjoint of `Ri_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_Z) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_W)`. The trace `Ri_* a(K) ⟶ K` is the
comparison map of [Stacks, Tag 0A9X] followed by the isomorphism of [Stacks, Tag 0A77] followed
by the map `R ℰom_{𝒪_W}(i_* 𝒪_Z, K) ⟶ K` induced by the unit `𝒪_W ⟶ i_* 𝒪_Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightAdjointToDerivedSheafHom_comp_derivedEvaluationAtOne
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory W) :
    (modulePushforward (closedQuotient i).i).mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((rightAdjointToDerivedSheafHom i hpush a adj).app K) ≫
        (closedQuotient i).derivedModulePushforwardDerivedSheafHomExactSupportIso.hom.app K.obj ≫
          (closedQuotient i).derivedEvaluationAtOne.app K.obj =
      (closedImmersionPushforwardModelIso i).hom.app ((a.obj K).obj) ≫
        (adj.counit.app K).hom
declarations.comment:
the example: the trace of a right adjoint `a` of `Ri_*` is the comparison map of
Tag 0A9X followed by Tag 0A77 followed by the map induced by the unit `O_W ⟶ i_* O_Z`. Since
Tag 0A9X enters as its comparison map rather than as an isomorphism, the statement needs neither
pseudo-coherence of `i`, nor part (1) of Tag 0A6H, nor boundedness, and holds for every `K` in
`D_QCoh(O_W)`

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.map_twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback_comp_baseChange_of_torIndependent
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0B6P] (Lemma 48.8.2).** For a cartesian square of quasi-compact and
quasi-separated schemes with `f` and `g` Tor independent and `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, the square

```
L(g')^*(Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ a(𝒪_Y)) ──────────────→ L(g')^*a(K)
          │                                    │ α_K
          ↓                                    ↓
L(f')^*Lg^*K ⊗ᴸ a'(𝒪_{Y'}) ─────────────→ a'(Lg^*K)
```

commutes, where the horizontal arrows are the maps of Equation 48.8.0.1 for `K` and `Lg^*K`, `α`
is the base change map of Equation 48.5.0.1, and the left vertical arrow is the tensor comparison
of `L(g')^*`, the identification `L(g')^*Lf^* ≅ L(f')^*Lg^*` of the composites around the
square, and `α` at `𝒪_Y` followed by `a'` of `Lg^*𝒪_Y ≅ 𝒪_{Y'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem map_twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback_comp_baseChange_of_torIndependent
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (hTor : TorIndependent f g) (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    haveI := isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_torIndependent sq hTor
    (quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g').map
        (twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback f
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
          (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso f).hom (quasiCoherentDerivedTensorRightUnitor Y)
          K) ≫
      (twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap g' f' f g
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g) sq).app K =
      (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso g').hom.app
          ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y), (quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj K) ≫
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X').map
          (((quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackCompIso g' f ≪≫ quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackCongr sq.w) ≪≫
            (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackCompIso f' g).symm).hom.app K)).app
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g').obj
            ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
              (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y))) ≫
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X').obj
            ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f').obj ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g).obj K))).map
          ((twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap g' f' f g
              (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
              (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
              (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
              (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g) sq).app
              (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y) ≫
            (twistedInverseImage f' (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')).map
              ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g).map
                  (eqToHom (tensorUnit_quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y).symm) ≫
                Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η (quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g) ≫
                eqToHom (tensorUnit_quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y'))) ≫
        twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback f'
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
          (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso f').hom (quasiCoherentDerivedTensorRightUnitor Y')
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g).obj K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_map_twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback_of_isIso_morphismRestrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6Q (Lemma 48.8.3).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of
Noetherian schemes and let `V ⊆ Y` be an open such that `f⁻¹(V) ⟶ V` is an isomorphism. Then for
`K ∈ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` the map `Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)` of Equation 48.8.0.1 restricts to an
isomorphism over `f⁻¹(V)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_map_twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback_of_isIso_morphismRestrict
    (V : Y.Opens) [IsIso (f ∣_ V)] (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y)
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj) :
    IsIso ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).map
      (twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
        (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso f).hom
        (quasiCoherentDerivedTensorRightUnitor Y) K))

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback_comp
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes,
`h = f ≫ g`, and `a`, `b`, `c` the right adjoints of `Rf_*`, `Rg_*`, `Rh_*` on `D_QCoh`. For
`K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Z)` the diagram

```
Lf^*(Lg^*K ⊗ᴸ b(𝒪_Z)) ⊗ᴸ a(𝒪_Y) ──→ a(Lg^*K ⊗ᴸ b(𝒪_Z)) ──→ a(b(K))
            ‖                                                  ‖
Lh^*K ⊗ᴸ (Lf^*b(𝒪_Z) ⊗ᴸ a(𝒪_Y)) ──→ Lh^*K ⊗ᴸ c(𝒪_Z) ──────→ c(K)
```

commutes, where the arrows are Equation 48.8.0.1 (for `f` at `Lg^*K ⊗ᴸ b(𝒪_Z)`, `a` of that for
`g` at `K`; `Lh^*K` tensored with that for `f` at `b(𝒪_Z)`, then that for `h` at `K`), the left
identification is the tensor comparison of `Lf^*`, the associator and `Lf^* ∘ Lg^* = Lh^*`, and
`c = a ∘ b` is `Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImageCompIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback_comp (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Z) :
    twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
        (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso f).hom (quasiCoherentDerivedTensorRightUnitor Y)
        (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g).obj K)).obj
          ((twistedInverseImage g (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)).obj
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z))) ≫
      (twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).map
        (twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback g
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)
          (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso g).hom (quasiCoherentDerivedTensorRightUnitor Z)
          K) ≫
      (twistedInverseImageCompIso f g (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (f ≫ g))).inv.app K =
    (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).map ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso f).hom.app
          ((twistedInverseImage g (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)).obj
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z),
          (quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g).obj K))).app
          ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ≫
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensorIsoCurriedTensor X).hom.app _).app _ ≫
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensorIsoCurriedTensor X).hom.app
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g).obj K))).app
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj
            ((twistedInverseImage g (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)).obj
              (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z))) ▷ _ ≫
      (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫
      _ ◁ ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensorIsoCurriedTensor X).inv.app _).app _ ≫
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensorIsoCurriedTensor X).inv.app _).app _ ≫
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).map
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackCompIso f g).hom.app K)).app _) ≫
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).obj ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (f ≫ g)).obj K)).map
        (twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback f
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
          (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso f).hom (quasiCoherentDerivedTensorRightUnitor Y)
          ((twistedInverseImage g (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)).obj
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z)) ≫
          (twistedInverseImageCompIso f g (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
            (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)
            (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (f ≫ g))).inv.app
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z)) ≫
      twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback (f ≫ g)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (f ≫ g))
        (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso (f ≫ g)).hom
        (quasiCoherentDerivedTensorRightUnitor Z) K

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.relativeDualizingComplexStructureSheaf
declarations.doc:
**The relative dualizing complex `ω_{X/Y}^• = a(𝒪_Y)`** of [Stacks, Tag 0B6S], for `a = f^×`
the right adjoint of [Stacks, Tag 0A9E]: the twisted inverse image of the structure sheaf of the
base, placed in degree zero.

Over `Y = Spec k` for a field `k` this is `Stacks.Duality.dualizingComplexOverField`, the
dualizing complex of [Stacks, Tag 0BS2].
declarations.statement: def relativeDualizingComplexStructureSheaf : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X
declarations.comment: the relative dualizing complex omega^bullet_{X/Y} = a(O_Y) that the Remark names, the right adjoint of Tag 0A9E applied to the structure sheaf; defined for every quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism to a quasi-compact scheme, so in particular under the Remark's hypotheses

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.relativeDualizingTraceStructureSheaf
declarations.doc:
**The trace map `Tr_{f, 𝒪_Y} : Rf_* ω_{X/Y}^• ⟶ 𝒪_Y`** of [Stacks, Tag 0AWG], displayed in
[Stacks, Tag 0B6S]: the counit of `Rf_* ⊣ f^×` at the structure sheaf of the base.

That it induces the trace map `Tr_{f, K}` for every `K` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` — the commuting square
of the Remark — is `Stacks.Duality.map_relativeDualizingTensorIso_hom_app_comp_trace`.
declarations.statement:
def relativeDualizingTraceStructureSheaf :
    (quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
      (relativeDualizingComplexStructureSheaf f) ⟶
    Stacks.Duality.DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y
declarations.comment: the trace map Tr_{f,O_Y} : Rf_* omega^bullet_{X/Y} to O_Y that the Remark displays, the counit of the adjunction of Tag 0A9E at the structure sheaf of the base

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.relativeDualizingTensorIso
declarations.doc:
**The functorial isomorphism `a(K) = Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ ω^•_{X/Y}` of [Stacks, Tag 0B6S]**, for
`Y` quasi-compact and quasi-separated and `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of finite presentation:
an isomorphism of functors `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` from `K ↦ Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} ω^•_{X/Y}`, where
`ω^•_{X/Y} = a(𝒪_Y)` is the relative dualizing complex, to the right adjoint `a` of
[Stacks, Tag 0A9E]. Its components are the map of Equation 48.8.0.1 ([Stacks, Tag 0A9S]), which
is invertible by [Stacks, Tag 0E4K].
declarations.statement:
def relativeDualizingTensorIso :
    quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f ⋙ (quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).flip.obj
        ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
          (derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ≅
      twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
declarations.comment: the functorial isomorphism a(K) = Lf^*K ⊗^L omega^bullet_{X/Y} for K in D_QCoh(O_Y), omega^bullet_{X/Y} = a(O_Y), for Y quasi-compact quasi-separated and f proper flat of finite presentation: an isomorphism of functors whose components are the map of Equation 48.8.0.1, invertible by Tag 0E4K

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.map_relativeDualizingTensorIso_hom_app_comp_trace
declarations.doc:
**The trace map `Tr_{f, 𝒪_Y}` induces the trace map `Tr_{f, K}` for every `K`**, the
commuting square of [Stacks, Tag 0B6S]: `Rf_*` of the isomorphism
`Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ ω^•_{X/Y} ≅ a(K)` followed by the trace `Tr_{f, K} : Rf_* a(K) ⟶ K` of
[Stacks, Tag 0AWG] is the projection formula `Rf_*(Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ ω^•_{X/Y}) ≅ K ⊗ᴸ Rf_* ω^•_{X/Y}` of
[Stacks, Tag 08EU], followed by `id_K ⊗ Tr_{f, 𝒪_Y} : K ⊗ᴸ Rf_* ω^•_{X/Y} ⟶ K ⊗ᴸ 𝒪_Y` and the
identification `K ⊗ᴸ 𝒪_Y = K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem map_relativeDualizingTensorIso_hom_app_comp_trace (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    (quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).map
        ((relativeDualizingTensorIso f).hom.app K) ≫
      (twistedInverseImageAdjunction f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).counit.app K =
    (relativeDualizingProjectionFormulaIso f K).inv ≫
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj K).map (relativeDualizingTraceStructureSheaf f) ≫
      quasiCoherentRightUnitor.hom.app K
declarations.comment: the trace compatibility: Tr_{f,K} composed with Rf_* of the isomorphism a(K) = Lf^*K ⊗^L omega^bullet_{X/Y} is the projection formula of Tag 08EU followed by id_K ⊗ Tr_{f,O_Y} and K ⊗^L O_Y = K, the Remark's commuting square, for Y quasi-compact quasi-separated and f proper flat of finite presentation

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.relativeDualizingBaseChangeIso_hom
declarations.doc:
**`ω^•_{X'/Y'} = L(g')^* ω^•_{X/Y}`**, the first assertion of the last sentence of
[Stacks, Tag 0B6S]: the base change map of [Stacks, Tag 0AA6] at `𝒪_Y` is an isomorphism
([Stacks, Tag 0AAB]), and composed with `a'(Lg^*𝒪_Y ≅ 𝒪_{Y'})` it is the isomorphism
`relativeDualizingBaseChangeIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeDualizingBaseChangeIso_hom :
    haveI := quasiCompact_of_isPullback_relativeDualizing f sq
    haveI := quasiSeparated_of_isPullback_relativeDualizing f sq
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : CompactSpace X' := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f'
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X' := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f'
    haveI := isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_torIndependent sq
      (torIndependent_of_flat_left f g)
    IsIso ((twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap g' f' f g
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g) sq).app
          (derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ∧
      (relativeDualizingBaseChangeIso f sq).hom =
        (twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap g' f' f g
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g) sq).app
            (derivedStructureSheaf Y) ≫
          (twistedInverseImage f' (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')).map
            (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackDerivedStructureSheafIsoOfIsQuasicoherent g
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback' g)).hom
declarations.comment: the base change of the relative dualizing complex in the Remark's last sentence: for g : Y' to Y a morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes and X' = Y' x_Y X, the base change map L(g')^* a(O_Y) to a'(Lg^* O_Y) of Tag 0AA6 is an isomorphism (Tag 0AAB), so omega^bullet_{X'/Y'} = L(g')^* omega^bullet_{X/Y} through it and a'(Lg^* O_Y = O_{Y'})

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.map_trace_comp_eq_baseChange_comp_trace
declarations.doc:
**The trace map of `f'` is the base change of the trace map of `f`**, the second assertion of
the last sentence of [Stacks, Tag 0B6S], by [Stacks, Tag 0B6J]: `Lg^*` of
`Tr_{f, 𝒪_Y} : Rf_* ω^•_{X/Y} ⟶ 𝒪_Y`, followed by `Lg^*𝒪_Y ≅ 𝒪_{Y'}`, is the base change map
`β : Lg^* Rf_* ⟶ Rf'_* L(g')^*` at `ω^•_{X/Y}` (invertible, [Stacks, Tag 08IB]), followed by
`Rf'_*` of the base change isomorphism `L(g')^* ω^•_{X/Y} ≅ ω^•_{X'/Y'}` and
`Tr_{f', 𝒪_{Y'}} : Rf'_* ω^•_{X'/Y'} ⟶ 𝒪_{Y'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem map_trace_comp_eq_baseChange_comp_trace :
    haveI := quasiCompact_of_isPullback_relativeDualizing f sq
    haveI := quasiSeparated_of_isPullback_relativeDualizing f sq
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : CompactSpace X' := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f'
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X' := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f'
    IsIso (quasiCoherentDerivedBaseChange g' f' f g
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback' g)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback' g') sq.w) ∧
    (quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g).map
        ((twistedInverseImageAdjunction f
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).counit.app
          (derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ≫
      (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackDerivedStructureSheafIsoOfIsQuasicoherent g
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback' g)).hom =
    NatTrans.app (quasiCoherentDerivedBaseChange g' f' f g
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback' g)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback' g') sq.w)
        ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
          (derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ≫
      (quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f'
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')).map
        (relativeDualizingBaseChangeIso f sq).hom ≫
      (twistedInverseImageAdjunction f'
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')).counit.app
        (derivedStructureSheaf Y')
declarations.comment: the base change of the trace in the Remark's last sentence: Tr_{f',O_{Y'}} is the base change of Tr_{f,O_Y} via the base change isomorphism, i.e. Lg^* Tr_{f,O_Y} followed by Lg^* O_Y = O_{Y'} equals the base change map of Rf_* at omega^bullet_{X/Y} followed by Rf'_* of L(g')^* omega^bullet_{X/Y} = omega^bullet_{X'/Y'} and Tr_{f',O_{Y'}} (Tag 0B6J)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.upperShriekCompareWithPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6T (Lemma 48.16.5).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FTS S` and let `j` be a compactification of `X` over `Y`, with ambient scheme
`X̄`, open immersion `j.immersion` and proper structure morphism `f̄ = j.toBase`. The map

  `μ_{f,K} : Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} f^!𝒪_Y ⟶ f^!K`

is the restriction to `X` of the comparison map `Lf̄^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X̄} ā(𝒪_Y) ⟶ ā(K)` of Equation
48.8.0.1 ([Stacks, Tag 0A9S]), the source being read through the composition formula
`Lf^* ≅ Lf̄^* ⋙ Lj^*` and the monoidality of `Lj^*` of [Stacks, Tag 079U].
declarations.statement:
public def upperShriekCompareWithPullback (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y.left) :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X.left).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f.left).obj K)).obj
        ((upperShriek f j).obj (derivedStructureSheaf Y.left)) ⟶
      (upperShriek f j).obj K
declarations.comment: the map mu_{f,K} of Lemma 48.16.5, at the compactification j from which Stacks.Duality.upperShriek computes f^!

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.upperShriekCompareWithPullback_naturality
declarations.doc:
**The map `μ_{f,K}` of [Stacks, Tag 0B6T] is functorial in `K`.** Each of its three factors
is natural: the composition formula for derived pullback, the monoidality of `Lj^*`, and
Equation 48.8.0.1 by `Stacks.Duality.compareWithPullback_naturality`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem upperShriekCompareWithPullback_naturality
    {K K' : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y.left} (h : K ⟶ K') :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X.left).map
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f.left).map h)).app
          ((upperShriek f j).obj (derivedStructureSheaf Y.left)) ≫
        upperShriekCompareWithPullback f j αBar αImm ρ K' =
      upperShriekCompareWithPullback f j αBar αImm ρ K ≫
        (upperShriek f j).map h
declarations.comment: functoriality of mu_{f,K} in K

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.upperShriekCompareWithPullback_comp_upperShriekPlusIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0B6T]: `μ_{f,K}` does not depend on the compactification.** For two
compactifications `j₁`, `j₂` of `X` over `Y` and `K ∈ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, `μ_{f,K}` for `j₁`, followed
by the isomorphism `f^!_{j₁} ≅ f^!_{j₂}` of [Stacks, Tag 0AA0] at `K`, is `Lf^*K` tensored with
that isomorphism at `𝒪_Y`, followed by `μ_{f,K}` for `j₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem upperShriekCompareWithPullback_comp_upperShriekPlusIso
    (j₁ j₂ : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f.left))
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategoryPlusOfModel Y.left) :
    upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical f j₁ K.obj ≫
        ((upperShriekPlusIso f j₁ j₂).hom.app K).hom =
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X.left).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f.left).obj K.obj)).map
          ((upperShriekPlusIso f j₁ j₂).hom.app (derivedStructureSheafPlus Y.left)).hom ≫
        upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical f j₂ K.obj
declarations.comment: independence of the compactification

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6T (Lemma 48.16.5).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FTS S` and let `j` be a compactification of `X` over `Y`, with ambient scheme
`X̄`, open immersion `j.immersion` and proper structure morphism `f̄ = j.toBase`. The map

  `μ_{f,K} : Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} f^!𝒪_Y ⟶ f^!K`

is the restriction to `X` of the comparison map `Lf̄^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X̄} ā(𝒪_Y) ⟶ ā(K)` of Equation
48.8.0.1 ([Stacks, Tag 0A9S]), the source being read through the composition formula
`Lf^* ≅ Lf̄^* ⋙ Lj^*` and the monoidality of `Lj^*` of [Stacks, Tag 079U].
declarations.statement:
public def upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y.left) :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X.left).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f.left).obj K)).obj
        ((upperShriek f j).obj (derivedStructureSheaf Y.left)) ⟶
      (upperShriek f j).obj K
declarations.comment: the maps μ_{f,K}

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical_naturality
declarations.doc:
**The map `μ_{f,K}` of [Stacks, Tag 0B6T] is functorial in `K`.** Each of its three factors
is natural: the composition formula for derived pullback, the monoidality of `Lj^*`, and
Equation 48.8.0.1 by `Stacks.Duality.compareWithPullback_naturality`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical_naturality
    {K K' : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y.left} (h : K ⟶ K') :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X.left).map
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f.left).map h)).app
          ((upperShriek f j).obj (derivedStructureSheaf Y.left)) ≫
        upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical f j K' =
      upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical f j K ≫
        (upperShriek f j).map h
declarations.comment: functoriality of μ_{f,K} in K

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.upperShriekCompareWithPullback_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6T (Lemma 48.16.5), compatibility with composition.** Let
`f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of `AlgebraicGeometry.FTS S` with `S` Noetherian, and
let `cf`, `cg`, `cfg` be compactifications of `f`, `g` and `g ∘ f`, computing `f^!`, `g^!` and
`(g ∘ f)^!`. For `K ∈ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Z)`, the map `μ_f` at `Lg^*K ⊗ g^!𝒪_Z` followed by `f^!μ_{g,K}`
equals: the identification
`Lf^*(Lg^*K ⊗ g^!𝒪_Z) ⊗ f^!𝒪_Y = Lf^*Lg^*K ⊗ (Lf^*g^!𝒪_Z ⊗ f^!𝒪_Y)` (the tensor structure of
`Lf^*` and the associator), `Lf^*Lg^*K ⊗ μ_f` at `g^!𝒪_Z`, the identifications
`Lf^*Lg^*K = L(g ∘ f)^*K` and `f^!g^!𝒪_Z = (g ∘ f)^!𝒪_Z` of [Stacks, Tag 0ATX]
(`Stacks.Duality.upperShriekCompIso`), `μ_{g ∘ f}` at `K`, and `(g ∘ f)^!K = f^!g^!K`. The
tensor products are `Stacks.Duality.quasiCoherentDerivedTensor`, read through
`Stacks.Duality.quasiCoherentDerivedTensorIsoCurriedTensor` where the monoidal structure of
`D_QCoh` is used.
declarations.statement:
theorem upperShriekCompareWithPullback_comp (cf : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f.left))
    (cg : CompactificationOf (Over.mk g.left)) (cfg : CompactificationOf (Over.mk (f ≫ g).left))
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategoryPlusOfModel Z.left) :
    upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical f cf
        (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y.left).obj
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g.left).obj K.obj)).obj
          ((upperShriek g cg).obj (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z.left))) ≫
        (upperShriek f cf).map (upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical g cg K.obj) =
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensorIsoCurriedTensor X.left).hom.app
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f.left).obj
            (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y.left).obj
              ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g.left).obj K.obj)).obj
              ((upperShriek g cg).obj (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z.left))))).app
          ((upperShriek f cf).obj (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y.left)) ≫
        (quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f.left).map
          (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensorIsoCurriedTensor Y.left).hom.app
            ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g.left).obj K.obj)).app
            ((upperShriek g cg).obj (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z.left))) ▷ _ ≫
        Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f.left)
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g.left).obj K.obj)
          ((upperShriek g cg).obj (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z.left)) ▷ _ ≫
        (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫
        (quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f.left).obj
            ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g.left).obj K.obj) ◁
          (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensorIsoCurriedTensor X.left).inv.app
            ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f.left).obj
              ((upperShriek g cg).obj (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z.left)))).app
            ((upperShriek f cf).obj (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y.left)) ≫
          upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical f cf
            ((upperShriek g cg).obj (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z.left))) ≫
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackCompIso f.left g.left).hom.app K.obj ⊗ₘ
          ((upperShriekCompIso f g cf cg cfg).inv.app (derivedStructureSheafPlus Z.left)).hom) ≫
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensorIsoCurriedTensor X.left).inv.app
            ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (f ≫ g).left).obj K.obj)).app
          ((upperShriek (f ≫ g) cfg).obj (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Z.left)) ≫
        upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical (f ≫ g) cfg K.obj ≫
        ((upperShriekCompIso f g cf cg cfg).hom.app K).hom
declarations.comment: compatibility with composition

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.derivedCategoryBBounded_upperShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6U (Lemma 48.17.9), part (d).** In Situation 48.16.1 let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect morphism of `FTS S`. Then `f^!` maps `D^b_Coh(𝒪_Y)` into
`D^b_Coh(𝒪_X)`. Here `f^!` is computed at an arbitrary compactification `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryBBounded_upperShriek {S : Scheme.{u}} [AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian S]
    {X Y : FTS S} (f : X ⟶ Y) (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f.left)) [Perfect f.left]
    (E : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y.left)
    (hE : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBBounded
      (fun M : Y.left.Modules ↦ _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent M) E.obj) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBBounded
      (fun M : X.left.Modules ↦ _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent M)
      ((upperShriek f j).obj E).obj
declarations.comment: part (d)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.derivedCategoryBBounded_upperShriek_derivedStructureSheaf_of_perfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6U (Lemma 48.17.9), part (a).** In Situation 48.16.1 let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect morphism of `FTS S`. Then `f^!𝒪_Y` lies in `D^b_Coh(𝒪_X)`: it is
cohomologically bounded and its cohomology sheaves are coherent. Here `f^!` is computed at an
arbitrary compactification `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryBBounded_upperShriek_derivedStructureSheaf_of_perfect [Perfect f.left] :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBBounded
      (fun M : X.left.Modules ↦ _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent M)
      (((upperShriek f j).obj (derivedStructureSheaf Y.left)).obj)
declarations.comment: part (a)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.hasFiniteTorDimension_derivedScalarRestriction_upperShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6U (Lemma 48.17.9), part (b).** In Situation 48.16.1 let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect morphism of `FTS S`. Then `f^!𝒪_Y` has finite tor dimension in
`D(f⁻¹𝒪_Y)`: read on the ringed space `(X, f⁻¹𝒪_Y)`, it has Tor amplitude in some interval.
Here `f^!` is computed at an arbitrary compactification `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteTorDimension_derivedScalarRestriction_upperShriek [Perfect f.left] :
    Stacks.Cohomology.TorAmplitude.HasFiniteTorDimension
      (RingedSpace.inverseImage Y.left.toRingedSpace f.left.base)
      ((Scheme.Hom.derivedScalarRestriction f.left).obj (relativeDualizingComplexObj f j))
declarations.comment: part (b)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_derivedSheafHomothety_upperShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6U (Lemma 48.17.9), part (c).** In Situation 48.16.1 let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect morphism of `FTS S`. Then the homothety
`𝒪_X ⟶ R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(f^!𝒪_Y, f^!𝒪_Y)` is an isomorphism. Here `f^!` is computed at an arbitrary
compactification `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedSheafHomothety_upperShriek [Perfect f.left] :
    IsIso (Stacks.SheafOfModules.derivedSheafHomothety X.left.sheaf
      (relativeDualizingComplexObj f j))
declarations.comment: part (c)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_upperShriekCompareWithPullback
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a Noetherian scheme and `f : X ⟶ Y` a perfect morphism of `FTS S`. Then the map
`μ_{f,K} : Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} f^!𝒪_Y ⟶ f^!K`, `Stacks.Duality.upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical`,
is an isomorphism for all `K ∈ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. Here `f^!` and `μ_{f,K}` are computed at an
arbitrary compactification `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_upperShriekCompareWithPullback [Perfect f.left]
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f.left)) (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y.left)
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj) :
    IsIso (upperShriekCompareWithPullbackCanonical f j K)
declarations.comment: part (e)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isInvertible_and_isPerfect_upperShriek_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0B6V (Lemma 48.17.11).** In Situation 48.16.1 let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a
local complete intersection morphism of `FTS S`. Then
1. `f^!𝒪_Y` is an invertible object of `D(𝒪_X)`, and
2. `f^!` maps perfect complexes to perfect complexes.

Here `f^!` is computed at an arbitrary compactification `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInvertible_and_isPerfect_upperShriek_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
    (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism f.left) :
    (letI := Scheme.Modules.derivedMonoidal X.left;
      MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible (relativeDualizingComplexObj f j)) ∧
    ∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y.left,
      Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := Y.left.toRingedSpace) K.obj →
        Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := X.left.toRingedSpace)
          ((upperShriek f j).obj K).obj

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.NormalizedOnOpens.twistedInverseImageObjIsoPullbackTensorOfFlat
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Remark 0B6W], the second canonical isomorphism.** For a flat proper morphism
`f : X ⟶ Y` of schemes of finite type over a Noetherian `S`, with `a` the right adjoint of
`Rf_*`, there is a canonical isomorphism `a(K) ≅ Lf^* K ⊗ᴸ a(𝒪_Y)` for `K ∈ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`: through
`a = f^!` (at the Nagata compactification of `f`) it is the inverse of `μ_{f,K}`
([Stacks, Tag 0B6U] (e)).
declarations.statement:
def twistedInverseImageObjIsoPullbackTensorOfFlat [IsProper f] [Flat f]
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategoryPlusOfModel Y) :
    haveI := hq.source_noetherian
    haveI := hp.source_noetherian
    (twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj K.obj ≅
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).obj ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj K.obj)).obj
        ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
          (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y))
declarations.comment: the second canonical isomorphism a(ω_Y^•) = Lf^* ω_Y^• ⊗ ω_{X/Y}^•

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.NormalizedOnOpens.isoPullbackTensorOfFlatNagata
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Remark 0B6W].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a flat proper morphism of schemes of finite type
over `S`, where `S` is Noetherian with a dualizing complex `ω_S^•`, and `ω_X^•`, `ω_Y^•` the
dualizing complexes normalized relative to `ω_S^•`. With `a` the right adjoint of `Rf_*` and
`ω_{X/Y}^• = a(𝒪_Y)` the relative dualizing complex, the canonical isomorphism
`ω_X^• ≅ a(ω_Y^•) ≅ Lf^* ω_Y^• ⊗ᴸ ω_{X/Y}^•` in `D(𝒪_X)`: the inverse of
`Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImageObjIsoNagata` ([Stacks, Tag 0AUD]) followed by
`twistedInverseImageObjIsoPullbackTensorOfFlat`.
declarations.statement:
def isoPullbackTensorOfFlatNagata
    (hωS : haveI := hp.base_noetherian; IsDualizingComplex ωS.obj.obj) [IsProper f] [Flat f]
    (𝒦X : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hp ωS)
    (𝒦Y : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hq ωS) :
    haveI := hq.source_noetherian
    haveI := hp.source_noetherian
    𝒦X.complex.obj ≅ ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj 𝒦Y.complex.obj)).obj
          ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y))
declarations.comment: ω_X^• = a(ω_Y^•) = Lf^* ω_Y^• ⊗ ω_{X/Y}^• in D(O_X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.NormalizedOnOpens.nonempty_iso_pullback_tensor_of_flat_nagata
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0B6W]** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a flat proper morphism of schemes of finite type over
`S`, where `S` is Noetherian with a dualizing complex `ω_S^•`, and `ω_X^•`, `ω_Y^•` the dualizing
complexes normalized relative to `ω_S^•`. With `a` the right adjoint of `Rf_*` and
`ω_{X/Y}^• = a(𝒪_Y)` the relative dualizing complex,
`ω_X^• ≅ a(ω_Y^•) ≅ Lf^* ω_Y^• ⊗ᴸ ω_{X/Y}^•` in `D(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_pullback_tensor_of_flat_nagata
    (hωS : haveI := hp.base_noetherian; IsDualizingComplex ωS.obj.obj) [IsProper f] [Flat f]
    (𝒦X : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hp ωS)
    (𝒦Y : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hq ωS) :
    haveI := hq.source_noetherian
    haveI := hp.source_noetherian
    Nonempty (𝒦X.complex.obj ≅ ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj 𝒦Y.complex.obj)).obj
          ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
            (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.NormalizedOnOpens.sheafHomDualizingIsoNagata
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0B6X], the second isomorphism.** In Situation 0AU4, for a proper `f : X ⟶ Y` of
schemes of finite type over `S`, the dualizing complexes `ω_X^•`, `ω_Y^•` normalized relative to
`ω_S^•` and every `L` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, `Rf_* R𝓗om(L, ω_X^•) ≅ R𝓗om(Rf_* L, ω_Y^•)`: the sheafy
trace map at `ω_Y^•` composed with `a(ω_Y^•) ≅ ω_X^•` ([Stacks, Tag 0AUD]).
declarations.statement:
def sheafHomDualizingIsoNagata
    (hωS : haveI := hp.base_noetherian; IsDualizingComplex ωS.obj.obj) [IsProper f]
    (𝒦X : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hp ωS)
    (𝒦Y : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hq ωS)
    (L : Std X) (hL : qcoh X L) :
    (push f).obj (((sheafHom X).obj (op L)).obj (stdComplex nagataCompactification 𝒦X)) ≅
      ((sheafHom Y).obj (op ((push f).obj L))).obj (stdComplex nagataCompactification 𝒦Y)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.NormalizedOnOpens.traceNagata
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0B6X], the trace map.** In Situation 0AU4, for a proper `f : X ⟶ Y` of schemes
of finite type over `S` and the dualizing complexes `ω_X^•`, `ω_Y^•` normalized relative to
`ω_S^•`, the canonical arrow `Tr_f : Rf_* ω_X^• ⟶ ω_Y^•`: the trace map of
[Stacks, Section 0AWG] read through `a(ω_Y^•) ≅ ω_X^•` ([Stacks, Tag 0AUD]).
declarations.statement:
def traceNagata
    (hωS : haveI := hp.base_noetherian; IsDualizingComplex ωS.obj.obj) [IsProper f]
    (𝒦X : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hp ωS)
    (𝒦Y : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hq ωS) :
    haveI := hq.source_noetherian
    haveI := hp.source_noetherian
    (quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
        𝒦X.complex.obj ⟶ 𝒦Y.complex.obj

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.NormalizedOnOpens.homEquivNagata
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0B6X], the first isomorphism.** In Situation 0AU4, for a proper `f : X ⟶ Y` of
schemes of finite type over `S`, the dualizing complexes `ω_X^•`, `ω_Y^•` normalized relative to
`ω_S^•` and `L` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, `Hom_X(L, ω_X^•) = Hom_Y(Rf_* L, ω_Y^•)`; it sends `u` to
`Tr_f ∘ Rf_* u` (`homEquivNagata_apply`).
declarations.statement:
def homEquivNagata
    (hωS : haveI := hp.base_noetherian; IsDualizingComplex ωS.obj.obj) [IsProper f]
    (𝒦X : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hp ωS)
    (𝒦Y : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hq ωS)
    (L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X) :
    haveI := hq.source_noetherian
    haveI := hp.source_noetherian
    (L ⟶ 𝒦X.complex.obj) ≃
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj L ⟶ 𝒦Y.complex.obj)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.NormalizedOnOpens.homEquivNagata_apply
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0B6X], the first isomorphism is produced by the trace map**:
`homEquivNagata` sends `u : L ⟶ ω_X^•` to `Tr_f ∘ Rf_* u`.
declarations.statement:
theorem homEquivNagata_apply
    (hωS : haveI := hp.base_noetherian; IsDualizingComplex ωS.obj.obj) [IsProper f]
    (𝒦X : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hp ωS)
    (𝒦Y : NormalizedOnOpens UpperShriek.nagata hq ωS)
    (L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X) (u : L ⟶ 𝒦X.complex.obj) :
    haveI := hq.source_noetherian
    haveI := hp.source_noetherian
    homEquivNagata hpe hωS 𝒦X 𝒦Y L u =
      (quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).map u ≫
        traceNagata hpe hωS 𝒦X 𝒦Y

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme_pullback_comp_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0B6Y.** The zero scheme of a section pulled back to `A` depends only on the morphism
`A ⟶ T`, not on a factorization of it: two factorizations `q₁ ≫ q₂ = r₁ ≫ r₂` give equal zero
schemes, both being the inverse image of `Z(s)` along that morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem zeroScheme_pullback_comp_comp {A B B' T : Scheme.{u}} (q₁ : A ⟶ B) (q₂ : B ⟶ T)
    (r₁ : A ⟶ B') (r₂ : B' ⟶ T) (h : q₁ ≫ q₂ = r₁ ≫ r₂) (L : T.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible T.sheaf.obj T.ringCatSheaf.property L]
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) :
    zeroScheme A ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q₁).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q₂).obj L))
        (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections q₁ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q₂).obj L)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections q₂ L s)) =
      zeroScheme A ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r₁).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r₂).obj L))
        (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections r₁ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r₂).obj L)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections r₂ L s))
declarations.comment: the zero scheme of a section pulled back along a composite does not depend on the factorization

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0B6Y.** The zero scheme of the pulled-back section is the scheme-theoretic inverse
image of the zero scheme: `Z(f^* s) = f⁻¹(Z(s))` as quasi-coherent ideal sheaves on `X'`.

Together with `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comapIso` and its two projection
identities this is the cartesian square `Z(f^* s) ≅ X' ×_X Z(s)` of the tag.
declarations.statement:
theorem zeroScheme_pullback {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X' ⟶ X) (L : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj X.ringCatSheaf.property L]
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) :
    zeroScheme X' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L) (pullbackGlobalSections f L s) =
      (zeroScheme X L s).comap f
declarations.comment: the pulled-back zero scheme

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comapIso
registrations.comment: the cartesian square

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comapIso_hom_fst
registrations.comment: the pulled-back inclusion

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comapIso_hom_snd
