**[Stacks, Tag 0BEF], the Künneth formula.** Let `k` be a field, let `X` and `Y` be schemes
over `k` and let `F`, `G` be quasi-coherent modules on `X`, `Y`. If `X` and `Y` are quasi-compact
and quasi-separated, the canonical map

`⨁_{p + q = n} Hᵖ(X, F) ⊗_k Hᑫ(Y, G) ⟶ Hⁿ(X ×_{Spec k} Y, pr₁^*F ⊗_{𝒪_{X ×_k Y}} pr₂^*G)`

of `AlgebraicGeometry.KunnethQcqs.kunnethMap` is an isomorphism for every `n`; its inverse is
`AlgebraicGeometry.KunnethQcqs.kunnethIso`. This is the library's registration of the tag: the
untagged `AlgebraicGeometry.nonempty_kunnethIso` reaches an abstract isomorphism from a datum of
derived global sections instead.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_kunnethMap [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] :
    IsIso (kunnethMap f g F G n)
declarations.comment: the canonical Künneth map, an isomorphism in every degree n

declarations.name: Stacks.PicardGroup.nonempty_iso_pullback_sectionOfPoint_of_finite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BEH.** Let `k` be a field, `X` a normal variety over `k`, and
`U ⊆ 𝔸^n_k` an open subscheme with `k`-rational points `p, q ∈ U(k)`. For every invertible module
`ℒ` on `X ×_{Spec k} U` the restrictions `ℒ|_{X × p}` and `ℒ|_{X × q}` are isomorphic.

Nothing is assumed beyond the source's hypotheses. The appeal to [Stacks, Tag 0BD7] at the
projection `pr : X ×_{Spec k} U → X` is made through
`Stacks.InvertiblePullback.exists_isInvertible_pullback_iso_of_isTrivial_genericFiber_of_flat`,
whose hypotheses hold here: `pr` is the base change of `U → Spec k`, which is flat (an open
immersion followed by the structure morphism of affine space) and, `n` being finite, locally of
finite type; `X` is integral, normal and — being of finite type over a field — locally
Noetherian, and so is `X ×_{Spec k} U`; and every fibre of `pr` is integral by
`Stacks.PicardGroup.isIntegral_fiber_fst`. Its remaining hypothesis, triviality of `ℒ` on the
generic fibre, is the one `Stacks.PicardGroup.nonempty_iso_pullback_sectionOfPoint` discharges
from [Stacks, Tag 0BDA].
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_pullback_sectionOfPoint_of_finite (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsVariety k f] [IsNormal X] {n : Type u} [Finite n]
    (U : (𝔸(n; Spec (.of k))).Opens) (p q : Spec (.of k) ⟶ U.toScheme)
    (hp : p ≫ openAffineSpaceOver k U = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
    (hq : q ≫ openAffineSpaceOver k U = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
    (L : (Limits.pullback f (openAffineSpaceOver k U)).Modules)
    [hL : IsInvertible (Limits.pullback f (openAffineSpaceOver k U)).presheaf
      (structureSheafRing
        (Limits.pullback f (openAffineSpaceOver k U)).toRingedSpace).property L] :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (sectionOfPoint f p hp)).obj L ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (sectionOfPoint f q hq)).obj L)
declarations.comment: k a field, X a normal variety over k, U an open of affine n-space over k with two k-rational points: an invertible module on X ×_{Spec k} U has isomorphic restrictions to X × p and X × q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.eulerCharacteristic
declarations.doc:
The alternating sum of the dimensions of the cohomology groups of a coherent sheaf on a
proper scheme over a field.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def eulerCharacteristic (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] : ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.eulerCharacteristic_eq_finsum_higherDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BEK].** Let `k` be a field, let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism of schemes proper
over `k` and let `G` be a coherent `𝒪_Y`-module. Then `χ(Y, G) = ∑ᵢ (-1)ⁱ χ(X, Rⁱf_*G)`, the
sum being over the nonnegative degrees, with no hypothesis.

The coherence of `Rⁱf_*G` that the right-hand side needs in order to name `χ(X, Rⁱf_*G)` is
[Stacks, Tag 02O5], in the form
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProperCoherenceWitness.higherDirectImageIsCoherent`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eulerCharacteristic_eq_finsum_higherDirectImage
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {Y X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsProper g] [IsProper (f ≫ g)]
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsCoherent] :
    eulerCharacteristic k (f ≫ g) G =
      ∑ᶠ i : ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i *
        @eulerCharacteristic k _ X g _
          (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus (i : ℤ)).obj G)
          (ProperCoherenceWitness.higherDirectImageIsCoherent Y X f
            (LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian g) (IsProper.of_comp f g) G
            inferInstance i)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_eulerPolynomial_twistedSheaf_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a scheme proper over `k`, let `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_r` be invertible
`𝒪_X`-modules and let `ℱ` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  Then the Euler characteristics of the
twists `ℱ ⊗ 𝓛_1^{⊗ n_1} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ 𝓛_r^{⊗ n_r}` are the values of a polynomial in `ℚ[n_1, …, n_r]`
which is zero or of total degree at most `dim Supp ℱ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_eulerPolynomial_twistedSheaf_of_isProper (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) {r : ℕ} (L : Fin r → X.Modules)
    [∀ i, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L i)] [IsProper f]
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F) :
    ∃ P : MvPolynomial (Fin r) ℚ,
      (P = 0 ∨ (P.totalDegree : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        topologicalKrullDim (_root_.SheafOfModules.supp F)) ∧
      ∀ n : Fin r → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => (n j : ℚ)) P
        = (@eulerCharacteristic k _ X f _ (twistedSheaf F L n)
            (@twistedSheaf_isCoherent X r F L _ hF n) : ℚ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_eulerPolynomial_sub_topDimComponents_totalDegree_lt
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BEN].** For `X` proper over a field `k`, a coherent `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ` and
invertible `𝒪_X`-modules `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_r`, the difference between
`χ(X, ℱ ⊗ 𝓛_1^{⊗ n_1} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ 𝓛_r^{⊗ n_r})` and the sum over the top-dimensional integral
components `Z` of `Supp ℱ`, weighted by the length of `ℱ` at the generic point of `Z`, of
`χ(Z, 𝒪_Z ⊗ 𝓛_1^{⊗ n_1} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ 𝓛_r^{⊗ n_r})` is a numerical polynomial in `n_1, …, n_r` of
total degree strictly less than `dim Supp ℱ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_eulerPolynomial_sub_topDimComponents_totalDegree_lt (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] {r : ℕ} (L : Fin r → X.Modules)
    [∀ i, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L i)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    ∃ P : MvPolynomial (Fin r) ℚ,
      (P = 0 ∨ ((P.totalDegree : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) <
        topologicalKrullDim (_root_.SheafOfModules.supp F)) ∧
      ∀ n : Fin r → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j ↦ (n j : ℚ)) P =
        (eulerCharacteristic k f (twistedSheaf F L n) : ℚ) -
          ∑ᶠ Z : TopDimIntegralSubscheme F,
            (Stacks.Chow.sheafMultiplicity F Z.genericPt : ℚ) *
              (componentTwistEulerCharacteristic k f L Z n : ℚ)
declarations.comment:
the Euler characteristic minus the length-weighted Euler characteristics of the
top-dimensional components of the support is a numerical polynomial of lower total degree

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BEP.** The intersection number `(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z)` of `d` invertible
`𝒪_X`-modules against a closed subscheme `i : Z ⟶ X` of dimension at most `d` of a proper
scheme `X` over a field `k`: the coefficient of `n_1 ⋯ n_d` in the numerical polynomial
`χ(Z, 𝓛_1^{⊗ n_1} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ 𝓛_d^{⊗ n_d}|_Z)`, computed as the `d`-fold mixed finite difference

`∑_{T ⊆ {1, …, d}} (-1)^{d - |T|} χ(Z, ⨂_{j ∈ T} 𝓛_j|_Z)`

of that function.  This is an honest integer, which is Stacks 0BEQ: only finitely many values of
the function are used, so neither polynomiality nor a choice of representing polynomial enters.
The Euler characteristic is written out as the alternating sum of the dimensions of the
cohomology groups, so that no coherence hypothesis is needed to state the definition;
`AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_sum_eulerCharacteristic` is the comparison with
`AlgebraicGeometry.eulerCharacteristic`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def intersectionNumber (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (d : ℕ) (_hd : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ d) (L : Fin d → X.Modules)
    [∀ j, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L j)] : ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_coeff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BEP, the coefficient of `n_1 ⋯ n_d`.**  If a rational polynomial `P` in `d`
variables of total degree at most `d` takes the Euler characteristics
`χ(Z, 𝓛_1^{⊗ n_1} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ 𝓛_d^{⊗ n_d}|_Z)` as its values at the integral tuples, then the
intersection number `(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z)` is the coefficient of `n_1 ⋯ n_d` in `P`.

This is the source's own description of the intersection number.  The existence of such a `P`,
which is Stacks 0BEM, is not assumed: the statement is unconditional in `P`, and the proof is
the monomial computation
`MvPolynomial.sum_neg_one_pow_mul_eval_indicator_eq_coeff_one`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_eq_coeff (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ d) (L : Fin d → X.Modules)
    [∀ j, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L j)]
    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℚ)
    (hP : ∀ n : Fin d → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => (n j : ℚ)) P =
      ((@eulerCharacteristic k _ Z (i ≫ f) inferInstance
        (twistedSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
          (fun j => (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (L j)) n)
        (isCoherent_twistedSheafUnitPullback k f i L n) : ℤ) : ℚ))
    (hdeg : P.totalDegree ≤ d) :
    ((intersectionNumber k f i d hd L : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      P.coeff (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun _ => 1)
declarations.comment: the coefficient of n_1 ⋯ n_d

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.selfIntersectionNumber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BEP, the self-intersection notation `(𝓛^d · Z)`.**  The intersection number of a
single invertible `𝒪_X`-module `𝓛` repeated `d` times against a closed subscheme `i : Z ⟶ X` of
dimension at most `d`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def selfIntersectionNumber (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ d) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L] : ℤ
declarations.comment: the self-intersection notation (L^d · Z)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_isInteger
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BEQ.** In the situation of Stacks 0BEP — `k` a field, `X` a scheme proper over `k`,
`i : Z ⟶ X` a closed subscheme of dimension at most `d`, and `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_d` invertible
`𝒪_X`-modules — the intersection number `(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z)` is an integer.

The intersection number is the coefficient of the squarefree monomial `n_1 ⋯ n_d` in the
numerical polynomial `χ(Z, 𝓛_1^{⊗ n_1} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ 𝓛_d^{⊗ n_d}|_Z)` of Stacks 0BEM, whose
coefficients are a priori only rational; the assertion is that this one is integral.  The
polynomial is not assumed: Stacks 0BEM, available unconditionally as
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_eulerPolynomial_twistedSheaf_of_isProper`, produces it, and its total
degree is at most `dim Supp 𝒪_Z ≤ dim Z ≤ d`.  The integer produced is
`AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber k f i d hd L`, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_coeff`.

The integrality itself is
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_int_coeff_one_of_eval_eq_eulerCharacteristic`, which holds for every
polynomial of total degree at most `d` representing those Euler characteristics.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_isInteger (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ d) (L : Fin d → X.Modules)
    [∀ j, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L j)] :
    ∃ P : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℚ,
      (∀ n : Fin d → ℤ, MvPolynomial.eval (fun j => (n j : ℚ)) P =
        ((@eulerCharacteristic k _ Z (i ≫ f) inferInstance
          (twistedSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
            (fun j => (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (L j)) n)
          (isCoherent_twistedSheafUnitPullback k f i L n) : ℤ) : ℚ)) ∧
        P.totalDegree ≤ d ∧
        ∃ m : ℤ, P.coeff (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun _ => 1) = (m : ℚ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_tensor
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BER].**  The intersection number is additive in each slot: if `𝓛_j` is the
tensor product of `𝓛_j'` and `𝓛_j''`, and the three families of invertible modules agree away
from `j`, then

`(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_j ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z) = (𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_j' ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z) + (𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_j'' ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_tensor (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ d) (j : Fin d) (L L' L'' : Fin d → X.Modules)
    [∀ q, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L q)]
    [∀ q, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L' q)]
    [∀ q, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L'' q)]
    (hL' : ∀ q, q ≠ j → L' q = L q) (hL'' : ∀ q, q ≠ j → L'' q = L q)
    (hj : L j ≅ (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨X.presheaf,
        Presheaf.isSheaf_of_isSheaf_comp _ (X.presheaf) (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
        (X.ringCatSheaf.2)⟩).obj ((L' j))).obj ((L'' j)))) :
    intersectionNumber k f i d hd L =
      intersectionNumber k f i d hd L' + intersectionNumber k f i d hd L''
declarations.comment: additivity of the intersection number in each invertible module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_update_tensor
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BER], the `Function.update` form.**  If `𝓛_j ≅ 𝓜 ⊗ 𝓝` then

`(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_j ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z) = (𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓜 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z) + (𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓝 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z)`,

the two families on the right being the given one with its `j`-th member replaced.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_update_tensor (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ d) (j : Fin d) (L : Fin d → X.Modules)
    [∀ q, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L q)] (M N : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 M]
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 N]
    (hj : L j ≅ (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨X.presheaf,
        Presheaf.isSheaf_of_isSheaf_comp _ (X.presheaf) (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
        (X.ringCatSheaf.2)⟩).obj (M)).obj (N))) :
    intersectionNumber k f i d hd L =
      intersectionNumber k f i d hd (Function.update L j M) +
        intersectionNumber k f i d hd (Function.update L j N)
declarations.comment: additivity in the j-th slot, written with Function.update

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_sum_topDimComponents
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BES].**  Let `k` be a field, let `X` be proper over `k`, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be
a closed subscheme of dimension `d` and let `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_d` be invertible `𝒪_X`-modules.  Writing
`Z_1, …, Z_t` for the irreducible components of `Z` of dimension `d`, with generic points `ξ_i`
and multiplicities `m_i = length_{𝒪_{X, ξ_i}} 𝒪_{Z, ξ_i}`, the intersection number of `Z` is
the weighted sum of those of its components:

`(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z) = ∑_i m_i (𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z_i)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_eq_sum_topDimComponents (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (L : Fin d → X.Modules)
    [∀ j, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L j)] :
    intersectionNumber k f i d hd.le L =
      ∑ᶠ W : TopDimIntegralSubscheme
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule Z)),
        Stacks.Chow.sheafMultiplicity
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule Z)) W.genericPt *
          intersectionNumber k f W.1.subschemeι d
            (topologicalKrullDim_subscheme_le_of_topDimIntegralSubscheme i hd W) L
declarations.comment:
the intersection number is the length-weighted sum of the intersection numbers
of the top-dimensional irreducible components

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_sum_dimComponents
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BES].**  Let `k` be a field, let `X` be proper over `k`, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be
a closed subscheme of dimension at most `d` and let `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_d` be invertible `𝒪_X`-modules.
Writing `Z_1, …, Z_t` for the irreducible components of `Z` of dimension `d`, with generic
points `ξ_i` and multiplicities `m_i = length_{𝒪_{X, ξ_i}} 𝒪_{Z, ξ_i}`, the intersection number
of `Z` is the weighted sum of those of its `d`-dimensional components:

`(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z) = ∑_i m_i (𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z_i)`.

For `dim Z = d` this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_sum_topDimComponents`, the components of dimension `d`
being then the top-dimensional ones; for `dim Z < d` both sides are zero, the sum being
empty.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_eq_sum_dimComponents (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (L : Fin d → X.Modules)
    [∀ j, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L j)] :
    intersectionNumber k f i d hd L =
      ∑ᶠ W : DimIntegralSubscheme
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule Z)) d,
        Stacks.Chow.sheafMultiplicity
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule Z)) W.genericPt *
          intersectionNumber k f W.1.subschemeι d W.topologicalKrullDim_le L

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_pullback_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BET], the case of a scheme-theoretic image of smaller dimension.** Let `k`
be a field, let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism of schemes proper over `k`, let `i : Z ⟶ Y` be an
integral closed subscheme of dimension at most `d` and let `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_d` be invertible
`𝒪_X`-modules.  If the scheme-theoretic image `f(Z)` has dimension less than `d`, then

`(f^*𝓛_1 ⋯ f^*𝓛_d · Z) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_pullback_eq_zero (k : Type u) [Field k] {Y X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (pY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (pX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper pY] [IsProper pX]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : f ≫ pX = pY) (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (L : Fin d → X.Modules)
    [∀ j, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L j)]
    (hIm : topologicalKrullDim (i ≫ f).image < (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    intersectionNumber k pY i d hd (fun j => (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (L j)) = 0
declarations.comment: the right-hand side is zero when the scheme-theoretic image has dimension less than d

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_pullback_eq_degreeOver_mul
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BET], the equal-dimensional case.** Let `k` be a field, let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a
morphism of schemes proper over `k`, let `i : Z ⟶ Y` be an integral closed subscheme of
dimension `d` and let `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_d` be invertible `𝒪_X`-modules.  If the scheme-theoretic image
`f(Z)` again has dimension `d`, then

`(f^*𝓛_1 ⋯ f^*𝓛_d · Z) = deg(f|_Z : Z → f(Z)) (𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · f(Z))`,

the degree being the one of [Stacks, Morphisms, Definition 02NY].
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_pullback_eq_degreeOver_mul (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {Y X Z : Scheme.{u}} (pY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (pX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsProper pY] [IsProper pX] (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : f ≫ pX = pY) (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z] (d : ℕ)
    (hZ : topologicalKrullDim Z = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (L : Fin d → X.Modules)
    [∀ j, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L j)]
    (hIm : topologicalKrullDim (i ≫ f).image = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    haveI : IsProper (i ≫ f) := isProper_comp_of_structureMap k pY pX f hf i
    haveI : IsIntegral (i ≫ f).image := Stacks.Chow.isIntegral_image (i ≫ f)
    haveI : IsProper (i ≫ f).toImage := Stacks.Chow.isProper_toImage (i ≫ f)
    intersectionNumber k pY i d hZ.le (fun j => (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (L j)) =
      degreeOver (i ≫ f).toImage *
        intersectionNumber k pX (i ≫ f).imageι d hIm.le L
declarations.comment: the degree formula when the scheme-theoretic image has the same dimension

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BEU].**  Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a scheme proper over `k`, let
`i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed subscheme of dimension at most `d + 1` and let `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_{d+1}` be
invertible `𝒪_X`-modules.  Let `D ⊆ Z` be an effective Cartier divisor of dimension at most `d`
with `𝓛_1|_Z ≅ 𝒪_Z(D)`.  Then

`(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_{d+1} · Z) = (𝓛_2 ⋯ 𝓛_{d+1} · D)`,

the intersection number of the divisor being taken along the composite closed immersion
`D ⟶ Z ⟶ X`.

This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_intersectionNumber_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor` with
its hypothesis `hfin` discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.forall_finiteDimensional_cohomologyOverField_of_isProper`, which is
[Stacks, Tag 02O6].

The bound `hdD` on the dimension of the divisor is still an argument here; it is *not* part of
Tag 0BEU's data, being a consequence of `hd`, and it is discharged in
`AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor'`, which therefore carries
the tag with no bound to supply. This form keeps its own registration.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_eq_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ (d + 1 : ℕ)) (L : Fin (d + 1) → X.Modules)
    [∀ t, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L t)]
    (Dv : Z.IdealSheafData) [hDv : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor Dv]
    (hdD : topologicalKrullDim Dv.subscheme ≤ d)
    (hL : (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (L 0) ≅ (invertibleSheaf Dv : Z.Modules)) :
    intersectionNumber k f i (d + 1) hd L =
      intersectionNumber k f (Dv.subschemeι ≫ i) d hdD fun t : Fin d => L t.succ
declarations.comment: taking the divisor's dimension bound as an argument

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor'
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BEU].**  Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a scheme proper over `k`, let
`i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed subscheme of dimension at most `d + 1` and let `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_{d+1}` be
invertible `𝒪_X`-modules.  Let `D ⊆ Z` be an effective Cartier divisor with
`𝓛_1|_Z ≅ 𝒪_Z(D)`.  Then

`(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_{d+1} · Z) = (𝓛_2 ⋯ 𝓛_{d+1} · D)`,

the intersection number of the divisor being taken along the composite closed immersion
`D ⟶ Z ⟶ X`.

This is the tag with nothing assumed.  Beyond `hd`, `hL` and the effective Cartier divisor
instance — which are the tag's own data — it has no hypothesis: the dimension bound
`dim D ≤ d` that the right-hand intersection number needs is supplied by
`AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDim_subscheme_le_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor_of_isProper`,
since an effective Cartier divisor is nowhere dense and so loses a dimension.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_eq_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor'
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ (d + 1 : ℕ)) (L : Fin (d + 1) → X.Modules)
    [∀ t, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L t)]
    (Dv : Z.IdealSheafData) [hDv : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor Dv]
    (hL : (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (L 0) ≅ (invertibleSheaf Dv : Z.Modules)) :
    intersectionNumber k f i (d + 1) hd L =
      intersectionNumber k f (Dv.subschemeι ≫ i) d
        (topologicalKrullDim_subscheme_le_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor_of_isProper k f i d hd Dv)
        fun t : Fin d => L t.succ
declarations.comment:
the intersection number of a closed subscheme against invertible modules equals
that of an effective Cartier divisor cutting out the first module's restriction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_pos
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BEV].** Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a scheme proper over `k`, let
`i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed subscheme of dimension `d` and let `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_d` be ample invertible
`𝒪_X`-modules.  Then the intersection number `(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z)` is positive.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_pos (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim Z = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (L : Fin d → X.Modules)
    [∀ j, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L j)]
    (hL : ∀ j, Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X (L j)) :
    0 < intersectionNumber k f i d hdim.le L

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.selfIntersectionNumber_pos
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BEV] for the self-intersection number** `(𝓛^d · Z)` of a single ample
invertible module.
declarations.statement:
public theorem selfIntersectionNumber_pos (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim Z = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (hL : Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X L) :
    0 < selfIntersectionNumber k f i d hdim.le L
declarations.comment: the self-intersection number of a single ample module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.degreeWithRespectTo_pos
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BEV] for the degree** `deg_𝓛(Z)` of [Stacks, Tag 0BEW]: the degree of a
closed subscheme with respect to an ample invertible module is positive.
declarations.statement:
public theorem degreeWithRespectTo_pos (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim Z = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (hL : Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X L) :
    0 < degreeWithRespectTo k f i d hdim L hL
declarations.comment: the degree deg_L(Z) of Tag 0BEW is positive

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.degreeWithRespectTo
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BEW.** The degree `deg_𝓛(Z)` of a closed subscheme `i : Z ⟶ X` of a proper scheme
`X` over a field `k` with respect to an ample invertible `𝒪_X`-module `𝓛`: the intersection
number `(𝓛^d · Z)` for `d` the dimension of `Z`.

The dimension is passed as a natural number `d` together with the hypothesis
`topologicalKrullDim Z = d`, which is what makes `d` the source's `dim(Z)`; `d` is therefore
determined by the data and the degree does not depend on which `d` is supplied.  An empty `Z` has
dimension `⊥` and an infinite-dimensional `Z` has dimension `⊤`, neither of which is
`(d : WithBot ℕ∞)` for a natural number `d`, so no value is assigned to them — see the
implementation notes.  Ampleness is not used in the body: the source requires it so that
`deg_𝓛` deserves the name of a degree, and it is carried for that reason.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def degreeWithRespectTo (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z = d) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (_hample : Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X L) : ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.selfIntersectionNumber_pullback_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BEX].** Let `k` be a field, let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a finite dominant morphism of
proper varieties over `k` of dimension `d` and let `𝓛` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module.  Then

`(f^*𝓛^d · Y) = deg(f) (𝓛^d · X)`,

the degree `deg(f) = [R(Y) : R(X)]` being `AlgebraicGeometry.degreeOver` of
[Stacks, Morphisms, Definition 02NY].  For `𝓛` ample both sides are the degrees
`deg_{f^*𝓛}(Y)` and `deg_𝓛(X)` of [Stacks, Tag 0BEW], which is the source's statement; see
`AlgebraicGeometry.degreeWithRespectTo_pullback_of_isFinite`.

Ampleness is not assumed: it is not used by the source's proof and neither side needs it to be
formed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem selfIntersectionNumber_pullback_of_isFinite (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsVariety k p] [IsProper p] (f : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsFinite f] [IsDominant f] [IsVariety k (f ≫ p)] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : topologicalKrullDim X = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L] :
    selfIntersectionNumber k (f ≫ p) (𝟙 Y) d
          (((topologicalKrullDim_eq_of_isFinite_of_isDominant f).trans hd).le)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L) =
      (degreeOver f : ℤ) * selfIntersectionNumber k p (𝟙 X) d hd.le L
declarations.comment: for an arbitrary invertible module, with no ampleness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.degreeWithRespectTo_pullback_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BEX].** Let `k` be a field, let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a finite dominant morphism of
proper varieties over `k` and let `𝓛` be an ample invertible `𝒪_X`-module.  Then

`deg_{f^*𝓛}(Y) = deg(f) deg_𝓛(X)`,

the degrees being those of [Stacks, Tag 0BEW] and `deg(f) = [R(Y) : R(X)]` that of
[Stacks, Morphisms, Definition 02NY].

The dimension of `X` is passed as a natural number `d` together with
`topologicalKrullDim X = d`, as `AlgebraicGeometry.degreeWithRespectTo` asks; the dimension of
`Y` is then `d` too and is not a hypothesis.  Neither is the ampleness of `f^*𝓛` that the
left-hand side needs: it is `AlgebraicGeometry.isAmple_pullback_of_isFinite`.

The content is `AlgebraicGeometry.selfIntersectionNumber_pullback_of_isFinite`, which does not
mention ampleness; `AlgebraicGeometry.degreeWithRespectTo` is by definition the
self-intersection number, so this is that statement read at the source's notation.
declarations.statement:
public theorem degreeWithRespectTo_pullback_of_isFinite (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsVariety k p] [IsProper p] (f : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsFinite f] [IsDominant f] [IsVariety k (f ≫ p)] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : topologicalKrullDim X = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (hL : Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X L) :
    degreeWithRespectTo k (f ≫ p) (𝟙 Y) d
          ((topologicalKrullDim_eq_of_isFinite_of_isDominant f).trans hd)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L) (isAmple_pullback_of_isFinite f L hL) =
      (degreeOver f : ℤ) * degreeWithRespectTo k p (𝟙 X) d hd L hL

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_one_eq_invertibleCurveDegree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BEY.** For a closed subscheme `Z ⊂ X` of dimension at most one of a proper scheme
`X` over a field `k` and an invertible `𝒪_X`-module `𝓛`, the intersection number `(𝓛 · Z)` is
the degree `deg(𝓛|_Z)` of Stacks 0AYR.

The source's proof is that `n ↦ χ(Z, 𝓛|_Z^{⊗ n})` has degree one, so its leading coefficient is
the difference of consecutive values.  With the finite difference as the definition that
difference *is* the intersection number: the sum over `Finset (Fin 1)` has the two terms
`-χ(Z, 𝒪_Z)` and `χ(Z, 𝓛|_Z)`, the first twist being the trivial one
(`AlgebraicGeometry.twistedSheafZeroIso`) and the second `𝓛|_Z` itself
(`Stacks.SheafOfModules.Invertible.tensorPowerOneIso` and the left unitor), and
`AlgebraicGeometry.invertibleCurveDegree` is by definition their difference.  Neither
polynomiality nor a degree computation is needed, so the statement keeps the source's `≤ 1`;
it is in fact true for every `Z`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem intersectionNumber_one_eq_invertibleCurveDegree (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim Z ≤ 1) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L] :
    intersectionNumber k f i 1 hdim (fun _ => L) =
      invertibleCurveDegree k (i ≫ f) hdim ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.degreeWithRespectTo_eq_invertibleCurveDegree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BEY, the ample case.** For a closed subscheme `Z ⊂ X` of dimension one of a proper
scheme `X` over a field `k` and an ample invertible `𝒪_X`-module `𝓛`, the degree `deg_𝓛(Z)` of
Stacks 0BEW is the degree `deg(𝓛|_Z)` of Stacks 0AYR.

The source states this for `Z` of dimension at most one, but at dimension zero the two numbers
differ: `deg_𝓛(Z)` is then `(𝓛^0 · Z) = χ(Z, 𝒪_Z)`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_zero`) while `deg(𝓛|_Z)` is `χ(Z, 𝓛|_Z) - χ(Z, 𝒪_Z)`,
and for a nonempty zero-dimensional `Z` the first is the positive integer `dim_k Γ(Z, 𝒪_Z)` and
the second is `0`.  The hypothesis is therefore `topologicalKrullDim Z = 1`, which is where
`deg_𝓛(Z)` is the intersection number `(𝓛 · Z)`; the conclusion is then
`AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_one_eq_invertibleCurveDegree`, which does keep the
source's `≤ 1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem degreeWithRespectTo_eq_invertibleCurveDegree (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hd : topologicalKrullDim Z = 1) (L : X.Modules)
    [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (hample : Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X L) :
    degreeWithRespectTo k f i 1 hd L hample =
      invertibleCurveDegree k (i ≫ f) hd.le ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L)
declarations.comment: the ample case

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsDescentLocus.isClosedImmersion_hom_of_geometricallyIntegral
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BF0].** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be flat, proper and of finite
presentation, with `𝒪_T ⟶ f_{T,*}𝒪_{X_T}` an isomorphism for every base change `T ⟶ S`, let `E`
be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, and let the geometric fibres of `f` be integral (`hgeom`:
`X ×_S Spec k` is integral for every algebraically closed field `k` and `Spec k ⟶ S`). Then every
descent locus `Z` of `E` over `f` (Tag 0BDP) is closed in `S`: its structure morphism is a closed
immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsDescentLocus.isClosedImmersion_hom_of_geometricallyIntegral
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso (structureSheafHom (pullback.snd f a).toLRSHom.toShHom))
    (E : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 E]
    (hgeom : ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (s : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S),
      IsIntegral (pullback f s))
    {Z : Over S} (hZ : IsDescentLocus f E Z) :
    IsClosedImmersion Z.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_open_descendsFromBase_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0BF1.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` and `f' : X' ⟶ S` satisfy the hypotheses of
[Stacks, Tag 0BDP] — flat, proper, of finite presentation, with `𝒪_T ⟶ p_* 𝒪_{X_T}` an
isomorphism after every base change `T ⟶ S` — and let `i : X' ⟶ X` be a morphism over `S`, `L` an
invertible `𝒪_X`-module and `L' = i^* L`. Let `s ∈ S` be a point of the descent locus `Z` of
`(f, L)` at which `H¹(X_s, 𝒪) → H¹(X'_s, 𝒪)` is injective. Then `Z ∩ U = Z' ∩ U` for an open
neighbourhood `U` of `s`, where `Z'` is the descent locus of `(f', L')`.

**Rendering.** The locus `Z` of Tag 0BDP is the subscheme representing the descent condition
`AlgebraicGeometry.DescendsFromBase f L` (a morphism `g : T ⟶ S` factors through `Z` exactly when
`L` pulled back to `X ×_S T` comes from a finite locally free module on `T`), and likewise `Z'`
for `(f', L')`. The statement is written through the functors these subschemes represent, which
determine them: `s ∈ Z` is `DescendsFromBase f L (S.fromSpecResidueField s)`, and
`Z ∩ U = Z' ∩ U` is the equivalence of the two descent conditions for every `g : T ⟶ S` with
image in `U`. The fibre map `X'_s ⟶ X_s` is `pullback.map` of `i`, and the map on `H¹` is the
pullback map of [Stacks, Tag 01FA] on the structure sheaf, read in `H¹(X'_s, 𝒪_{X'_s})` through
the canonical `(X'_s ⟶ X_s)^* 𝒪_{X_s} ≅ 𝒪_{X'_s}`. The containment `Z ⊆ Z'` is
`descendsFromBase_modulePullback_of_comp`; the same statement for given representing objects
`Z`, `Z'` is `AlgebraicGeometry.IsDescentLocus.exists_open_factorsThrough_iff`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_open_descendsFromBase_iff {X X' S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S)
    (i : X' ⟶ X) (hi : i ≫ f = f')
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] (hfp : FinitePresentation f)
    (hfO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso (structureSheafHom (pullback.snd f a).toLRSHom.toShHom))
    [Flat f'] [IsProper f'] (hfp' : FinitePresentation f')
    (hfO' : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso (structureSheafHom (pullback.snd f' a).toLRSHom.toShHom))
    (L : X.Modules) [Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
    (s : S) (hs : DescendsFromBase f L (S.fromSpecResidueField s))
    (hH1 : Function.Injective (Stacks.Cohomology.moduleCohomologyPullbackMap
      (pullback.map f' (S.fromSpecResidueField s) f (S.fromSpecResidueField s) i (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
        (by rw [Category.comp_id, hi])
        (by rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])).toLRSHom.toShHom
      1 (SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).ringCatSheaf) ≫
        (Stacks.Cohomology.moduleCohomologyAlong
          (pullback.map f' (S.fromSpecResidueField s) f (S.fromSpecResidueField s) i (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
            (by rw [Category.comp_id, hi])
            (by rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])).toLRSHom.toShHom 1).map
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitIso
            (pullback.map f' (S.fromSpecResidueField s) f (S.fromSpecResidueField s) i (𝟙 _)
              (𝟙 _) (by rw [Category.comp_id, hi])
              (by rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]))).hom)) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), Set.range g.base ⊆ U →
      (DescendsFromBase f L g ↔ DescendsFromBase f' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L) g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsDescentLocus.exists_factorsThrough_iff_forall_of_injective_H1
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BF2].** Let `f : X ⟶ S` and the `i k ≫ f : Y k ⟶ S` (`k` in a finite type)
be flat, proper and of finite presentation with `𝒪_T ⟶ p_{T,*}𝒪` an isomorphism after every base
change `T ⟶ S`, the hypotheses of Tag 0BDP. Let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, `ℒ_k` its
pullback to `Y k`, and `Z`, `Z_k` descent loci (Tag 0BDP) of `ℒ` over `f` and of `ℒ_k` over
`i k ≫ f`. If `s ∈ Z` and `H¹(X_s, 𝒪) ⟶ ⊕_k H¹(Y_{k,s}, 𝒪)` is injective, then
`Z ∩ U = (⋂_k Z_k) ∩ U` (scheme theoretic intersection) for an open neighbourhood `U` of `s`: a
morphism `g : T ⟶ S` with image in `U` factors through `Z` if and only if it factors through every
`Z_k`.

`H¹(X_s, 𝒪)` is the degree-`1` cohomology of the `κ(s)`-linear derived global sections of
`𝒪_{X_s}`, and the `k`-th component of the map is
`Stacks.Cohomology.GlobalKunneth.sectionsPullbackMap` along the base change `Y_{k,s} ⟶ X_s` of
`i k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsDescentLocus.exists_factorsThrough_iff_forall_of_injective_H1
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] (hfp : FinitePresentation f)
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso (structureSheafHom (pullback.snd f a).toLRSHom.toShHom))
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (Y : ι → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ k, Y k ⟶ X)
    (hflat : ∀ k, Flat (i k ≫ f)) (hprop : ∀ k, IsProper (i k ≫ f))
    (hfpk : ∀ k, FinitePresentation (i k ≫ f))
    (hOk : ∀ k {T : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso (structureSheafHom (pullback.snd (i k ≫ f) a).toLRSHom.toShHom))
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace))
    [hL : IsInvertible X.presheaf
      (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) X.IsSheaf) L]
    {Z : Over S} (hZ : IsDescentLocus f L Z) {Zk : ι → Over S}
    (hZk : ∀ k, IsDescentLocus (i k ≫ f) ((modulePullback (i k).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L) (Zk k))
    (s : S) (hs : s ∈ Set.range Z.hom)
    (hinj : ∀ c : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (ModuleCat.{u} (baseRing (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace)) 1).obj
        ((sectionsOverBase (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit (structureSheafRing
              (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).toRingedSpace))))),
      (∀ k, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ 1).map
          (sectionsPullbackMap (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).toLRSHom.toShHom
            (pullback.map (i k ≫ f) (S.fromSpecResidueField s) f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)
              (i k) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp)).toLRSHom.toShHom
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit (structureSheafRing
                (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).toRingedSpace)))))).hom c = 0) →
        c = 0) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), Set.range g ⊆ (U : Set S) →
      ((∃ h : T ⟶ Z.left, h ≫ Z.hom = g) ↔
        ∀ k, ∃ h : T ⟶ (Zk k).left, h ≫ (Zk k).hom = g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.exists_isTrivial_on_open_of_isTrivial_faces
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` and `g : Y ⟶ S` be flat, proper and of finite presentation with
`𝒪_T ≅ f_{T,*}𝒪` and `𝒪_T ≅ g_{T,*}𝒪` after every base change, with sections `σ` of `f` and `τ`
of `g`, and let `L` be invertible on `X ×_S Y`. If `L` is trivial on the two faces
`(1, τ ∘ f) : X ⟶ X ×_S Y` and `(σ ∘ g, 1) : Y ⟶ X ×_S Y` and on the fibre over `s`, then `L` is
trivial over `U ×_S (X ×_S Y)` for an open neighbourhood `U` of `s`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isTrivial_on_open_of_isTrivial_faces
    {S X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] (hfp : FinitePresentation f)
    (hfO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso (structureSheafHom (pullback.snd f a).toLRSHom.toShHom))
    [Flat g] [IsProper g] (hgp : FinitePresentation g)
    (hgO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso (structureSheafHom (pullback.snd g a).toLRSHom.toShHom))
    (σ : S ⟶ X) (hσ : σ ≫ f = 𝟙 S)
    (τ : S ⟶ Y) (hτ : τ ≫ g = 𝟙 S)
    (s : S)
    (L : _root_.SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing (pullback f g).toRingedSpace))
    [IsInvertible (pullback f g).presheaf
      (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
        (pullback f g).IsSheaf) L]
    (hfaceX :
      let i : X ⟶ pullback f g :=
        pullback.lift (𝟙 X) (f ≫ τ) (by simp [Category.assoc, hτ])
      IsTrivial X.presheaf
        (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) X.IsSheaf)
        ((modulePullback i.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L))
    (hfaceY :
      let i : Y ⟶ pullback f g :=
        pullback.lift (g ≫ σ) (𝟙 Y) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
      IsTrivial Y.presheaf
        (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) Y.IsSheaf)
        ((modulePullback i.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L))
    (hfiber :
      let P := pullback f g
      let p : P ⟶ S := pullback.fst f g ≫ f
      let W := pullback p (S.fromSpecResidueField s)
      IsTrivial W.presheaf
        (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) W.IsSheaf)
        ((modulePullback (pullback.fst p (S.fromSpecResidueField s)).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L)) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧
      (let P := pullback f g
       let p : P ⟶ S := pullback.fst f g ≫ f
       let W := pullback p U.ι
       IsTrivial W.presheaf
         (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) W.IsSheaf)
         ((modulePullback (pullback.fst p U.ι).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.isTrivial_of_isTrivial_faces_and_fiber
declarations.doc:
**The theorem of the cube.** Let `f : X ⟶ S`, `g : Y ⟶ S` and `h : Z ⟶ S` be morphisms of
schemes, with `f` and `g` flat, proper, of finite presentation and with geometrically integral
fibres, let `x` and `y` be sections of `f` and `g`, and let `L` be an invertible module on
`X ×_S Y ×_S Z` whose pullbacks along the faces `x × 1 × 1` and `1 × y × 1` are trivial and whose
restriction to one fibre `X ×_S Y ×_S z` is trivial. If `Z` is connected, then `L` is trivial.

The fibre over `z` is the base change of the projection `X ×_S Y ×_S Z ⟶ Z` along
`Z.fromSpecResidueField z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTrivial_of_isTrivial_faces_and_fiber {S X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) (h : Z ⟶ S)
    (x : S ⟶ X) (hx : x ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S ⟶ Y) (hy : y ≫ g = 𝟙 S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] (hfp : FinitePresentation f) [GeometricallyIntegral f]
    [Flat g] [IsProper g] (hgp : FinitePresentation g) [GeometricallyIntegral g]
    [ConnectedSpace Z]
    (L : _root_.SheafOfModules.{u}
      (structureSheafRing (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h).toRingedSpace))
    [IsInvertible (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h).presheaf
      (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
        (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h).IsSheaf) L]
    (hfaceX :
      let i : pullback g h ⟶ pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h :=
        pullback.lift
          (pullback.lift (pullback.fst g h ≫ g ≫ x) (pullback.fst g h)
            (by simp only [Category.assoc, hx, Category.comp_id]))
          (pullback.snd g h)
          (by rw [pullback.lift_fst_assoc]
              simp only [Category.assoc, hx, Category.comp_id, pullback.condition])
      IsTrivial (pullback g h).presheaf
        (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
          (pullback g h).IsSheaf)
        ((modulePullback i.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L))
    (hfaceY :
      let i : pullback f h ⟶ pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h :=
        pullback.lift
          (pullback.lift (pullback.fst f h) (pullback.fst f h ≫ f ≫ y)
            (by simp only [Category.assoc, hy, Category.comp_id]))
          (pullback.snd f h)
          (by rw [pullback.lift_fst_assoc, pullback.condition])
      IsTrivial (pullback f h).presheaf
        (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
          (pullback f h).IsSheaf)
        ((modulePullback i.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L))
    (hfiber : ∃ z : Z,
      IsTrivial (pullback (pullback.snd (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h)
          (Z.fromSpecResidueField z)).presheaf
        (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
          (pullback (pullback.snd (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h)
            (Z.fromSpecResidueField z)).IsSheaf)
        ((modulePullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h)
          (Z.fromSpecResidueField z)).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L)) :
    IsTrivial (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h).presheaf
      (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
        (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h).IsSheaf) L

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.isTrivial_of_isTrivial_face_and_fiber
declarations.doc:
**The theorem of the cube.** Let `f : X ⟶ S`, `g : Y ⟶ S` and `h : Z ⟶ S` be morphisms of
schemes, let `x` and `y` be sections of `f` and `g`, and let `L` be a sheaf of modules on
`X ×_S Y ×_S Z` whose pullback along the face `x × 1 × 1` is trivial and whose restriction to one
fibre `X ×_S Y ×_S z` is trivial. If `Z` is connected and `D` is a descent locus for `L` along the
projection to `Z` which is a closed immersion and contains a neighbourhood of each of its points,
then `L` is trivial.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTrivial_of_isTrivial_face_and_fiber {S X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {D : Over Z}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) (h : Z ⟶ S)
    (x : S ⟶ X) (hx : x ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S ⟶ Y) (hy : y ≫ g = 𝟙 S) [ConnectedSpace Z]
    (L : _root_.SheafOfModules.{u}
      (structureSheafRing (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h).toRingedSpace))
    (hD : IsDescentLocus (pullback.snd (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h) L D)
    (hclosed : _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion D.hom)
    (hnbhd : ∀ z ∈ Set.range D.hom, ∃ U : Z.Opens, z ∈ U ∧
      DescendsFromBase (pullback.snd (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h) L U.ι)
    (hfaceX :
      let i : pullback g h ⟶ pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h :=
        pullback.lift
          (pullback.lift (pullback.fst g h ≫ g ≫ x) (pullback.fst g h)
            (by simp only [Category.assoc, hx, Category.comp_id]))
          (pullback.snd g h)
          (by rw [pullback.lift_fst_assoc]
              simp only [Category.assoc, hx, Category.comp_id, pullback.condition])
      IsTrivial (pullback g h).presheaf
        (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
          (pullback g h).IsSheaf)
        ((modulePullback i.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L))
    (hfiber : ∃ z : Z,
      IsTrivial (pullback (pullback.snd (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h)
          (Z.fromSpecResidueField z)).presheaf
        (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
          (pullback (pullback.snd (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h)
            (Z.fromSpecResidueField z)).IsSheaf)
        ((modulePullback (pullback.fst (pullback.snd (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h)
          (Z.fromSpecResidueField z)).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L)) :
    IsTrivial (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h).presheaf
      (Presheaf.isSheaf_comp_of_isSheaf _ _ (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
        (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) h).IsSheaf) L
declarations.comment: assuming the conclusions of Tags 0BDP, 0BF0 and 0BF3 for the descent locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.tangentMap_mul_at_identity
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BF5.** The differential of group-scheme multiplication at
the identity is addition of relative tangent vectors.
declarations.statement:
theorem tangentMap_mul_at_identity {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : Over S) [GrpObj G]
    (s : S) :
    let e : G.left := (η[G]).left s
    let m : pullback G.hom G.hom ⟶ G.left :=
      (Over.tensorObj_left G G) ▸ (μ[G]).left
    let z : ↑(pullback G.hom G.hom) :=
      (Over.tensorObj_left G G) ▸ ((lift (η[G]) (η[G])).left s)
    ∃ (h₁ : (pullback.fst G.hom G.hom) z = e)
      (h₂ : (pullback.snd G.hom G.hom) z = e)
      (hm : m z = e)
      (hbase : m ≫ G.hom = pullback.fst G.hom G.hom ≫ G.hom)
      (_ : IsIso (G.hom.residueFieldMap ((pullback.fst G.hom G.hom) z)))
      (_ : IsIso (G.hom.residueFieldMap ((pullback.snd G.hom G.hom) z)))
      (_ : IsIso (m.residueFieldMap z)),
      have : IsIso (G.hom.residueFieldMap ((pullback.fst G.hom G.hom) z)) :=
        ‹IsIso (G.hom.residueFieldMap ((pullback.fst G.hom G.hom) z))›
      have : IsIso (G.hom.residueFieldMap ((pullback.snd G.hom G.hom) z)) :=
        ‹IsIso (G.hom.residueFieldMap ((pullback.snd G.hom G.hom) z))›
      have : IsIso (m.residueFieldMap z) :=
        ‹IsIso (m.residueFieldMap z)›
      ∀ v w : DottedTangentArrow G.hom e,
        hm ▸ tangentMap m
          (pullback.fst G.hom G.hom ≫ G.hom) G.hom hbase z
          ((tangentSpaceProductEquiv G.hom G.hom z).toLinearEquiv.symm
            (h₁.symm ▸ v, h₂.symm ▸ w)) = v + w

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasiProjective_of_groupScheme_over_field
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field and `G` an algebraic group scheme over `k`. Then `G` is quasi-projective
over `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiProjective_of_groupScheme_over_field
    (G : Grp (Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))) [LocallyOfFiniteType G.X.hom]
    [QuasiCompact G.X.hom] :
    IsQuasiProjective G.X.hom

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.IsCentralPoint
declarations.doc:
A relative point of a group scheme lies in its functorial centre if it commutes with every
point after every base change of its domain.
declarations.statement: def IsCentralPoint {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : Grp (Over S)) {T : Over S} (h : T ⟶ G.X) : Prop
declarations.comment: the functorial centre

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.exists_closedSubgroupScheme_center
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BF8.** The centre of a locally algebraic group scheme over a field is
a closed subgroup scheme: the functorial centre `Stacks.Groupoids.IsCentralPoint` is represented
by a closed subgroup scheme of `G`.

The group scheme is separated over the field by Tag 047L, so for each chart `A` of the affine
open cover of `G` the locus where a point of `A` and a point of `G` commute is a closed subscheme
of `A ⊗ G`; its Weil restriction `W` along the projection to `G`, which exists by
`Stacks.Groupoids.hasWeilRestrictionAffineOverField`, universally cuts out "commutes with every
point of `A`".  The intersection of the `W` over all charts represents the centre by
`isCentralPoint_iff_affineCover`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_closedSubgroupScheme_center {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (G : Grp (Over (Spec (.of k))))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.X.hom] :
    ∃ Z : ClosedSubgroupScheme G,
      ∀ (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (h : T ⟶ G.X),
        (∃ z : T ⟶ Z.carrier.X, z ≫ Z.ι.hom.hom = h) ↔ IsCentralPoint G h
declarations.comment: representability of the centre by a closed subgroup scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isProjective_of_isAbelianVariety
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFA.** Let `k` be a field and let `A` be an abelian variety over `k`.
Then `A` is projective over `k`.

An abelian variety is an algebraic group scheme over `k`, hence quasi-projective over `k` by
Tag 0BF7, and it is proper over `k`, so Tag 0B45 makes it projective over the affine base
`Spec k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProjective_of_isAbelianVariety (k : Type u) [Field k] (A : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [GrpObj A] [IsAbelianVariety k A] : IsProjective A.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAbelianVariety_pullbackObj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFB.** For a field extension `K/k`, the base change `A_K` of an
abelian variety `A` over `k` is an abelian variety over `K`.
declarations.statement:
instance isAbelianVariety_pullbackObj (A : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GrpObj A]
    [IsAbelianVariety k A] :
    IsAbelianVariety K
      ((Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).obj A)

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.nonempty_cubeRelation_of_isAbelianVariety
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFE.** Let `k` be a field, let `A` be an abelian variety over `k`
and let `L` be an invertible `𝒪_A`-module. Then

`m₁₂₃^*L ⊗ m₁^*L ⊗ m₂^*L ⊗ m₃^*L ≅ m₁₂^*L ⊗ m₁₃^*L ⊗ m₂₃^*L`

as invertible modules on `A × A × A`, where `m_I` is the sum of the coordinates indexed by
`I`, written as the product of the corresponding coordinates in the group `A × A × A ⟶ A`. The
theorem of the cube is `Stacks.Groupoids.hasTheoremOfTheCube`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_cubeRelation_of_isAbelianVariety [IsAbelianVariety k A]
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing A.left.toRingedSpace))
    (hL : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible A.left.presheaf A.left.ringCatIsSheaf L) :
    Nonempty
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.schemeTensor (cubeObj A).left
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.schemeTensor (cubeObj A).left
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.schemeTensor (cubeObj A).left
              (pullbackOver (cubeProj₁ A * cubeProj₂ A * cubeProj₃ A) L)
              (pullbackOver (cubeProj₁ A) L))
            (pullbackOver (cubeProj₂ A) L))
          (pullbackOver (cubeProj₃ A) L) ≅
        Stacks.SheafOfModules.schemeTensor (cubeObj A).left
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.schemeTensor (cubeObj A).left
            (pullbackOver (cubeProj₁ A * cubeProj₂ A) L)
            (pullbackOver (cubeProj₁ A * cubeProj₃ A) L))
          (pullbackOver (cubeProj₂ A * cubeProj₃ A) L))

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.nonempty_cubeRelation
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be an abelian variety over a field `k` satisfying the theorem of the cube
`HasTheoremOfTheCube A`, and let `L` be an invertible `𝒪_A`-module. Then

`m₁₂₃^*L ⊗ m₁^*L ⊗ m₂^*L ⊗ m₃^*L ≅ m₁₂^*L ⊗ m₁₃^*L ⊗ m₂₃^*L`

as invertible modules on `A × A × A`, where `m_I` is the product of the coordinates indexed by
`I` in the group `A × A × A ⟶ A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_cubeRelation [AlgebraicGeometry.IsAbelianVariety k A]
    (hcube : HasTheoremOfTheCube A)
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing A.left.toRingedSpace))
    (hL : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible A.left.presheaf A.left.ringCatIsSheaf L) :
    Nonempty
      (schemeTensor (cubeObj A).left
          (schemeTensor (cubeObj A).left
            (schemeTensor (cubeObj A).left
              (pullbackOver (cubeProj₁ A * cubeProj₂ A * cubeProj₃ A) L)
              (pullbackOver (cubeProj₁ A) L))
            (pullbackOver (cubeProj₂ A) L))
          (pullbackOver (cubeProj₃ A) L) ≅
        schemeTensor (cubeObj A).left
          (schemeTensor (cubeObj A).left
            (pullbackOver (cubeProj₁ A * cubeProj₂ A) L)
            (pullbackOver (cubeProj₁ A * cubeProj₃ A) L))
          (pullbackOver (cubeProj₂ A * cubeProj₃ A) L))
declarations.comment: assuming the theorem of the cube (Tag 0BF4) for the triple self-product of A

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.nonempty_zpowId_pullback_iso
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, let `A` be an abelian variety over `k` satisfying the theorem of the
cube for its triple self-product, and let `L` be an invertible `𝒪_A`-module. Then

`[n]^*L ≅ L^{⊗ n(n+1)/2} ⊗ ([-1]^*L)^{⊗ n(n-1)/2}`

for every integer `n`, where `[n] : A → A` is multiplication by `n`, the `n`th power of the
identity in the group `A ⟶ A` of morphisms into the group object, and `[-1] = ι` is inversion.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_zpowId_pullback_iso [AlgebraicGeometry.IsAbelianVariety k A]
    (hcube : HasTheoremOfTheCube A) (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (pullbackOver ((𝟙 A : A ⟶ A) ^ n) L ≅
      schemeTensor A.left (schemeTensorPower A.left L hL (n * (n + 1) / 2))
        (schemeTensorPower A.left (pullbackOver (ι : A ⟶ A) L)
          (isInvertible_pullbackOver (ι : A ⟶ A) L hL) (n * (n - 1) / 2)))
declarations.comment: for every integer n, assuming the theorem of the cube (Tag 0BF4) for A

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.nonempty_zpowId_pullback_iso_of_isAbelianVariety
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, let `A` be an abelian variety over `k` and let `L` be an invertible
`𝒪_A`-module. Then for every integer `n`

`[n]^*L ≅ L^{⊗ n(n+1)/2} ⊗ ([-1]^*L)^{⊗ n(n-1)/2}`

where `[n] : A → A` is multiplication by `n`, the `n`th power of the identity in the group
`A ⟶ A` of morphisms into the group object, and `[-1] = ι` is inversion. Both divisions are
exact (`Stacks.Groupoids.two_dvd_mul_succ`).
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_zpowId_pullback_iso_of_isAbelianVariety (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (pullbackOver ((𝟙 A : A ⟶ A) ^ n) L ≅
      schemeTensor A.left (schemeTensorPower A.left L hL (n * (n + 1) / 2))
        (schemeTensorPower A.left (pullbackOver (ι : A ⟶ A) L)
          (isInvertible_pullbackOver (ι : A ⟶ A) L hL) (n * (n - 1) / 2)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_zpow_id
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, let `A` be an abelian variety over `k` and let `[n] = (𝟙 A) ^ n : A ⟶ A`
be multiplication by a nonzero integer `n` in the group `A ⟶ A`. Then `[n]` is finite locally free
of degree `|n| ^ (2 * dim A)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_zpow_id (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank ((𝟙 A : A ⟶ A) ^ n).left
      (n.natAbs ^ (2 * abelianVarietyDimension A))
declarations.comment: for n nonzero, the degree n^(2 dim A) read as |n|^(2 dim A): the source's statement fails for n = 0 when dim A >= 1, since [0] factors through the unit point and its fibre over the unit is all of A

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.etale_zpow_id_iff_isUnit_intCast
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFH.** Let `k` be a field and let `A` be a nonzero abelian variety
over `k`.  Then `[d] : A → A` is étale if and only if `d` is invertible in `k`.

Nonzeroness is the positivity of the topological Krull dimension, and it is used: it is what
makes the relative tangent space at the identity nonzero, so that multiplication by `d` on that
space is injective only for `d` invertible.  If `k` has characteristic `p` and `p` divides `d`
then the derivative of `[d]` at the identity vanishes, and `[d]` is not étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem etale_zpow_id_iff_isUnit_intCast (k : Type u) [Field k] (A : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [GrpObj A] [AlgebraicGeometry.IsAbelianVariety k A] (hA : 0 < topologicalKrullDim A.left)
    (d : ℤ) :
    Etale (((𝟙 A : A ⟶ A) ^ d).left) ↔ IsUnit ((d : ℤ) : k)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.intersectionNumber_eq_chowDegree_iteratedFirstChernCap_and_ample
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a proper scheme over `k` and let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed
subscheme of dimension `d`. For invertible `𝒪_X`-modules `𝓛_1, …, 𝓛_d`,

`(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z) = deg(c₁(𝓛_1) ∩ ⋯ ∩ c₁(𝓛_d) ∩ [Z]_d)`,

and in particular, for an ample invertible `𝒪_X`-module `𝓛`,

`deg_𝓛(Z) = deg(c₁(𝓛)^d ∩ [Z]_d)`.

Here `(𝓛_1 ⋯ 𝓛_d · Z)` is the intersection number of [Stacks, Tag 0BEP], `deg_𝓛(Z)` the degree
of [Stacks, Tag 0BEW], and `deg` the degree of zero cycles of [Stacks, Tag 0AZ1], for the Chow
groups over `Spec k` with its zero dimension function.
declarations.statement:
theorem intersectionNumber_eq_chowDegree_iteratedFirstChernCap_and_ample {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (d : ℕ)
    (dimZ : topologicalKrullDim Z = d) :
    (∀ (L : Fin d → X.Modules) [∀ j, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 (L j)],
      intersectionNumber k f i d dimZ.le L =
        chowDegree (fieldChowSituation k) (fieldChowSituation_dimensionFunction_eq_zero k) f
          (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)
          (iteratedFirstChernCap k f L
            (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rationalEquivalences (fieldChowSituation k) f d)
              (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) f i d)))) ∧
    (∀ (L : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L]
      (ample : Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X L),
      degreeWithRespectTo k f i d dimZ L ample =
        chowDegree (fieldChowSituation k) (fieldChowSituation_dimensionFunction_eq_zero k) f
          (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)
          (iteratedFirstChernCap k f (fun _ : Fin d => L)
            (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rationalEquivalences (fieldChowSituation k) f d)
              (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation k) f i d))))

declarations.name: isNormalRing_of_flat_of_isGeometricallyRegular_fiber
declarations.doc: Let `R → S` be a regular map of Noetherian rings. If `R` is normal, then `S` is normal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNormalRing_of_flat_of_isGeometricallyRegular_fiber
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] [Module.Flat R S]
    (hR : IsNormalRing R)
    (hfiber : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
      Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular p.ResidueField (p.Fiber S)) :
    IsNormalRing S

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_affineBlowupStandardOpen_iff_exceptionalIdeal_stalk_eq_span
declarations.doc:
A point of a blowup lies in the standard affine chart at `a` if and only if
the image of `a` generates the exceptional ideal in its local ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mem_affineBlowupStandardOpen_iff_exceptionalIdeal_stalk_eq_span
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (a : I.ideal U) (x : (blowUp I))
    (hx : (blowUpToBase I) x ∈ U.1) :
    letI := (reesSituation I).sectionRingGradedRing U.1
    letI := (reesSituation I).sectionRingGradingGradedRing U.1
    x ∈ Set.range
      ((Proj.basicOpen ((reesSituation I).sectionRingGrading U.1)
        (reesDegreeOne I U a).1).ι ≫
        (Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.relativeProjChart (reesSituation I) U)) ↔
      AlgebraicGeometry.IdealSheafData.stalk (exceptionalIdeal I) x =
        Ideal.span
          {((blowUpToBase I).stalkMap x)
            (X.presheaf.germ U.1 ((blowUpToBase I) x) hx
              (a : X.presheaf.obj (.op U.1)))}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bijOn_genericPoints_blowUpToBase
declarations.doc:
The blowup morphism restricts to a bijection from the generic
points of the irreducible components of the blowup onto the generic points of those irreducible
components of the base that are not contained in the centre.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijOn_genericPoints_blowUpToBase {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) :
    Set.BijOn (blowUpToBase I) (genericPoints (blowUp I)) (genericPoints X \ I.supportSet)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GlueingNearPoint.isSeparated_iff_isSeparated_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFN (separated case).** A morphism of finite presentation to `S` which
is an isomorphism over the complement of a closed point `s` is separated exactly when its base
change along `Spec 𝒪_{S, s} ⟶ S` is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_iff_isSeparated_baseChange (S : Scheme.{u}) (s : S)
    (hs : IsClosed ({s} : Set S)) (hqc : QuasiCompact (puncturedOpen hs).ι)
    (X : FinitePresentationAway (puncturedOpen hs)) :
    IsSeparated X.obj.hom ↔
      IsSeparated ((finitePresentationAwayBaseChange S s hs).obj X).obj.hom
declarations.comment: separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GlueingNearPoint.isProper_iff_isProper_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFN (proper case).** A morphism of finite presentation to `S` which is
an isomorphism over the complement of a closed point `s` is proper exactly when its base change
along `Spec 𝒪_{S, s} ⟶ S` is proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_iff_isProper_baseChange (S : Scheme.{u}) (s : S)
    (hs : IsClosed ({s} : Set S)) (hqc : QuasiCompact (puncturedOpen hs).ι)
    (X : FinitePresentationAway (puncturedOpen hs)) :
    IsProper X.obj.hom ↔
      IsProper ((finitePresentationAwayBaseChange S s hs).obj X).obj.hom
declarations.comment: proper

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GlueingNearPoint.isFinite_iff_isFinite_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFN (finite case).** A morphism of finite presentation to `S` which is
an isomorphism over the complement of a closed point `s` is finite exactly when its base change
along `Spec 𝒪_{S, s} ⟶ S` is finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinite_iff_isFinite_baseChange (S : Scheme.{u}) (s : S)
    (hs : IsClosed ({s} : Set S)) (hqc : QuasiCompact (puncturedOpen hs).ι)
    (X : FinitePresentationAway (puncturedOpen hs)) :
    IsFinite X.obj.hom ↔
      IsFinite ((finitePresentationAwayBaseChange S s hs).obj X).obj.hom
declarations.comment: finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GlueingNearPoint.etale_iff_etale_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFN (étale case).** A morphism of finite presentation to `S` which is
an isomorphism over the complement of a closed point `s` is étale exactly when its base change
along `Spec 𝒪_{S, s} ⟶ S` is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem etale_iff_etale_baseChange (S : Scheme.{u}) (s : S)
    (hs : IsClosed ({s} : Set S)) (hqc : QuasiCompact (puncturedOpen hs).ι)
    (X : FinitePresentationAway (puncturedOpen hs)) :
    Etale X.obj.hom ↔
      Etale ((finitePresentationAwayBaseChange S s hs).obj X).obj.hom
declarations.comment: etale

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isIso_restrict_of_finite_fiber_of_normal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFP (finite fibre, normal local ring).**
Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a proper birational morphism, where `X` is Noetherian and `Y`
is reduced. The morphism is an isomorphism over a neighbourhood of every point whose fibre
is finite and whose local ring is a normal domain.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isIso_restrict_of_finite_fiber_of_normal
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsProper f] [IsReduced Y]
    (hf : IsBirational f) (x : X) (hfinite : (f ⁻¹' {x}).Finite)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)] [IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)] :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ IsIso (f ∣_ U)
declarations.comment: finite_fibre_normal

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_maximal_isomorphism_open_of_quasiFiniteAt_of_isNormal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFP (quasi-finite point over a normal point).** The maximal open
over which a proper birational morphism with reduced source is an isomorphism contains every
normal point admitting a preimage at which the morphism is quasi-finite.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mem_maximal_isomorphism_open_of_quasiFiniteAt_of_isNormal
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsProper f] [IsReduced Y]
    (hf : IsBirational f) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsGreatest { V : X.Opens | IsIso (f ∣_ V) } U) (x : X)
    (hnormal : IsNormalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (y : Y) (hy : f y = x)
    (hqf : quasiFiniteAt f y) :
    x ∈ U
declarations.comment: quasi_finite_point_normal

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_maximal_isomorphism_open_of_mem_genericPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFP (codimension zero).**
Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a proper birational morphism, where `X` is Noetherian and `Y` is reduced. The
maximal open over which `f` is an isomorphism contains every point of codimension zero on `X`,
that is, every generic point of an irreducible component of `X`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mem_maximal_isomorphism_open_of_mem_genericPoints
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsProper f] [IsReduced Y]
    (hf : IsBirational f) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsGreatest { V : X.Opens | IsIso (f ∣_ V) } U) (x : X)
    (hx : x ∈ genericPoints X) :
    x ∈ U
declarations.comment: item (1): a point of codimension zero, a generic point of a component

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_maximal_isomorphism_open_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
declarations.doc:
Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a proper birational morphism, where `X` is Noetherian and `Y` is reduced.
The maximal open over which `f` is an isomorphism contains every point whose local ring is a
discrete valuation ring. Such a point has codimension one on `X`, the dimension of a discrete
valuation ring being one.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mem_maximal_isomorphism_open_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsProper f] [IsReduced Y]
    (hf : IsBirational f) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsGreatest { V : X.Opens | IsIso (f ∣_ V) } U) (x : X)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)] :
    x ∈ U
declarations.comment: item (2): a codimension-one point whose local ring is a discrete valuation ring

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isGorenstein_iff_isInvertible_dualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFQ, clause (1)(a).** A locally Noetherian scheme `X` carrying a
dualizing complex `ω_X^•` is Gorenstein if and only if `ω_X^•` is an invertible object of
`D(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGorenstein_iff_isInvertible_dualizingComplex [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsGorenstein X ↔
      letI := Scheme.Modules.derivedMonoidal X
      MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible K
declarations.comment: (1)(a): X is Gorenstein iff its dualizing complex is invertible in D(O_X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isGorenstein_iff_hasInvertibleDualizingModelOn
declarations.doc:
A locally Noetherian scheme carrying a dualizing complex is Gorenstein exactly when, at every
affine open, that complex is the associated sheaf of a dualizing complex over the ring of sections
which is locally a shifted unit — an invertible module in a single degree, locally on the affine
open.

By [Stacks, Tag 0FNT] the condition on the model says that it is an invertible object of
`D(Γ(X, U))`; see `Stacks.Duality.isGorenstein_iff_isInvertible_dualizingModel`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGorenstein_iff_hasInvertibleDualizingModelOn (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsGorenstein X ↔
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U), HasInvertibleDualizingModelOn K U hU
declarations.comment: (1)(a): Gorenstein iff the dualizing complex is locally a shift of the structure ring, read at the affine-local models

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isGorenstein_iff_isInvertible_dualizingModel
declarations.doc:
A locally Noetherian scheme carrying a dualizing complex is Gorenstein exactly when, at every
affine open, that complex is the associated sheaf of a dualizing complex over the ring of sections
which is an invertible object of its derived category, for the canonical derived tensor product of
[Stacks, Tag 0FNQ].

This is `Stacks.Duality.isGorenstein_iff_hasInvertibleDualizingModelOn` rewritten through
[Stacks, Tag 0FNT].
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGorenstein_iff_isInvertible_dualizingModel (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsGorenstein X ↔
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U),
        letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U, hU⟩
        letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard U.toScheme.Modules
        letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, U))
        letI := (DerivedCategory.Invertible.derivedCategory_symmetricMonoidalCategory
          Γ(X, U)).choose
        ∃ ω : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, U)),
          Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex ω ∧
            MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible ω ∧
              Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅
                (tilde.functor Γ(X, U) ⋙
                  Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor hU.isoSpec.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj ω)
declarations.comment: (1)(a): Gorenstein iff the dualizing complex is an invertible object, read at the affine-local models

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.exists_isOpen_isGorenstein
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFQ, clause (1)(c).** On a locally Noetherian scheme carrying a
dualizing complex, `U = {x ∈ X | 𝒪_{X,x} is Gorenstein}` is open and, as an open subscheme, is a
Gorenstein scheme.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isOpen_isGorenstein (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) :
    ∃ hU : IsOpen {x : X | Dualizing.IsGorensteinLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)},
      AlgebraicGeometry.IsGorenstein (Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := X) ⟨_, hU⟩)
declarations.comment: (1)(c): the Gorenstein locus is an open Gorenstein subscheme

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isGorensteinLocalRing_stalk_iff_isInvertible_localizedDualizing
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a locally Noetherian scheme, `U` an affine open and `x` a point of `U`. For every
dualizing complex `ω` over `Γ(X, U)`, the local ring of `X` at `x` is Gorenstein exactly when the
derived localization of `ω` at the prime `x` defines is an invertible object of the derived
category of that localization.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGorensteinLocalRing_stalk_iff_isInvertible_localizedDualizing
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (x : U) :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U, hU⟩
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, U))
    letI : (hU.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal.IsPrime := (hU.primeIdealOf x).isPrime
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal))
    letI := Dualizing.derivedCategoryMonoidal.{u, u}
      (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal)
    ∀ ω : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, U)), Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex ω →
      (Dualizing.IsGorensteinLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x.1) ↔
        MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible
          ((StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.derivedExtensionScalars
              (algebraMap Γ(X, U)
                (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal))).obj ω))
declarations.comment: (1)(b): the local ring at a point is Gorenstein iff the dualizing complex localized at that point is invertible, read at the affine-local models

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isGorensteinLocalRing_stalk_iff_isInvertible_localizedDualizingModel
declarations.doc:
Let `K` be a dualizing complex on a locally Noetherian scheme `X`, and `x` a point of an
affine open `U`. The local ring of `X` at `x` is Gorenstein exactly when `K` has a dualizing model
on `U` whose derived localization at the prime of `x` is invertible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGorensteinLocalRing_stalk_iff_isInvertible_localizedDualizingModel
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (hK : IsDualizingComplex K)
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (x : U) :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U, hU⟩
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard U.toScheme.Modules
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, U))
    letI : (hU.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal.IsPrime := (hU.primeIdealOf x).isPrime
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal))
    letI := Dualizing.derivedCategoryMonoidal.{u, u}
      (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal)
    Dualizing.IsGorensteinLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x.1) ↔
      ∃ ω : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, U)),
        Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex ω ∧
          Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅
            (tilde.functor Γ(X, U) ⋙
              Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor hU.isoSpec.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj ω) ∧
            MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible
              ((StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.derivedExtensionScalars
                  (algebraMap Γ(X, U)
                    (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal))).obj ω)
declarations.comment: (1)(b): the local ring at a point is Gorenstein iff the dualizing complex of the scheme, localized at that point, is invertible, read at the affine-local models

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isGorensteinLocalRing_stalk_iff_isInvertible_derivedStalk
declarations.doc:
On a locally Noetherian scheme carrying a dualizing complex `K`, the local ring at `x` is
Gorenstein exactly when the derived stalk `K_x` is an invertible object of `D(𝒪_{X,x})`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGorensteinLocalRing_stalk_iff_isInvertible_derivedStalk
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} X.Modules] (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) (x : X) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    letI := (DerivedCategory.Invertible.derivedCategory_symmetricMonoidalCategory
      (X.presheaf.stalk x)).choose
    Dualizing.IsGorensteinLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↔
      MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible ((AlgebraicGeometry.derivedStalkFunctor x).obj K)
declarations.comment:
(1)(b): the local ring at a point is Gorenstein iff the derived stalk of the
dualizing complex is invertible

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.exists_isDualizingComplex_iff_unit
declarations.doc:
A Gorenstein scheme has a dualizing complex if and only if its structure sheaf, placed in
degree zero, is a dualizing complex.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_iff_unit [AlgebraicGeometry.IsGorenstein X]
