    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.Modules] :
    (∃ K : DerivedCategory X.Modules, IsDualizingComplex K) ↔
      IsDualizingComplex ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))
declarations.comment: (2): a Gorenstein scheme has a dualizing complex iff its structure sheaf is one

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 0BFR (fields).** Every field has a dualizing complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isDualizingComplex (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} k), IsDualizingComplex K
declarations.comment: fields

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_of_isDedekindDomain
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFR (Dedekind domains).** A Dedekind domain has a dualizing complex,
namely the ring itself in degree zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_of_isDedekindDomain (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsDedekindDomain A] :
    ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), IsDualizingComplex K
declarations.comment: Dedekind domains

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_int
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFR (the integers).** The ring `ℤ` has a dualizing complex, namely
`ℤ[0]`: it is a Dedekind domain.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_int :
    ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ), IsDualizingComplex K
declarations.comment: the integers

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_of_isPrecomplete_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFR, the class of Noetherian complete local rings.** Such a ring has
a dualizing complex; the complex produced is in fact normalized, by
`Dualizing.exists_isNormalizedDualizingComplex_of_isPrecomplete_maximalIdeal`.

Completeness is precompleteness for the maximal ideal, as in [Stacks, Tag 07PJ]; see the
implementation notes of this file.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_of_isPrecomplete_maximalIdeal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsPrecomplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A] :
    ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), IsDualizingComplex K
declarations.comment: Noetherian complete local rings

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_ubiquity
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFR.** The following types of rings have a dualizing complex:

1. fields,
2. Noetherian complete local rings,
3. `ℤ`,
4. Dedekind domains,
5. any ring obtained from a Noetherian ring with a dualizing complex by taking an algebra
   essentially of finite type, or by taking an ideal-adic completion, or by taking a
   henselization, or by taking a strict henselization.

The five conjuncts are `Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex`,
`Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_of_isPrecomplete_maximalIdeal`,
`Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_int`,
`Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_of_isDedekindDomain` and, for clause (5), the five
statements `Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_of_essentiallyOfFiniteType`,
`Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_adicCompletion`,
`Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_henselizationPair`,
`Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_henselization` and
`Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_strictHenselization`; each carries the tag for its own
clause. See the implementation notes of this file for the two places where the conjunction says
more than the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_ubiquity :
    (∀ (k : Type u) [Field k],
        ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} k), IsDualizingComplex K) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
        [IsPrecomplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A],
        ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), IsDualizingComplex K) ∧
    (∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ), IsDualizingComplex K) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDedekindDomain A],
        ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), IsDualizingComplex K) ∧
    (∀ (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra A B],
        IsEssentiallyOfFiniteType A B (algebraMap A B) →
        (∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), IsDualizingComplex K) →
        ∃ (hB' : IsNoetherianRing B) (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B)),
          @IsDualizingComplex B _ hB' _ L) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A),
        (∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), IsDualizingComplex K) →
        letI : IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion I A) := AdicCompletion.isNoetherianRing I
        ∃ L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion I A)), IsDualizingComplex L) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
        (Ah : Type w) [CommRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
        (hh : HenselianPair Ah (I.map (algebraMap A Ah)))
        (hι : ∀ (B : Type (max u w)) (_ : CommRing B) (J : Ideal B),
          HenselianPair B J →
            ∀ f : A →+* B, I ≤ J.comap f →
              ∃! g : Ah →+* B,
                g.comp (algebraMap A Ah) = f ∧ I.map (algebraMap A Ah) ≤ J.comap g),
        (∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A), IsDualizingComplex K) →
        letI : IsNoetherianRing Ah :=
          (henselization_isNoetherian_and_completion_equiv A I Ah hh hι).2.1
        ∃ L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v w} Ah), IsDualizingComplex L) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
        (Ah : Type w) [CommRing Ah] [IsLocalRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
        [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) Ah],
        (∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A), IsDualizingComplex K) →
        letI : IsNoetherianRing Ah :=
          IsLocalRing.isNoetherianRing_of_isHenselization (A := A) (B := Ah)
            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
        ∃ L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v w} Ah), IsDualizingComplex L) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
        (L : Type uL) [Field L] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L]
        (Ash : Type w) [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash] [Algebra A Ash]
        [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A L Ash],
        (∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} A), IsDualizingComplex K) →
        letI : IsNoetherianRing Ash :=
          IsLocalRing.isNoetherianRing_of_isHenselization (A := A) (B := Ash) L
        ∃ M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} Ash), IsDualizingComplex M)
declarations.comment: all five clauses conjoined

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_of_essentiallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFR, clause (5) for algebras essentially of finite type.** If a
Noetherian ring `A` has a dualizing complex, then so does every `A`-algebra essentially of finite
type over `A`. This is the existence form of [Stacks, Tag 0A7K].
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_of_essentiallyOfFiniteType {A B : Type u} [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra A B]
    (hB : IsEssentiallyOfFiniteType A B (algebraMap A B))
    (hA : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), IsDualizingComplex K) :
    ∃ (hB' : IsNoetherianRing B) (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B)),
      @IsDualizingComplex B _ hB' _ L
declarations.comment: clause (5), algebras essentially of finite type

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_adicCompletion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFR, clause (5) for ideal-adic completions.** If a Noetherian ring `A`
has a dualizing complex, then so does its `I`-adic completion for every ideal `I`: the base
change of the dualizing complex along `A → A^∧` is one by [Stacks, Tag 0DWD] part (2).
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_adicCompletion {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (hA : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), IsDualizingComplex K) :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion I A) := AdicCompletion.isNoetherianRing I
    ∃ L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (AdicCompletion I A)), IsDualizingComplex L
declarations.comment: clause (5), ideal-adic completions

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_henselizationPair
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFR, clause (5) for the henselization of a pair.** If a Noetherian
ring `A` has a dualizing complex, then so does the henselization `A^h` of a pair `(A, I)`: the
base change of the dualizing complex along `A → A^h` is one by [Stacks, Tag 0DWD] part (1).
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_henselizationPair
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (Ah : Type w) [CommRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
    (hh : HenselianPair Ah (I.map (algebraMap A Ah)))
    (hι : ∀ (B : Type (max u w)) (_ : CommRing B) (J : Ideal B),
      HenselianPair B J →
        ∀ f : A →+* B, I ≤ J.comap f →
          ∃! g : Ah →+* B,
            g.comp (algebraMap A Ah) = f ∧ I.map (algebraMap A Ah) ≤ J.comap g)
    (hA : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A), IsDualizingComplex K) :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Ah :=
      (henselization_isNoetherian_and_completion_equiv A I Ah hh hι).2.1
    ∃ L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v w} Ah), IsDualizingComplex L
declarations.comment: clause (5), henselization of a pair

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_henselization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFR, clause (5) for the henselization of a local ring.** If a
Noetherian local ring `A` has a dualizing complex, then so does its henselization: the base
change of the dualizing complex along `A → A^h` is one by [Stacks, Tag 0DWD] part (3).
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_henselization
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (Ah : Type w) [CommRing Ah] [IsLocalRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) Ah]
    (hA : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A), IsDualizingComplex K) :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Ah :=
      IsLocalRing.isNoetherianRing_of_isHenselization (A := A) (B := Ah)
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
    ∃ L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v w} Ah), IsDualizingComplex L
declarations.comment: clause (5), henselization of a local ring

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_strictHenselization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFR, clause (5) for a strict henselization of a local ring.** If a
Noetherian local ring `A` has a dualizing complex, then so does any henselization of `A` with a
prescribed residue field extension `L/κ(A)` — in particular a strict henselization: the base
change of the dualizing complex is one by [Stacks, Tag 0DWD] part (3).
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_strictHenselization
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (L : Type uL) [Field L] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) L]
    (Ash : Type w) [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash] [Algebra A Ash]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A L Ash]
    (hA : ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} A), IsDualizingComplex K) :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Ash :=
      IsLocalRing.isNoetherianRing_of_isHenselization (A := A) (B := Ash) L
    ∃ M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} Ash), IsDualizingComplex M
declarations.comment: clause (5), strict henselization of a local ring

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_isDualizingComplex_of_isAdicComplete
declarations.doc:
**Every Noetherian complete local ring has a dualizing complex.** By the Cohen structure
theorem the ring is a quotient of a power series ring in finitely many variables over a field or
a Cohen ring; that power series ring is regular local, hence Gorenstein, so it is its own
dualizing complex, and a dualizing complex is carried along a finite ring map by
`Dualizing.isDualizingComplex_derivedHom_of_finite`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isDualizingComplex_of_isAdicComplete (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal A) A] :
    ∃ K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A), IsDualizingComplex K
declarations.comment: Noetherian complete local rings

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.isNormal_normalizedBlowUpScheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFT.** The normalized blowup of `X` at a closed point is a normal
scheme: it is by construction the normalization of the blowup of `X` at that point.
declarations.statement:
instance isNormal_normalizedBlowUpScheme {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    IsNormal (normalizedBlowUpScheme X hX x hx)
declarations.comment: normal

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.isNagataScheme_normalizedBlowUpScheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFT.** The normalized blowup of a Nagata scheme at a closed point is
Nagata: the blowup is Nagata because it is of finite type over `X`, and the normalization of a
Nagata scheme is finite, hence again of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNagataScheme_normalizedBlowUpScheme {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) (hNagata : IsNagataScheme X) :
    IsNagataScheme (normalizedBlowUpScheme X hX x hx)
declarations.comment: Nagata

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.isProper_normalizedBlowUp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFT.** The normalized blowup of a Nagata scheme at a closed point is
proper over it: the blowup is proper because `X` is locally Noetherian, and the normalization of
the blowup is finite because the blowup is Nagata.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_normalizedBlowUp {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) (hNagata : IsNagataScheme X) :
    IsProper (normalizedBlowUp X hX x hx)
declarations.comment: proper over the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNormal_isNagataScheme_and_isProper_normalizedBlowUp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFT.** The normalized blowup of a Nagata scheme `X` at a closed point
is a normal, Nagata scheme, and its structure morphism is proper over `X`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNormal_isNagataScheme_and_isProper_normalizedBlowUp {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) (hNagata : IsNagataScheme X) :
    IsNormal (Stacks.Blowup.normalizedBlowUpScheme X hX x hx) ∧
      IsNagataScheme (Stacks.Blowup.normalizedBlowUpScheme X hX x hx) ∧
      IsProper (Stacks.Blowup.normalizedBlowUp X hX x hx)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFU.** Base change to the spectra of the local rings defines a
functor from finitely presented modifications of `S` supported at the distinguished points to
the product of the corresponding local categories.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange
    (D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u}) : BaseChangeFunctor D

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange_full
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFV**, the fullness constituent of the equivalence. Base change from
finitely presented modifications supported at finitely many closed points to the corresponding
local modifications is full.

With `AlgebraicGeometry.finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange_faithful` this says that the
functor is fully faithful: a global modification supported at the distinguished points is
determined by its family of localizations, up to a unique isomorphism over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange_full
    (D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u}) :
    (finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange D).functor.Full
declarations.comment: full

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange_isEquivalence_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFV.** Base change from finitely presented modifications supported
at finitely many closed points to the corresponding local modifications is an equivalence of
categories.
declarations.statement:
theorem finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange_isEquivalence_unconditional
    (D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u}) :
    (finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange D).functor.IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange_faithful
declarations.doc:
The faithfulness constituent of the equivalence of [Stacks, Tag 0BFV]. Base change from
finitely presented modifications supported at finitely many closed points to the corresponding
local modifications is faithful.

The equivalence itself, which carries the tag, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange_isEquivalence`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange_faithful
    (D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u}) :
    (finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange D).functor.Faithful
declarations.comment: faithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSeparated_iff_forall_baseChangeLocal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFW (separatedness).** If `f : X ⟶ S` corresponds to
`g i : Y i ⟶ Spec 𝒪_{S, s i}` under the base-change functor of Tag 0BFU, then `f` is separated
if and only if every `g i` is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_iff_forall_baseChangeLocal
    {D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u}} (BC : BaseChangeFunctor D)
    (X : D.globalCategory) :
    IsSeparated X.obj.hom ↔ ∀ i, IsSeparated (BC.functor.obj X i).obj.hom
declarations.comment: separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isProper_iff_forall_baseChangeLocal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFW (properness).** If `f : X ⟶ S` corresponds to
`g i : Y i ⟶ Spec 𝒪_{S, s i}` under the base-change functor of Tag 0BFU, then `f` is proper if
and only if every `g i` is proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_iff_forall_baseChangeLocal
    {D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u}} (BC : BaseChangeFunctor D)
    (X : D.globalCategory) :
    IsProper X.obj.hom ↔ ∀ i, IsProper (BC.functor.obj X i).obj.hom
declarations.comment: proper

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinite_iff_forall_baseChangeLocal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFW (finiteness).** If `f : X ⟶ S` corresponds to
`g i : Y i ⟶ Spec 𝒪_{S, s i}` under the base-change functor of Tag 0BFU, then `f` is finite if
and only if every `g i` is finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinite_iff_forall_baseChangeLocal
    {D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u}} (BC : BaseChangeFunctor D)
    (X : D.globalCategory) :
    IsFinite X.obj.hom ↔ ∀ i, IsFinite (BC.functor.obj X i).obj.hom
declarations.comment: finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.baseChangeFibreIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFX.** If `f : X ⟶ S` corresponds to `g i : Y i ⟶ Spec 𝒪_{S, s i}`
under the base-change functor, then the fibre of `f` over `s i` is isomorphic to the fibre of
`g i` over the closed point, as schemes over `κ(s i)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def baseChangeFibreIso (D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u})
    (BC : BaseChangeFunctor D) (X : D.globalCategory) (i : Fin D.n) :
    (Over.pullback (D.S.fromSpecResidueField (D.points i))).obj
        ((ObjectProperty.ι (IsFinitePresentationAway D.complement)).obj X) ≅
      (Over.pullback (D.fromSpecResidueFieldLocal i)).obj
        ((ObjectProperty.ι (IsFinitePresentationAway (D.puncturedLocalScheme i))).obj
          (BC.functor.obj X i))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.factorsAsPointBlowups_of_corresponds
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFY**, necessity, in the language of Tag 0BFU. If `f : X ⟶ S` factors
as a finite sequence of blowups at closed points lying over the distinguished points, then every
local modification `g i : Y i ⟶ Spec 𝒪_{S, s i}` corresponding to it under a base-change functor
factors as a finite sequence of blowups at closed points lying over the closed point.

Sufficiency is not proved: it needs full faithfulness of the base-change functor, which is
[Stacks, Tag 0BFV] and is absent from this development.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsAsPointBlowups_of_corresponds (D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u})
    (BC : BaseChangeFunctor D) (X : D.globalCategory) (i : Fin D.n) (Y : D.localCategory i)
    (hY : BC.functor.obj X i ≅ Y)
    (h : FactorsAsPointBlowups D.S (Set.range D.points) X.obj.left X.obj.hom) :
    FactorsAsPointBlowups (D.localScheme i)
      {IsLocalRing.closedPoint (D.S.presheaf.stalk (D.points i))} Y.obj.left Y.obj.hom
declarations.comment: necessity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.factorsAsPointBlowups_iff_forall_corresponds
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFY.** Let `S` be a scheme, let `s 1, …, s n` be pairwise distinct
closed points whose open complement has quasi-compact inclusion, and let `f : X ⟶ S` correspond
to `g i : Y i ⟶ Spec 𝒪_{S, s i}` under the base-change functor `F` of [Stacks, Tag 0BFU]. Then
`f` admits a factorization `X = Z m ⟶ … ⟶ Z 0 = S` in which every step is the blowing up of its
target at a closed point lying over the *set* `{s 1, …, s n}` if and only if, for every `i`, the
morphism `g i` admits a factorization `Y i = Z i (m i) ⟶ … ⟶ Z i 0 = Spec 𝒪_{S, s i}` in which
every step is the blowing up of its target at a closed point lying over the closed point, which
is `s i` itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsAsPointBlowups_iff_forall_corresponds
    (D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u}) (X : D.globalCategory)
    (Y : ∀ i, D.localCategory i)
    (hY : ∀ i, (finitePresentationAwayPointsBaseChange D).functor.obj X i ≅ Y i) :
    FactorsAsPointBlowups D.S (Set.range D.points) X.obj.left X.obj.hom ↔
      ∀ i, FactorsAsPointBlowups (D.localScheme i)
        {IsLocalRing.closedPoint (D.S.presheaf.stalk (D.points i))} (Y i).obj.left
        (Y i).obj.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.factorsAsPointBlowups_iff_forall
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFY.** Let `S` be a scheme with pairwise distinct closed points
`s 0, …, s (n - 1)` whose open complement has quasi-compact inclusion, and let `f : X ⟶ S`, of
finite presentation and an isomorphism over that complement, correspond under a base-change
functor of Tag 0BFU to the local modifications `g i : Y i ⟶ Spec 𝒪_{S, s i}`. Then `f` factors as
a finite sequence of blowups at closed points lying over the `s i` if and only if every `g i`
factors as a finite sequence of blowups at closed points lying over the closed point of
`Spec 𝒪_{S, s i}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsAsPointBlowups_iff_forall (BC : BaseChangeFunctor D) (X : D.globalCategory)
    (Y : ∀ i, D.localCategory i) (hY : BC.functor.obj X ≅ Y) :
    FactorsAsPointBlowups D.S (Set.range D.points) X.obj.left X.obj.hom ↔
      ∀ i, FactorsAsPointBlowups (D.localScheme i)
        {IsLocalRing.closedPoint (D.S.presheaf.stalk (D.points i))} (Y i).obj.left
        (Y i).obj.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.factorsAsNormalizedPointBlowups_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFZ**, for a normal base. Let `S, s i, S_i` be as in Tag 0BFU, with
`S` normal and every quasi-compact open of `S` having finitely many irreducible components, and
let `f : X ⟶ S` correspond to the `g i : Y i ⟶ S_i` under the base-change functor. Then `f` is a
finite sequence of normalized blowups at closed points lying over the distinguished points if and
only if, for each `i`, `g i` is a finite sequence of normalized blowups at closed points lying
over the closed point of `S_i`.

Normality is necessary: `AlgebraicGeometry.not_factorsAsNormalizedPointBlowups_iff` exhibits a
scheme satisfying the remaining hypotheses for which the equivalence fails.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsAsNormalizedPointBlowups_iff [IsNormal D.S]
    (hS : ∀ U : D.S.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set D.S) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (BC : BaseChangeFunctor D) (X : D.globalCategory) (Y : ∀ i, D.localCategory i)
    (hY : ∀ i, BC.functor.obj X i ≅ Y i) :
    FactorsAsNormalizedPointBlowups D.S (Set.range D.points) X.obj.left X.obj.hom ↔
      ∀ i, FactorsAsNormalizedPointBlowups (D.localScheme i)
        {IsLocalRing.closedPoint (D.S.presheaf.stalk (D.points i))} (Y i).obj.left
        (Y i).obj.hom
declarations.comment: corrected: S normal added, the statement being false without it; both directions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.factorsAsNormalizedPointBlowups_of_corresponds
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BFZ**, necessity, for a normal base, in the language of Tag 0BFU. If
`f : X ⟶ S` factors as a finite sequence of normalized blowups at closed points lying over the
distinguished points, then every local modification `g i : Y i ⟶ Spec 𝒪_{S, s i}` corresponding
to it under a base-change functor factors as a finite sequence of normalized blowups at closed
points lying over the closed point.

Both directions are
`AlgebraicGeometry.FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.factorsAsNormalizedPointBlowups_iff`.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsAsNormalizedPointBlowups_of_corresponds
    (D : FinitePresentationAwayPointsSituation.{u}) [IsNormal D.S] (BC : BaseChangeFunctor D)
    (X : D.globalCategory) (i : Fin D.n) (Y : D.localCategory i)
    (hY : BC.functor.obj X i ≅ Y)
    (h : FactorsAsNormalizedPointBlowups D.S (Set.range D.points) X.obj.left X.obj.hom) :
    FactorsAsNormalizedPointBlowups (D.localScheme i)
      {IsLocalRing.closedPoint (D.S.presheaf.stalk (D.points i))} Y.obj.left Y.obj.hom
declarations.comment: necessity only; corrected: S normal added, the statement being false without it

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.definesRationalSingularity_of_essFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BG0.** Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a two-dimensional local normal Nagata domain
defining a rational singularity, and let `A ⟶ B` be a local extension of normal local domains
with the same fraction field `K`, essentially of finite type, with `dim B = 2`. Then `B` defines
a rational singularity.
declarations.statement:
theorem definesRationalSingularity_of_essFiniteType (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsNormalDomain A] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNormalDomain B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)] (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [Algebra B K]
    [IsScalarTower A B K] [IsFractionRing A K] [IsFractionRing B K] (hN : IsNagataRing A)
    (hA : ringKrullDim A = 2) (hB : ringKrullDim B = 2) (hft : Algebra.EssFiniteType A B)
    (hrat : DefinesRationalSingularity A) : DefinesRationalSingularity B
declarations.comment: a local extension A ⊂ B of domains with the same fraction field, essentially of finite type, A a 2-dimensional local normal Nagata domain defining a rational singularity, B normal of dimension 2: B defines a rational singularity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_nonsingularFormalArc_of_pointBlowupSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BG2.** An infinite point-blowup sequence whose
exceptional divisors are locally defined by the transforms of one initial
function is induced by a nonsingular formal arc.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_nonsingularFormalArc_of_pointBlowupSequence
    (s : PointBlowupSequence.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian (s.scheme 0)]
    (x : (s.scheme 0).presheaf.stalk (s.point 0))
    (hx : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((s.scheme 0).presheaf.stalk (s.point 0)))
    (hExceptional : ∀ n, s.exceptionalIdealAt n =
      Ideal.span {s.stalkImage (n + 1) x}) :
    ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (hDomain : IsDomain R),
      letI : IsDomain R := hDomain
      ∃ (hDVR : IsDiscreteValuationRing R),
        letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing R := hDVR
        ∃ (_hComplete : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R)
          (a : Spec R ⟶ s.scheme 0)
          (hCenter : a (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) = s.point 0),
          IsIso (a.residueFieldMap (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)) ∧
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R =
            Ideal.span {(Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo a).hom (hCenter.symm ▸ x)} ∧
          ∃ lifts : (n : ℕ) → Spec R ⟶ s.scheme n,
            lifts 0 = a ∧
            (∀ n, lifts (n + 1) ≫ s.stepMap n = lifts n) ∧
            (∀ n, lifts n (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) = s.point n)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_regular_center
declarations.doc:
A sequence of blowups along a formal arc whose generic image is regular eventually
reaches a regular center.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_regular_center
    {A R : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (hA : ringKrullDim A = 2) (f : A →+* R) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (hgeneric : IsRegularLocalRing ((Spec (.of A)).presheaf.stalk
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f) (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))))))
    (s : ArcBlowupSequence A R f) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, IsRegularLocalRing ((s.scheme i).presheaf.stalk
      (s.arc i (closedPoint R)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkMap_adicCompletion_isomorphism
declarations.doc:
After base change from a local ring to its completion, the map on local rings at a point
over the closed point induces an isomorphism on completions.
declarations.statement:
theorem stalkMap_adicCompletion_isomorphism
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hfg : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) :
    let Ahat := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let g : Spec (.of Ahat) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A Ahat))
    let Y : Scheme.{u} := pullback f g
    let π : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
    ∀ (q : Y),
      f.base (π.base q) =
          (⟨IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) →
        ∃ e : AdicCompletion
              (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (π.base q)))
              (X.presheaf.stalk (π.base q)) ≃+*
            AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk q))
              (Y.presheaf.stalk q),
          e.toRingHom.comp
              (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (π.base q))
                (AdicCompletion
                  (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (π.base q)))
                  (X.presheaf.stalk (π.base q)))) =
            (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk q)
              (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk q))
                (Y.presheaf.stalk q))).comp (π.stalkMap q).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_completion
declarations.doc:
Regularity of a local ring of a scheme descends pointwise from its base change to the
completion of a Noetherian local base ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_completion
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (x : X)
    (y : (pullback f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R)))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hy : (pullback.fst f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R))))).base y = x)
    (hregular : IsRegularLocalRing
      ((pullback f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R)))) :
          Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk y)) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)
declarations.comment: pointwise_descent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegularLocalRing_stalk_pullback_completion_iff
declarations.doc:
At a point of the closed fibre, regularity of the local ring is invariant under base change
from a Noetherian local ring to its completion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_stalk_pullback_completion_iff
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (x : X)
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hx : (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))))).base y = x)
    (hy : (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))))).base y =
      (⟨IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A), inferInstance⟩ :
        PrimeSpectrum (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))) :
    IsRegularLocalRing
        ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)))) :
          Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk y) ↔
      IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)
declarations.comment: closed_fibre_equivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegular_pullback_completion_iff
declarations.doc:
A proper scheme locally of finite type over a Noetherian local ring is regular if and only
if its base change to the completion of the base ring is regular.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRegular_pullback_completion_iff
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f] :
    IsRegular X ↔
      IsRegular
        (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)))) : Scheme.{u})
declarations.comment: proper_equivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.definesRationalSingularity_adicCompletion_and_isNormalDomain_stalk_blowUp
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a Nagata local normal domain of dimension two which defines a rational
singularity and whose completion `A^` is normal. Then

1. `A^` defines a rational singularity, and
2. if `X ⟶ Spec(A)` is the blowup in `𝔪`, then for a closed point `x ∈ X` the completion of
   `𝒪_{X, x}` is normal (indeed a normal domain).
declarations.statement:
theorem definesRationalSingularity_adicCompletion_and_isNormalDomain_stalk_blowUp
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNormalDomain A] (hNagata : IsNagataRing A)
    [IsNormalDomain (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2) (hrat : DefinesRationalSingularity A) :
    DefinesRationalSingularity (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) ∧
      ∀ x : blowUp (maximalIdealSheaf A), IsClosed ({x} : Set (blowUp (maximalIdealSheaf A))) →
        IsNormalDomain (AdicCompletion
          (maximalIdeal ((blowUp (maximalIdealSheaf A)).presheaf.stalk x))
          ((blowUp (maximalIdealSheaf A)).presheaf.stalk x))
declarations.comment: both clauses: the completion A^ defines a rational singularity, and at every closed point of the blowup of Spec(A) in the maximal ideal the completed local ring is a normal domain

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.normalization_isFinite_of_etaleAt_genericPoints
declarations.doc:
If a scheme is locally of finite type over an analytically
unramified Noetherian local ring and is étale over it at the generic points of its irreducible
components, then its normalization morphism is finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem normalization_isFinite_of_etaleAt_genericPoints (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (hA : IsAnalyticallyUnramified A)
    (hf : ∀ x : X, x ∈ genericPoints X → EtaleAt f x) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
    let hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) →
        (irreducibleComponents U).Finite := fun U hU ↦ by
      let : CompactSpace U := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hU
      let : NoetherianSpace U :=
        noetherianSpace_of_isLocallyNoetherianSpace U
          ((isLocallyNoetherianSpace_of_isLocallyNoetherian X).subtype U)
      exact NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents
    IsFinite (normalization X hX)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SemistableReduction.isFinite_normalization_of_isNormal_complementSpecialFiber_completion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BG9 (finiteness).** If the complement of the special fibre after
completion is normal, then the normalization is finite.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFinite_normalization_of_isNormal_complementSpecialFiber_completion
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hnormal :
      let Ahat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
      let i : Spec (.of Ahat) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A Ahat))
      let Y : Scheme.{u} := pullback f i
      let q : Y ⟶ Spec (.of Ahat) := pullback.snd f i
      IsNormal (complementSpecialFiber q)) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
    let hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) →
        (irreducibleComponents U).Finite := fun U hU ↦ by
      have : CompactSpace U := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hU
      have : NoetherianSpace U :=
        noetherianSpace_of_isLocallyNoetherianSpace U
          ((isLocallyNoetherianSpace_of_isLocallyNoetherian X).subtype U)
      exact NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents
    IsFinite (Scheme.normalization X hX)
declarations.comment: finiteness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SemistableReduction.exists_iso_pullback_normalization_completion_of_isNormal_complementSpecialFiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BG9 (compatibility with completion).** If the complement of the
special fibre after completion is normal, base change to the completion carries the
normalization of `X` to the normalization of the completed base change, compatibly with the
maps to that base change.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_iso_pullback_normalization_completion_of_isNormal_complementSpecialFiber
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hnormal :
      let Ahat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
      let i : Spec (.of Ahat) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A Ahat))
      let Y : Scheme.{u} := pullback f i
      let q : Y ⟶ Spec (.of Ahat) := pullback.snd f i
      IsNormal (complementSpecialFiber q)) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
    let Ahat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
    let i : Spec (.of Ahat) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A Ahat))
    let Y : Scheme.{u} := pullback f i
    let p : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f i
    let hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) →
        (irreducibleComponents U).Finite := fun U hU ↦ by
      have : CompactSpace U := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hU
      have : NoetherianSpace U :=
        noetherianSpace_of_isLocallyNoetherianSpace U
          ((isLocallyNoetherianSpace_of_isLocallyNoetherian X).subtype U)
      exact NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents
    let νX := Scheme.normalization X hX
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := inferInstance
    let hY : ∀ V : Y.Opens, IsCompact (V : Set Y) →
        (irreducibleComponents V).Finite := fun V hV ↦ by
      have : CompactSpace V := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hV
      have : NoetherianSpace V :=
        noetherianSpace_of_isLocallyNoetherianSpace V
          ((isLocallyNoetherianSpace_of_isLocallyNoetherian Y).subtype V)
      exact NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents
    let νY := Scheme.normalization Y hY
    ∃ e : pullback νX p ≅ Scheme.normalizationScheme Y hY,
      e.hom ≫ νY = pullback.snd νX p
declarations.comment: compatibility with completion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_normalizedBlowUpTowerDescent_of_adicCompletion_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BGA.** Let `A` be a Noetherian local domain whose completion `A^` is
normal. Given any sequence of normalized blowups `T : Yₙ → ⋯ → Y₁ → Spec A^` (its stages and the
closed points blown up, as data), there is a sequence of normalized blowups
`Xₙ → ⋯ → X₁ → Spec A`, proper over `Spec A`, whose base change to `A^` recovers `T` stage by
stage: at every step the normalized blowup of `Yᵢ` at the closed point `yᵢ` recorded in `T` is the
base change, along the comparison `Yᵢ ⟶ Xᵢ`, of the normalized blowup of `Xᵢ` at the image of
`yᵢ`, a cartesian square.

That `A^` is a Nagata ring is not a hypothesis here: `A^` is Noetherian, local, and complete for
its own maximal ideal, so [Stacks, Tag 032W] applies to it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_normalizedBlowUpTowerDescent_of_adicCompletion_unconditional
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hnormal : IsNormalRing (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A))
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A))}
    (T : NormalizedBlowUpTower (Spec (.of (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A))) Y g) :
    ∃ (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (p : Y ⟶ X),
      NormalizedBlowUpTowerDescent A T X f p ∧ IsProper f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RationalDoublePointSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BGC.** A Nagata local normal domain of dimension two which defines a
rational singularity, whose completion is normal, which is Gorenstein, and which is not
regular.
declarations.statement: structure RationalDoublePointSituation

declarations.name: MvPolynomial.eq_smul_sq_affineLinear_of_mem_ideal_sq
declarations.doc:
A nonzero quadratic polynomial in the square of an ideal `I ⊆ κ[x, y]`, where `I`
has colength greater than one, is a scalar multiple of the square of an affine linear
polynomial.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_smul_sq_affineLinear_of_mem_ideal_sq
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (a b c d e f : k)
    (hnonzero : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0 ∨ c ≠ 0 ∨ d ≠ 0 ∨ e ≠ 0 ∨ f ≠ 0)
    (hmem : C a + C b * X 0 + C c * X 1 + C d * X 0 ^ 2 +
      C e * X 0 * X 1 + C f * X 1 ^ 2 ∈ I ^ 2)
    (hcolength : 1 < Module.rank k (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ I)) :
    ∃ j g h i : k,
      C a + C b * X 0 + C c * X 1 + C d * X 0 ^ 2 +
          C e * X 0 * X 1 + C f * X 1 ^ 2 =
        C j * (C g + C h * X 0 + C i * X 1) ^ 2

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_singularPointBlowupChain_isRegular_of_definesRationalSingularity
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a local normal Nagata domain of dimension two which defines a rational
singularity, whose completion is normal, and which is Gorenstein. Then there exists a finite
sequence of blowups in singular closed points `Xₙ → Xₙ₋₁ → ⋯ → X₁ → X₀ = Spec(A)` such that `Xₙ`
is regular and such that each scheme `Xᵢ` of the sequence is normal with finitely many singular
points of the same type: the local ring at each singular point is again the ring of a Situation
[Stacks, Tag 0BGC].
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_singularPointBlowupChain_isRegular_of_definesRationalSingularity
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNormalDomain A] (hnagata : IsNagataRing A)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2) (hrational : DefinesRationalSingularity A)
    (hcompletion : IsNormalDomain (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A))
    (hgorenstein : letI : IsNoetherianRing A := hnagata.isNoetherianRing
      Dualizing.IsGorensteinLocalRing A) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)),
      SingularPointBlowupChain (fun W => IsNormal W ∧ (singularLocus W).Finite ∧
          ∀ w ∈ singularLocus W, ∃ S : RationalDoublePointSituation.{u},
            Nonempty (S.A ≃+* W.presheaf.stalk w))
        (Spec (.of A)) Y f ∧ IsRegular Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_dense_open_isRegular
declarations.doc:
An integral locally Noetherian scheme admitting an alteration by a regular scheme has a
dense regular open subscheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_dense_open_isRegular
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [IsIntegral Y]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsAlteration f)
    (hX : IsRegular X) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, Dense (V : Set Y) ∧ IsRegular V
declarations.comment: dense_regular_open

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.normalization_isFinite_of_regular_alteration
declarations.doc:
**The normalization of an integral locally Noetherian scheme admitting an alteration by a
regular scheme is finite.** This is the first assertion of [Stacks, Tag 0BGG]. The one input of
the source's argument beyond this module is the degree-zero case of [Stacks, Tag 02O6] for the
structure sheaf, which enters once as `AlgebraicGeometry.finiteGlobalSectionsOfProper`; the
statement is therefore unconditional.

The source assumes `Y` Noetherian, i.e. locally Noetherian and quasi-compact. Quasi-compactness
is not used: finiteness is Zariski-local on the target, and the argument runs over one affine
open at a time.
declarations.statement:
theorem normalization_isFinite_of_regular_alteration
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsAlteration f) (hX : IsRegular X) :
    let hY : ∀ U : Y.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set Y) →
        (irreducibleComponents U).Finite := fun U hU ↦ by
      let : CompactSpace U := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hU
      let : NoetherianSpace U :=
        noetherianSpace_of_isLocallyNoetherianSpace U
          (IsLocallyNoetherianSpace.subtype
            (isLocallyNoetherianSpace_of_isLocallyNoetherian Y) U)
      exact NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents
    IsFinite (Scheme.normalization Y hY)
declarations.comment: finiteness of the normalization

declarations.name: isNormalRing_adicCompletion_of_finite_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BGH.** Let `A` be a Noetherian local ring and `B ⊆ C` finite
`A`-algebras. If `B` and the `m_A`-adic completion of `C` are normal, then the `m_A`-adic
completion of `B` is normal.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNormalRing_adicCompletion_of_finite_injective
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C] [Algebra B C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
    [Module.Finite A B] [Module.Finite A C]
    (hBC : Function.Injective (algebraMap B C))
    (hB : IsNormalRing B)
    (hC : IsNormalRing (AdicCompletion ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A C)) C)) :
    IsNormalRing (AdicCompletion ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A B)) B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isRegularRing_localizationAway_of_regular_alteration
declarations.doc:
**A Noetherian local domain admitting an alteration by a regular scheme is regular after
inverting one nonzero element.** This is part (1) of [Stacks, Tag 0BGI]: the dense regular open
of [Stacks, Tag 0BGG] contains a nonempty basic open `D(a)` of `Spec A`, and `Γ(D(a)) = A_a`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isRegularRing_localizationAway_of_regular_alteration
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (hf : IsAlteration f) (hX : IsRegular X) :
    ∃ a : A, a ≠ 0 ∧ IsRegularRing (Localization.Away a)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.module_finite_integralClosure_of_regular_alteration
declarations.doc:
**The integral closure of a Noetherian local domain admitting an alteration by a regular
scheme is a finite module over it.** This is part (2) of [Stacks, Tag 0BGI]: the global sections
`C` of the regular alteration are a finite `A`-module — by the degree-zero case of
[Stacks, Tag 02O6], `AlgebraicGeometry.finiteGlobalSectionsOfProper` — and an integrally closed
domain containing `A`, so the integral closure of `A` in `Frac(A)` embeds into `C` and is a
submodule of a finite module over the Noetherian ring `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem module_finite_integralClosure_of_regular_alteration
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (hf : IsAlteration f) (hX : IsRegular X) :
    Module.Finite A ↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNormalRing_adicCompletion_integralClosure_of_regular_alteration
declarations.doc:
**The completion of the integral closure is normal.** This is part (3) of
[Stacks, Tag 0BGI]. With `C = Γ(X, 𝒪_X)` and `B` the integral closure of `A` in `Frac(A)`, the
inclusion `B ⊆ C` is a map of finite `A`-algebras, `B` is a normal domain, and the completion of
`C` is normal because the base change of `X` to `Spec Aˆ` stays regular ([Stacks, Tag 0BG6]) and
its global sections are `Aˆ ⊗_A C` ([Stacks, Tag 02KH]); [Stacks, Tag 0BGH] then gives normality
of `Bˆ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNormalRing_adicCompletion_integralClosure_of_regular_alteration
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (hf : IsAlteration f) (hX : IsRegular X) :
    IsNormalRing
      (AdicCompletion
        ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map
          (algebraMap A ↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A))))
        ↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A)))
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isRegularRing_genericFormalFibre_of_regular_alteration
declarations.doc:
**The generic formal fibre of a Noetherian local domain admitting an alteration by a regular
scheme is regular.** This is part (4) of [Stacks, Tag 0BGI]. Taking an affine open `U ⊆ X` around
the generic point and `R = Γ(X, U)`, the scheme `Spec (R ⊗_A Aˆ)` is an open subscheme of the
regular `X ×_{Spec A} Spec Aˆ` ([Stacks, Tag 0BG6]), so `Aˆ ⊗_A R` is regular; the generic formal
fibre is recovered by inverting `A ∖ {0}` and descending along the faithfully flat
`Frac(A)`-algebra `Frac(A) ⊗_A R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRegularRing_genericFormalFibre_of_regular_alteration
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (hf : IsAlteration f) (hX : IsRegular X) :
    IsRegularRing ((AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A) ⊗[A] (FractionRing A))
declarations.comment: part (4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsResolution
declarations.doc:
A morphism to a Noetherian integral scheme is a **resolution of singularities** if it is a
modification and its source is regular.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsResolution {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.HasResolutionByNormalizedBlowUps
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BGL.** A scheme admits a *resolution of singularities by normalized
blowups* if its normalization can be followed by finitely many normalized blowups at closed
points, all proper over the scheme, so as to obtain a regular scheme.
declarations.statement: abbrev HasResolutionByNormalizedBlowUps (Y : Scheme.{u}) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasResolutionByNormalizedBlowUps_of_exists_isResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BGM.** Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a Noetherian local ring which is normal of
dimension two. If `Spec(A)` has a resolution of singularities, then `Spec(A)` has a resolution by
normalized blowups.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasResolutionByNormalizedBlowUps_of_exists_isResolution
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNormalDomain A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2)
    (hres : ∃ (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)), IsResolution f) :
    HasResolutionByNormalizedBlowUps (Spec (.of A))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isResolution_of_isAdicComplete
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BGN.** Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a Noetherian complete local ring which is a
normal domain of dimension two. Then `Spec(A)` has a resolution of singularities.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isResolution_of_isAdicComplete
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal A) A] [IsNormalDomain A] (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2) :
    ∃ (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)), IsResolution f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.tfae_exists_isAlteration_isRegular
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_exists_isAlteration_isRegular (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Y] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim Y = 2) :
    List.TFAE
      [∃ (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y), IsAlteration f ∧ IsRegular X,
       ∃ (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y), IsResolution f,
       HasResolutionByNormalizedBlowUps Y,
       ∃ hY : ∀ U : Y.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set Y) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite,
        IsFinite (Scheme.normalization Y hY) ∧
        (singularLocus (Y.normalizationScheme hY)).Finite ∧
        ∀ y : Y.normalizationScheme hY, y ∈ singularLocus (Y.normalizationScheme hY) →
          IsNormalRing (AdicCompletion
            (maximalIdeal ((Y.normalizationScheme hY).presheaf.stalk y))
            ((Y.normalizationScheme hY).presheaf.stalk y))]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAlgebraicSpace_of_surjective_etale_atlas
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGQ.** A sheaf `F` on the big fppf site over `S` admitting a representable,
surjective, étale morphism `f : h_U ⟶ F` from an object `U` of the site is an algebraic space
over `S`.

The kernel pair `R = U ×_F U` of `f` is an object of the site with étale projections forming an
étale equivalence relation, so the quotient sheaf `U/R` is an algebraic space by Stacks 02WW;
both `F` and `U/R` are the coequalizer of the two projections in fppf sheaves of sets, hence
isomorphic.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_of_surjective_etale_atlas
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) F)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ F)
    (hsurj : MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)) f)
    (hetale : MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)) f) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAlgebraicSpace_of_relativelyRepresentable_surjective_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGR.** A sheaf `F` on the big fppf site over `S` admitting a representable,
surjective, étale morphism `a : G ⟶ F` from an algebraic space `G` over `S` is an algebraic space
over `S`.

A surjective étale atlas `h_U ⟶ G` of `G` by an object of the site is representable because `G`
has representable diagonal, and composing it with `a` gives an atlas of the same kind for `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_of_relativelyRepresentable_surjective_etale
    {G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) F) (a : G ⟶ F)
    (hs : MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)) a)
    (he : MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)) a) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpaceULift_of_relative_surjective_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGR** for presheaves with values in a universe `max w u` independent of the
universe `u` of the schemes. A sheaf `F` on the big fppf site of `S` admitting a morphism
`a : G ⟶ F` from an algebraic space `G` over `S` which is representable by objects of the site,
surjective and étale is an algebraic space over `S`.

Both presheaves are pointwise `u`-small — the source because it is an algebraic space, the
target because its sections lift along `a` after a surjective étale base change — so they are
universe lifts of presheaves of `Type u` and the statement is the one in the value universe of
the site transported along the lift.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpaceULift_of_relative_surjective_etale
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max w u)}
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) F)
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpaceULift.{w} B S hS G) (a : G ⟶ F)
    (hs : (surjectiveOnSite B S hS).relative (uliftYoneda.{w}) a)
    (he : (etaleOnSite B S hS).relative (uliftYoneda.{w}) a) :
    IsAlgebraicSpaceULift.{w} B S hS F
declarations.comment: in an arbitrary value universe

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReduced_globalFunctions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGS.** The ring of global regular functions of a reduced algebraic space is
reduced.  Restriction to a reduced surjective étale chart embeds it into the ring of global
regular functions of a reduced scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReduced_globalFunctions (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (hred : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS F
      (fun X : Scheme.{u} => _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced X)) :
    _root_.IsReduced (globalFunctions B S hS F)
declarations.comment: global_sections_reduced

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_zero_of_forall_zeroLocus_eq_univ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGS.** A global regular function on a reduced algebraic space whose vanishing
locus is all of `F` — its zero locus on every étale chart is the whole chart — is zero.  It
vanishes on a reduced surjective étale chart, hence is zero there by
`AlgebraicGeometry.eq_zero_of_basicOpen_eq_bot`, and restriction to that chart is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_zeroLocus_eq_univ (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (hred : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS F
      (fun X : Scheme.{u} => _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced X))
    (f : globalFunctions B S hS F)
    (hf : ∀ U : SmallEtale B S hS F,
      ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj ((SmallEtale.toOver B S hS F).obj U)).zeroLocus
        {f.val (op U)} = Set.univ) :
    f = 0
declarations.comment: zero_of_full_vanishing_locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReduced_iff_forall_localRing_isReduced
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGS.** An algebraic space is reduced exactly when all of its local rings are
reduced. Reducedness of the space is the étale-local scheme property of Stacks 03E6 — a
reduced surjective étale scheme chart — and reducedness of its local ring at a point is the
chart condition of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasLocalRingPropertyAtPoint`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReduced_iff_forall_localRing_isReduced (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) :
    HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS F (fun X : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced X) ↔
      ∀ x : points B S hS F,
        HasLocalRingPropertyAtPoint B S hS F hF x
          (fun (R : Type u) => fun [CommRing R] => _root_.IsReduced R)
          isReduced_localization_etale_invariant
declarations.comment: reduced_iff_local_rings_reduced

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isNormal_of_isRegular
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGT.** A regular algebraic space is normal: a surjective étale atlas by a
regular scheme is one by a normal scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNormal_of_isRegular (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hreg : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS F (fun X : Scheme.{u} => IsRegular X)) :
    HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS F
      (fun X : Scheme.{u} => _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsNormal X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGU, elementary étale neighborhoods.** A scheme étale over an
algebraic space, pointed above `x`, for which the residue-field point is a
monomorphism into the space.
declarations.statement:
structure ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (x : points B S hS F)
declarations.comment: elementary étale neighborhoods

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood.Hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGU, morphisms.** A map of elementary étale neighborhoods is
a map over the algebraic space carrying the chosen point to the chosen point.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (V W : ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS F hF x)
declarations.comment: morphisms of elementary étale neighborhoods

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood.exists_affine_cone_objs
declarations.doc:
Any two elementary étale neighborhoods of a point of an algebraic space are refined by a
common elementary étale neighborhood whose scheme is affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affine_cone_objs (U V : ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X hX x) :
    ∃ (W : ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X hX x) (_ : W ⟶ U) (_ : W ⟶ V),
      IsAffine W.scheme.left.1
declarations.comment: two neighbourhoods are refined by a common one whose scheme is affine

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood.exists_cone_objs
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGV, common refinements.** Two elementary étale neighborhoods of `x` admit a
common refinement.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_cone_objs (V W : ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X hX x) :
    ∃ (E : ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X hX x) (_ : E ⟶ V) (_ : E ⟶ W), True
declarations.comment: common refinements: any two elementary étale neighbourhoods admit a third mapping to both

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood.exists_cone_maps
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGV, equalizing refinements.** Two morphisms of elementary étale neighborhoods of
`x` are equalized by a refinement of their source.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_cone_maps {V W : ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X hX x} (f g : V ⟶ W) :
    ∃ (E : ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X hX x) (h : E ⟶ V), h ≫ f = h ≫ g
declarations.comment: equalizing refinements: any two parallel morphisms are equalized by a refinement

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood.isCofilteredOrEmpty
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGV.** The category of elementary étale neighborhoods of a point of an algebraic
space is cofiltered as soon as it is nonempty: any two neighborhoods are refined by a third,
and any two parallel morphisms are equalized by a refinement.
declarations.statement: instance isCofilteredOrEmpty : IsCofilteredOrEmpty (ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X hX x)
declarations.comment: the category is cofiltered or empty; unconditional

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCofiltered_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood
declarations.doc:
The category of elementary étale neighborhoods of a point of a decent algebraic space is
cofiltered.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCofiltered_elementaryEtaleNeighborhood :
    IsCofiltered (ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X hX x)
declarations.comment: the category of elementary étale neighbourhoods of a point of a decent space is cofiltered; nonemptiness by Tag 0BBP

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.henselianLocalRing
declarations.doc:
The henselian local ring of a decent algebraic space at a point: the
colimit of the rings of global sections over the elementary étale neighborhoods of the
point.
declarations.statement: abbrev henselianLocalRing (_hDecent : IsDecentSpace B S hS X) : CommRingCat.{u + 1}
declarations.comment: the henselian local ring at a point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionHom
declarations.doc:
The canonical ring homomorphism from the global sections of an
elementary étale neighborhood into the henselian local ring.
declarations.comment: canonical section homomorphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionHom_naturality
declarations.doc:
Restricting a section to a finer elementary étale neighborhood does not
change its canonical image in the henselian local ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem sectionHom_naturality (hDecent : IsDecentSpace B S hS X)
    {U V : (ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X hX x)ᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V)
    (s : (globalSections B S hS X hX x).obj U) :
    sectionHom B S hS X hX x hDecent V ((globalSections B S hS X hX x).map f s) =
      sectionHom B S hS X hX x hDecent U s
declarations.comment: naturality of section homomorphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_lift
declarations.doc:
A family of ring homomorphisms out of the global sections of the
elementary étale neighborhoods of a point, compatible with restriction, factors uniquely
through the henselian local ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_lift (hDecent : IsDecentSpace B S hS X) (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
    (φ : ∀ U : (ElementaryEtaleNeighborhood B S hS X hX x)ᵒᵖ,
      (globalSections B S hS X hX x).obj U →+* R)
    (hφ : ∀ {U V} (f : U ⟶ V) (s : (globalSections B S hS X hX x).obj U),
      φ V ((globalSections B S hS X hX x).map f s) = φ U s) :
    ∃! ψ : henselianLocalRing B S hS X hX x hDecent →+* R,
      ∀ U s, ψ (sectionHom B S hS X hX x hDecent U s) = φ U s
declarations.comment: colimit universal property

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.essSurj_baseChangeFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGY, essential surjectivity of the base-change functor.** Let `f : V ⟶ W` be a
separated étale morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let `T` be a closed subspace of `W`
whose preimage is carried isomorphically onto `T`. Then every modification of `V` outside
`f⁻¹W⁰` is isomorphic to the base change of a modification of `W` outside `W⁰`, namely of the
dependent product `Π_f Y`, the isomorphism being the counit.
declarations.statement:
theorem essSurj_baseChangeFunctor (f : V ⟶ W) (T : Subfunctor W.obj)
    (hT : IsClosedSubspace B S hS T) (hfT : IsIso (T.fromPreimage f.hom))
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom) :
    (baseChangeFunctor B S hS f (openComplement B S hS T)).1.EssSurj
declarations.comment: the base-change functor is essentially surjective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEquivalence_baseChangeFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGY.** Let `f : V ⟶ W` be a separated étale morphism of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and let `T ⊂ W` be a closed subspace such that `f⁻¹T → T` is an isomorphism. Write
`W⁰` for the complement of `T` and `V⁰ = f⁻¹W⁰`. Then base change along `f` is an equivalence
from the category of morphisms `g : X ⟶ W` of algebraic spaces with `g⁻¹W⁰ → W⁰` an
isomorphism to the category of morphisms `h : Y ⟶ V` of algebraic spaces with `h⁻¹V⁰ → V⁰` an
isomorphism.

Faithfulness is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.faithful_baseChangeFunctor`, fullness is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.full_baseChangeFunctor` and essential surjectivity is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.essSurj_baseChangeFunctor`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_baseChangeFunctor (f : V ⟶ W) (T : Subfunctor W.obj)
    (hT : IsClosedSubspace B S hS T) (hfT : IsIso (T.fromPreimage f.hom))
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom) :
    (baseChangeFunctor B S hS f (openComplement B S hS T)).1.IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: equivalence of categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.faithful_baseChangeFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGY, faithfulness of the base-change functor.** Let `f : V ⟶ W` be an étale
morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let `T` be a closed subspace of `W` whose preimage
is carried isomorphically onto `T`. Then the functor of Stacks 0BGY, base change along `f`
from the modifications of `W` outside the open complement `W⁰` of `T` to the modifications of
`V` outside `f⁻¹W⁰`, is faithful.

Two morphisms of modifications which agree after base change agree on `X ×_W V`, and they
agree over `W⁰` because the target is an isomorphism there; those two parts cover the source
locally, which is a sheaf, so the morphisms are equal.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_baseChangeFunctor (f : V ⟶ W) (T : Subfunctor W.obj)
    (hT : IsClosedSubspace B S hS T) (hfT : IsIso (T.fromPreimage f.hom))
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) :
    (baseChangeFunctor B S hS f (openComplement B S hS T)).1.Faithful
declarations.comment: the base-change functor is faithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.full_baseChangeFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGY, fullness of the base-change functor.** Let `f : V ⟶ W` be a separated étale
morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let `T` be a closed subspace of `W` whose preimage is
carried isomorphically onto `T`. Then the functor of Stacks 0BGY, base change along `f` from the
modifications of `W` outside the open complement `W⁰` of `T` to the modifications of `V` outside
`f⁻¹W⁰`, is full.
declarations.statement:
theorem full_baseChangeFunctor (f : V ⟶ W') (T : Subfunctor W'.obj)
    (hT : IsClosedSubspace B S hS T) (hfT : IsIso (T.fromPreimage f.hom))
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom) :
    (baseChangeFunctor B S hS f (openComplement B S hS T)).1.Full
declarations.comment: the base-change functor is full

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fullyFaithful_baseChangeFunctor
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0BGY, full faithfulness of the base-change functor.**
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def fullyFaithful_baseChangeFunctor (f : V ⟶ W') (T : Subfunctor W'.obj)
    (hT : IsClosedSubspace B S hS T) (hfT : IsIso (T.fromPreimage f.hom))
    (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom) (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom) :
    (baseChangeFunctor B S hS f (openComplement B S hS T)).1.FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: the base-change functor is fully faithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.baseChangeFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BGY.** Pullback of modifications, canonically identified with pullback of
their underlying presheaves over the base.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def baseChangeFunctor {V W : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : V ⟶ W) (W₀ : Subfunctor W.obj) :
    Σ F : Modification B S hS W₀ ⥤ Modification B S hS (W₀.preimage f.hom),
      F ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IsModification B S hS (W₀.preimage f.hom)) ≅
        ObjectProperty.ι (IsModification B S hS W₀) ⋙ Over.pullback f.hom
declarations.comment: the base-change functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ClosedPointNeighborhood.isEquivalence_henselianBaseChangeFunctor_of_isHenselization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BH0.** Let `X` be a decent algebraic space over `S` and `x ∈ |X|` a closed point
such that `U = X ∖ {x} ⟶ X` is quasi-compact; let `(W, w) → (X, x)` be an affine elementary étale
neighbourhood with `w` the only point above `x` (Stacks 0BBP) and let `R` be a henselization of
`𝒪_{W, w}`, so that `R = 𝒪^h_{X, x}` (Stacks 0EMY). With `V = Spec(𝒪^h_{X, x}) ∖ {𝔪^h_x}`, the base
change functor from the morphisms `f : Y ⟶ X` of finite presentation with `f⁻¹(U) ⟶ U` an
isomorphism to the morphisms `g : Y ⟶ Spec(𝒪^h_{X, x})` of finite presentation with
`g⁻¹(V) ⟶ V` an isomorphism is an equivalence of categories.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_henselianBaseChangeFunctor_of_isHenselization :
    (D.henselianBaseChangeFunctor R (D.contains_spec_of_isHenselization R)).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasLocallyFiniteIrreducibleComponents_of_isBlowupAlong_of_presentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BH1.**  Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S` and let `Z ⊆ X` be the closed
subspace cut out by a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals.  If `X` satisfies the equivalent
conditions of Stacks 0BB1 — here its condition (2),
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasLocallyFiniteIrreducibleComponents` — then so does the blowup
`b : X' ⟶ X` of `X` in `Z`.

Nothing about the blowup is assumed beyond its universal property, Stacks 085U: the étale
chart of `X'` the proof runs on is the one the construction of Stacks 085Q supplies, namely the
relative `Proj` `P_U` of the Rees algebra of the chart ideal on the presenting scheme `U` of
the presentation `P`.  That scheme is the blowup of the *scheme* `U`, by
`Stacks.Blowup.reesSituationBlowUpIso`, so every quasi-compact open of it has finitely many
irreducible components by
`AlgebraicGeometry.finite_irreducibleComponents_of_isCompact_blowUp`; `P_U ⟶ X'` is surjective
étale, so conditions (1) and (2) of Stacks 0BB1 carry the condition to the constructed blowup,
and from there to `b` along the isomorphism of any two blowups in the same centre.

Besides `Z`, the blowup `b` and the hypothesis on `X` the statement takes only the data the
construction of Stacks 085Q itself takes: the presentation `P`, the universe choice
`HasSheafify` for the quotient presheaf, and the three `B.Contains` side conditions on the
relative `Proj`s which `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativeProjChartOfSituation` already asks for.
None of that appears in the conclusion.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasLocallyFiniteIrreducibleComponents_of_isBlowupAlong_of_presentation
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)]
    {X X' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (Z : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X.obj)
    (P : Presentation B S hS X.obj X.property)
    (hcU : B.Contains (reesChartSituation (centreIdeal Z)
        (isCartesianOnAffineCharts_centreIdeal Z) P).relativeProj)
    (hcR : B.Contains (reesRelationSituation (centreIdeal Z)
        (isCartesianOnAffineCharts_centreIdeal Z) P).relativeProj)
    (hcRR : B.Contains (reesDoubleSituation (centreIdeal Z)
        (isCartesianOnAffineCharts_centreIdeal Z) P).relativeProj)
    {b : X' ⟶ X} (hb : IsBlowupAlong B S hS Z b)
    (hX : HasLocallyFiniteIrreducibleComponents B S hS X.1) :
    HasLocallyFiniteIrreducibleComponents B S hS X'.1
declarations.comment: the blowup of an algebraic space satisfying the equivalent conditions of Stacks 0BB1 in a closed subspace satisfies them too, with no assumed inputs beyond the Stacks 085Q construction data for the centre -- a presentation P, the HasSheafify universe choice, and the three B.Contains side conditions hcU, hcR and hcRR on the relative Projs -- none of which occurs in the conclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDomain_globalSections_of_isIntegralSpace
declarations.doc:
The ring of global regular functions on an integral algebraic space, the compatible families
of regular functions on its étale charts, is a domain.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDomain_globalSections_of_isIntegralSpace (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hXint : IsIntegralSpace B S hS X) :
    IsDomain (RingCat.sectionsSubring
      (structurePresheaf B S hS X ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u}))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isNormalDomain_globalSections_of_isIntegralSpace
declarations.doc:
The ring of global regular functions on a normal integral algebraic space, the compatible
families of regular functions on its étale charts, is a normal domain.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNormalDomain_globalSections_of_isIntegralSpace (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hXint : IsIntegralSpace B S hS X)
    (hXnormal : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsNormal Y)) :
    IsNormalDomain (RingCat.sectionsSubring
      (structurePresheaf B S hS X ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u}))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_of_isSheaf_etale_of_etale_space_atlas_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BH4.** Let `F` be a presheaf of sets on the big category over `S`, which is the
common underlying category of the chosen big fppf and big étale sites. If `F` is a sheaf for the
étale topology and there are an algebraic space `X` over `S` and a morphism `X ⟶ F` which is
representable by algebraic spaces, surjective and étale, then `F` is an algebraic space over `S`
in the sense of Algebraic Spaces, Definition 025Y.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_of_isSheaf_etale_of_etale_space_atlas` with its
Stacks 04S6 input discharged by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.bootstrap04S6QuotientSheaf`. It is the
complete statement of Stacks 0BH4 and its only registration; nothing is assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_of_isSheaf_etale_of_etale_space_atlas_unconditional
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf ((etaleTopology B).over (B.obj hS)) F)
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (a : X ⟶ F)
    (ha : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS a)
    (hsurj : HasProperty B S hS (surjectiveMorphismProperty B S hS) a ha)
    (hetale : HasProperty B S hS (etaleMorphisms B S hS) a ha) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.fpqcLocalProperties_iff_of_affineModificationBaseChange_obj_iso
declarations.doc:
Let `φ : A →+* R` be a homomorphism of rings, `A` Noetherian, inducing an isomorphism from
the `I`-adic completion of `A` to the `I R`-adic completion of `R`, as in Stacks 0AE5. Let
`f : X' ⟶ Spec A`, an object of the category of Stacks 0AS2 for `(A, I)`, correspond to
`g : Y' ⟶ Spec R`, an object of the category for `(R, I R)`, under the base change functor of
Stacks 0AE5, that is `g ≅ f ×_{Spec A} Spec R`. Then `f` is quasi-compact, quasi-separated,
separated, proper, respectively finite, if and only if `g` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem fpqcLocalProperties_iff_of_affineModificationBaseChange_obj_iso
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (h : Function.Bijective (adicCompletionMap φ I (I.map φ) le_rfl))
    (M : Space.FiniteTypeModification B S hS (Space.openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS
      (yoneda.obj (affineOver B S hS hA s)) (zeroLocusPoints B S hS hA s I)ᶜ))
    (N : Space.FiniteTypeModification B S hS (Space.openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS
      (yoneda.obj (affineOver B S hS hR (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ s)))
      (zeroLocusPoints B S hS hR (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ s) (I.map φ))ᶜ))
    (e : (affineModificationBaseChange B S hS φ I hA hR s).obj M ≅ N) :
    (Space.IsQuasiCompact B S hS M.obj.hom ↔ Space.IsQuasiCompact B S hS N.obj.hom) ∧
      (Space.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS M.obj.hom ↔ Space.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS N.obj.hom) ∧
      (Space.IsSeparated B S hS M.obj.hom ↔ Space.IsSeparated B S hS N.obj.hom) ∧
      (Space.IsProper B S hS M.obj.hom ↔ Space.IsProper B S hS N.obj.hom) ∧
      (Space.IsFinite B S hS M.obj.hom ↔ Space.IsFinite B S hS N.obj.hom)
