        Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced k' (k' ⊗[k] R)) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) (R : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced k (Localization.AtPrime p)) ↔
          Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced k R) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
      [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.Flat B C],
      (∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced p.ResidueField (p.Fiber B)) →
      (∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.ResidueField (q.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced p.ResidueField (p.Fiber C)) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
      [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.FaithfullyFlat B C],
      (∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced p.ResidueField (p.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced p.ResidueField (p.Fiber B)) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) (k' : Type v) (R : Type w)
      [Field k] [Field k'] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k k'] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k' R] [IsScalarTower k k' R]
      [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced k R → Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced k' R)

declarations.name: geometricNormality_satisfies_formalFibre_properties
declarations.doc:
Geometric normality satisfies properties (A)--(E) for formal fibres: base change by a
finitely generated field extension, detection on local rings, ascent along a regular map,
faithfully flat descent, and separable algebraic extension of the base field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem geometricNormality_satisfies_formalFibre_properties :
    (∀ (k : Type u) (k' : Type v) (R : Type w) [Field k] [Field k'] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k k'] [Algebra k R] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k k'] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal k R →
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal k' (k' ⊗[k] R)) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) (R : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal k (Localization.AtPrime p)) ↔
          Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal k R) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
      [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.Flat B C],
      (∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal p.ResidueField (p.Fiber B)) →
      (∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.ResidueField (q.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal p.ResidueField (p.Fiber C)) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
      [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.FaithfullyFlat B C],
      (∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal p.ResidueField (p.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal p.ResidueField (p.Fiber B)) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) (k' : Type v) (R : Type w)
      [Field k] [Field k'] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k k'] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k' R] [IsScalarTower k k' R]
      [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal k R → Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal k' R)

declarations.name: serreProperty_satisfies_formalFiberAxioms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BIY.** For `n ≥ 1`, the property that the target of a map from a field to a
Noetherian ring satisfies `(Sₙ)` has properties (A)--(E).
declarations.statement:
public theorem serreProperty_satisfies_formalFiberAxioms
    (n : ℕ) (_hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∀ (k : Type u) (K : Type v) (R : Type w)
      [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R] [Algebra k K]
      [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K],
      HasSerreCondition R n → HasSerreCondition (R ⊗[k] K) n) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) (R : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        HasSerreCondition (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) n) ↔
        HasSerreCondition R n) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
      [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.Flat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, HasSerreCondition (p.asIdeal.Fiber B) n) →
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.asIdeal.ResidueField (q.asIdeal.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, HasSerreCondition (p.asIdeal.Fiber C) n) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
      [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.FaithfullyFlat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, HasSerreCondition (p.asIdeal.Fiber C) n) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, HasSerreCondition (p.asIdeal.Fiber B) n) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) (K : Type v) (R : Type w)
      [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k K] [Algebra k R] [Algebra K R] [IsScalarTower k K R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] [Algebra.IsSeparable k K],
      HasSerreCondition R n → HasSerreCondition R n)
declarations.comment:
The source fixes `n ≥ 1`, so `_hn : 1 ≤ n` is carried for faithfulness even though
the proof does not use it — each of the five axioms holds for `(Sₙ)` at every `n`. Hence the
leading underscore on that binder.

declarations.name: propertyRk_after_finiteExtensions_satisfies_formalFibre_properties
declarations.doc:
For fixed `n`, the property that every finite extension of the ground field makes an algebra
satisfy Serre's condition `(R_n)` satisfies properties (A)--(E) for formal fibres: base change by
a finitely generated field extension, detection on local rings, ascent along a regular map,
faithfully flat descent, and separable algebraic extension of the base field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem propertyRk_after_finiteExtensions_satisfies_formalFibre_properties (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ (k : Type u) (k' : Type v) (R : Type w) [Field k] [Field k'] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k k'] [Algebra k R] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k k'] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [FiniteDimensional k K],
        HasPropertyRk (K ⊗[k] R) n) →
      ∀ (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra k' K] [FiniteDimensional k' K],
        HasPropertyRk (K ⊗[k'] (k' ⊗[k] R)) n) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) (R : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
        ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [FiniteDimensional k K],
          HasPropertyRk (K ⊗[k] Localization.AtPrime p) n) ↔
      ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [FiniteDimensional k K],
        HasPropertyRk (K ⊗[k] R) n) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
      [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.Flat B C],
      (∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra p.ResidueField K]
          [FiniteDimensional p.ResidueField K],
          HasPropertyRk (K ⊗[p.ResidueField] p.Fiber B) n) →
      (∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime],
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.ResidueField (q.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra p.ResidueField K]
          [FiniteDimensional p.ResidueField K],
          HasPropertyRk (K ⊗[p.ResidueField] p.Fiber C) n) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) (C : Type w)
      [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.FaithfullyFlat B C],
      (∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra p.ResidueField K]
          [FiniteDimensional p.ResidueField K],
          HasPropertyRk (K ⊗[p.ResidueField] p.Fiber C) n) →
      ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
        ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra p.ResidueField K]
          [FiniteDimensional p.ResidueField K],
          HasPropertyRk (K ⊗[p.ResidueField] p.Fiber B) n) ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) (k' : Type v) (R : Type w)
      [Field k] [Field k'] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k k'] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k' R] [IsScalarTower k k' R]
      [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] [FiniteDimensional k K],
        HasPropertyRk (K ⊗[k] R) n) →
      ∀ (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra k' K] [FiniteDimensional k' K],
        HasPropertyRk (K ⊗[k'] R) n)

declarations.name: isNagataRing_iff_formalFibers_geometricallyReduced
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJ0.** A Noetherian local ring is Nagata if and only if all its formal fibres are
geometrically reduced.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNagataRing_iff_formalFibers_geometricallyReduced
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] :
    IsNagataRing A ↔
      ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum A,
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced q.asIdeal.ResidueField
          (q.asIdeal.Fiber (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A))

declarations.name: Stacks.Smoothing.NeronSituation
declarations.doc:
The standing data and hypotheses of Stacks 0BJ2: an extension `R → Λ` of discrete
valuation rings of ramification index one, factored as `R → A → Λ` with `A` flat and of finite
type over `R`.
declarations.statement: structure NeronSituation

declarations.name: Stacks.Smoothing.neron_affineBlowup_localization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJ3.** The affine blowup at `𝔭` commutes with localizing away from an element
outside `𝔭`: if `A' = A[𝔭/π]`, then the affine blowup of `A_a` is `A'_a`.
declarations.statement:
theorem neron_affineBlowup_localization
    (S : NeronSituation) (π : S.R)
    (_hπ : Irreducible π)
    (a : S.A)
    (_ha : a ∉ S.maximalIdealPreimage)
    (hπA : algebraMap S.R S.A π ∈ S.maximalIdealPreimage) :
    let A' : Type _ := affineBlowupAlgebra S.maximalIdealPreimage
      (algebraMap S.R S.A π) (Localization.Away (algebraMap S.R S.A π))
    let Aa := Localization.Away a
    let L := Localization.Away (algebraMap S.A A' a)
    let B : Type _ := affineBlowupAlgebra
      (S.maximalIdealPreimage.map (algebraMap S.A Aa))
      (algebraMap S.A Aa (algebraMap S.R S.A π))
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap S.A Aa (algebraMap S.R S.A π)))
    ∃ e : L ≃+* B,
      (∀ x : S.A, e (algebraMap A' L (algebraMap S.A A' x)) =
        algebraMap Aa B (algebraMap S.A Aa x)) ∧
      (∀ x : Aa, e (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap S.A A') a x) =
        algebraMap Aa B x)
declarations.comment: neron_localization

declarations.name: Stacks.Smoothing.blowup_quotient_by_surjection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJ3.** A surjection `B → A` of flat finite-type `R`-algebras presents the blowup
of `A` at `𝔭`: it is the blowup of `B` at the preimage of `𝔭`, modulo the extended kernel and
then modulo the `π`-power torsion.
declarations.statement:
lemma blowup_quotient_by_surjection (S : NeronSituation) (π : S.R)
    (hπ : Ideal.span ({π} : Set S.R) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.R)
    (B : Type*) [CommRing B] [Algebra S.R B] [Module.Flat S.R B]
    [Algebra.FiniteType S.R B]
    (f : B →ₐ[S.R] S.A) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Nonempty <|
      let pB : Ideal B := Ideal.comap f.toRingHom S.maximalIdealPreimage
      let B' := affineBlowupAlgebra pB (algebraMap S.R B π)
        (Localization.Away (algebraMap S.R B π))
      let I : Ideal B := RingHom.ker f.toRingHom
      let IB' : Ideal B' := Ideal.map (algebraMap B B') I
      let T := B' ⧸ IB'
      let A' := affineBlowupAlgebra S.maximalIdealPreimage
        (algebraMap S.R S.A π) (Localization.Away (algebraMap S.R S.A π))
      (T ⧸ torsionIdeal T (algebraMap S.R T π)) ≃ₐ[S.R] A'
declarations.comment: neron_surjection

declarations.name: Stacks.Smoothing.affineBlowup_smoothAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJ4, smoothness.** In a Néron situation with uniformizer `π`, if `A` is smooth over
`R` at `𝔭` and the residue-field extension `κ(R) → κ(Λ)` is separable, then the affine blowup
`A' = A[𝔭/π]` is smooth over `R` at the prime `𝔭'` induced by the canonical map `A' → Λ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem affineBlowup_smoothAt
    (S : NeronSituation) (π : S.R)
    (hπ : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.R = Ideal.span ({π} : Set S.R))
    (hsep : @Algebra.IsSeparableExtension
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.R).ResidueField
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.Λ).ResidueField _ _ S.residueFieldExtension)
    (hS : Algebra.SmoothAt S.R S.A S.maximalIdealPreimage) :
    Algebra.SmoothAt S.R
      (affineBlowupAlgebra S.maximalIdealPreimage (algebraMap S.R S.A π)
        (Localization.Away (algebraMap S.R S.A π)))
      (Ideal.comap (canonicalNeronBlowupMap S π hπ).1
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.Λ))
declarations.comment: blowup_smooth

declarations.name: Stacks.Smoothing.affineBlowup_differentials_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJ4, the differential sequence.** In a Néron situation with uniformizer `π`, if `A`
is smooth over `R` at `𝔭` and the residue-field extension `κ(R) → κ(Λ)` is separable, then for
`c = dim (A/πA)_𝔭` the relative differentials of the affine blowup `A'` at its prime `𝔭'` sit in a
short exact sequence
`0 → Ω_{A/R} ⊗_A A'_{𝔭'} → Ω_{A'/R} ⊗_{A'} A'_{𝔭'} → ((A'/πA')_{𝔭'})^c → 0`,
whose first map is the base change of `Ω_{A/R} → Ω_{A'/R}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem affineBlowup_differentials_shortExact
    (S : NeronSituation) (π : S.R)
    (hπ : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.R = Ideal.span ({π} : Set S.R))
    (hsep : @Algebra.IsSeparableExtension
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.R).ResidueField
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.Λ).ResidueField _ _ S.residueFieldExtension)
    (hsm : Algebra.SmoothAt S.R S.A S.maximalIdealPreimage)
    (c : ℕ)
    (hc : ringKrullDim
      ((Localization.AtPrime S.maximalIdealPreimage) ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap S.R (Localization.AtPrime S.maximalIdealPreimage) π} :
          Set (Localization.AtPrime S.maximalIdealPreimage))) = c) :
    let A' := affineBlowupAlgebra S.maximalIdealPreimage (algebraMap S.R S.A π)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap S.R S.A π))
    ∀ (p' : Ideal A') [p'.IsPrime],
      p' = Ideal.comap (canonicalNeronBlowupMap S π hπ).1 (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.Λ) →
      ∀ (B : Type w) [CommRing B] [Algebra A' B] [IsLocalization.AtPrime B p']
        [Algebra S.A B] [IsScalarTower S.A A' B],
        let Q := B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap A' B (algebraMap S.R A' π)} : Set B)
        ∃ (f : B ⊗[S.A] Ω[S.A⁄S.R] →ₗ[B] B ⊗[A'] Ω[A'⁄S.R])
          (_ : ∀ (x : B) (y : Ω[S.A⁄S.R]),
            f (x ⊗ₜ[S.A] y) = x ⊗ₜ[A'] KaehlerDifferential.map S.R S.R S.A A' y)
          (g : B ⊗[A'] Ω[A'⁄S.R] →ₗ[B] (Fin c → Q))
          (hzero : ModuleCat.ofHom f ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom g = 0),
          (ShortComplex.mk (ModuleCat.ofHom f) (ModuleCat.ofHom g) hzero).ShortExact
declarations.comment: differentials_sequence

declarations.name: Stacks.Smoothing.smoothAt_of_conormal_cokernel_free
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJ5.** In a Néron situation, suppose `A` is smooth over `R` at the generic point
`𝔮 = Ker(A → Λ)`, suppose `A` is a quotient of an `R`-algebra `B` which is smooth over `R` at the
preimage of `𝔭`, and suppose the cokernel of the conormal map `I/I² ⊗_A Λ → Ω_{B/R} ⊗_B Λ` is a
free `Λ`-module. Then `A` is smooth over `R` at `𝔭` too.
declarations.statement:
theorem smoothAt_of_conormal_cokernel_free
    (S : NeronSituation)
    (B : Type*) [CommRing B] [Algebra S.R B] [Algebra B S.A]
    [IsScalarTower S.R B S.A]
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap B S.A))
    (hA : Algebra.SmoothAt S.R S.A S.kernelIdeal)
    (_hB : Algebra.SmoothAt S.R B (Ideal.comap (algebraMap B S.A) S.maximalIdealPreimage))
    (hfree : let _ := ConormalSeq.cotangentModule hsurj
      Module.Free S.Λ
        ((S.Λ ⊗[S.A] (S.A ⊗[B] Ω[B⁄S.R])) ⧸
          LinearMap.range
            (LinearMap.baseChange S.Λ (ConormalSeq.conormalMap S.R hsurj)))) :
    Algebra.SmoothAt S.R S.A S.maximalIdealPreimage

declarations.name: Stacks.Smoothing.exists_finite_affineNeronBlowup_smoothAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJ6.** In a Néron situation, if `A` is smooth over `R` at the generic prime
`𝔮 = Ker(A → Λ)` and the residue-field extension `κ(R) → κ(Λ)` is separable, then finitely many
affine Néron blowups produce a stage that is smooth over `R` at its distinguished prime
`𝔭 = (· → Λ)^{-1}(𝔪_Λ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finite_affineNeronBlowup_smoothAt
    (S : NeronSituation.{u, v, w})
    (hsm : Algebra.SmoothAt S.R S.A S.kernelIdeal)
    (hsep : @Algebra.IsSeparableExtension
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.R).ResidueField
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.Λ).ResidueField _ _ S.residueFieldExtension) :
    ∃ T : NeronStage S,
      Relation.ReflTransGen (IsAffineNeronBlowup S) (NeronStage.initial S) T ∧
        Algebra.SmoothAt S.R T.A T.maximalIdealPreimage

declarations.name: Stacks.Smoothing.ind_underSmooth_of_ramificationIdx_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJ7 (Néron desingularization for discrete valuation rings).** Let `R ⊂ Λ` be an
extension of discrete valuation rings which has ramification index `1` and induces a separable
extension of residue fields and of fraction fields. Then `Λ` is a filtered colimit of smooth
`R`-algebras.
declarations.statement:
theorem ind_underSmooth_of_ramificationIdx_one
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R Λ))
    (hram : Stacks.DiscreteValuationRing.Ramification.ramificationIdx R Λ = 1)
    (hres : letI := Ideal.residueFieldAlgebra (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
                (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ)
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).ResidueField
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ).ResidueField)
    [Algebra.IsSeparableExtension K L] :
    ObjectProperty.ind.{u} (UnderSmooth (CommRingCat.of R))
      (Under.mk (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Λ)))
declarations.comment:
"`Λ` is a filtered colimit of smooth `R`-algebras" is
`CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ind.{u}` of `UnderSmooth (CommRingCat.of R)` on the category
`Under (CommRingCat.of R)` of `R`-algebras, the same spelling as the left-hand side of the library's
Lemma 07C3. The residue fields are `Ideal.ResidueField` at the maximal ideals, as in the library's
Lemmas 0BJ4-0BJ6, and the fraction fields are abstract, pinned by `IsFractionRing`. See the module
docstring.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.degreeWithRespectTo_div_factorial_pos
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BJ8], the leading coefficient.**  For `X` proper over `k` of dimension `d`
and `𝓛` ample, the constant `deg_𝓛(X)/d!` is positive.  The degree `deg_𝓛(X)` is positive by
[Stacks, Tag 0BEV] and `d!` is positive.
declarations.statement:
public theorem degreeWithRespectTo_div_factorial_pos :
    0 < (degreeWithRespectTo k f (𝟙 X) d hdim L hL : ℚ) / (d.factorial : ℚ)
declarations.comment: the leading coefficient deg_L(X)/d! is a positive constant

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_degree_lt_eventually_finrank_globalSections_eq
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BJ8], the asymptotic formula.**  For `X` proper over `k` of dimension `d` and
`𝓛` ample, for all sufficiently large `n`

`dim_k Γ(X, 𝓛^{⊗ n}) = deg_𝓛(X)/d! ⬝ n^d + P(n)`

with `P` a rational polynomial of degree strictly less than `d`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_degree_lt_eventually_finrank_globalSections_eq :
    ∃ P : Polynomial ℚ, P.degree < (d : WithBot ℕ) ∧
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        (Module.finrank k (globalSectionsOverField k f
            (tensorPower X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L (n : ℤ))) : ℚ) =
          (degreeWithRespectTo k f (𝟙 X) d hdim L hL : ℚ) / (d.factorial : ℚ) * (n : ℚ) ^ d +
            P.eval (n : ℚ)
declarations.comment: the asymptotic formula for dim_k Γ(X, L^n)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.asymptotic_riemann_roch
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BJ8] (Asymptotic Riemann–Roch).**  Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a scheme
proper over `k` of dimension `d` and let `𝓛` be an ample invertible `𝒪_X`-module.  Then

`dim_k Γ(X, 𝓛^{⊗ n}) = deg_𝓛(X)/d! ⬝ n^d + lower order terms`

for all sufficiently large `n`, and the leading constant `deg_𝓛(X)/d!` is positive.
declarations.statement:
public theorem asymptotic_riemann_roch :
    0 < (degreeWithRespectTo k f (𝟙 X) d hdim L hL : ℚ) / (d.factorial : ℚ) ∧
      ∃ P : Polynomial ℚ, P.degree < (d : WithBot ℕ) ∧
        ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
          (Module.finrank k (globalSectionsOverField k f
              (tensorPower X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2 L (n : ℤ))) : ℚ) =
            (degreeWithRespectTo k f (𝟙 X) d hdim L hL : ℚ) / (d.factorial : ℚ) * (n : ℚ) ^ d +
              P.eval (n : ℚ)

declarations.name: cohenMacaulayProperty_satisfies_formalFiberAxioms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJ9.** The property of a map from a field to a Noetherian ring that its target is
Cohen–Macaulay satisfies properties (A)--(E): it is preserved by finitely generated field
extension, is local on the target, passes through a composition of flat maps when the second map
is regular, descends through a faithfully flat second map, and is unchanged upon replacing the
ground field by a separable algebraic extension.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cohenMacaulayProperty_satisfies_formalFiberAxioms
    (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R], P (algebraMap k R) ↔ Module.IsCohenMacaulay R R) :
    (∀ (k K R : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R] [Algebra k K]
      [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K],
      P (algebraMap k R) →
        P (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := k) (A := R) (B := K)).toRingHom) ∧
    (∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        P (algebraMap k (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))) ↔ P (algebraMap k R)) ∧
    (∀ (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.Flat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber B))) →
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.asIdeal.ResidueField (q.asIdeal.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber C))) ∧
    (∀ (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.FaithfullyFlat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber C))) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber B))) ∧
    (∀ (k K R : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k K] [Algebra k R] [Algebra K R] [IsScalarTower k K R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] [Algebra.IsSeparable k K],
      P (algebraMap k R) → P (algebraMap K R))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.powerTorsionRestrictScalarsData
declarations.doc:
Restriction of scalars on power-torsion derived categories, together with its comparison to
ordinary derived restriction after inclusion.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def powerTorsionRestrictScalarsData
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    Σ' F : Dualizing.PowerTorsionDerivedCategory B (I.map f) (hI.map f) ⥤
        Dualizing.PowerTorsionDerivedCategory A I hI,
      F ⋙ (Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty A I hI).ι ≅
        (Dualizing.derivedPowerTorsionProperty B (I.map f) (hI.map f)).ι ⋙
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uA uB v} f).mapDerivedCategory
declarations.comment: the torsion-valued restriction functor

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyRestrictScalarsIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJB.** Local cohomology commutes with restriction of scalars,
naturally in the derived `B`-module, as an isomorphism valued in the power-torsion derived
category.

Both functors are right adjoint to `K ↦ K ⊗ᴸ_A B` on `D_{I^∞-torsion}(A)`: for the left-hand
side this is the composite of the local-cohomology adjunction over `A` with the
extension–restriction adjunction, and for the right-hand side it is the composite of the
local-cohomology adjunction over `B` with the restriction of the extension–restriction
adjunction to the two power-torsion subcategories.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def localCohomologyRestrictScalarsIso
    (f : A →+* B) (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) :
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max uA uB v} f).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor A I hI ≅
      Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctor B (I.map f) (hI.map f) ⋙
        powerTorsionRestrictScalars.{uA, uB, v} f I hI
declarations.comment: the local-cohomology isomorphism

declarations.name: Dualizing.localCohomology_comp_torsion
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BJC].** Local cohomology supported on `V(J)` of an object with
`I`-power-torsion cohomology has `(I + J)`-power-torsion cohomology, because
`V(I + J) = V(I) ∩ V(J)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem localCohomology_comp_torsion (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I J : Ideal A)
    (hI : I.FG) (hJ : J.FG) (K : PowerTorsionDerivedCategory A I hI) :
    derivedPowerTorsionProperty A (I + J) (Submodule.FG.sup hI hJ)
      (((derivedPowerTorsionProperty A I hI).ι ⋙ localCohomologyFunctor A J hJ ⋙
        (derivedPowerTorsionProperty A J hJ).ι).obj K)
declarations.comment: the target of the composition of the local cohomology functors

declarations.name: Dualizing.localCohomologyCompIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BJC].** `RΓ_Y ∘ RΓ_Z = RΓ_{Y ∩ Z}` for `Z = V(I)` and `Y = V(J)`: iterated
local cohomology is local cohomology supported on `V(I) ∩ V(J) = V(I + J)`. Both functors are
right adjoint to the inclusion of the objects with `(I + J)`-power-torsion cohomology into those
with `I`-power-torsion cohomology, so they agree.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def localCohomologyCompIso (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I J : Ideal A)
    (hI : I.FG) (hJ : J.FG) :
    localCohomologyFunctor.{u, v} A I hI ⋙ localCohomologyOnPowerTorsion A I J hI hJ ≅
      localCohomologyFunctor A (I + J) (Submodule.FG.sup hI hJ)
declarations.comment: the composition of the local cohomology functors

declarations.name: Dualizing.spectralSequencePageTwoIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BJC], the second page.** At `(p, q)` the second page of the spectral
sequence is `H^p_Y(H^q_Z(K))`, naturally in `K`: the `q`-th local cohomology module of `K`
supported on `Z = V(I)`, placed in degree zero, has its `p`-th local cohomology supported on
`Y = V(J)` taken.

This is `Stacks.Cohomology.LerayCard.pageTwoNatIsoDerived` for `Φ = RΓ_Y`, precomposed with
`RΓ_Z`; no Noetherian hypothesis and no comparison of models of local cohomology is involved.
declarations.statement:
def spectralSequencePageTwoIso (p q : ℤ) :
    spectralSequence.{u, v} A I J hI hJ ⋙ SpectralSequence.pageFunctor _ _ 2 2 ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ (p, q) ≅
      localCohomologyFunctorPlus.{u, v} A I hI ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) q ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) 0 ⋙
            localCohomologyFunctorPlus.{u, v} A J hJ ⋙
              DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) p
declarations.comment: the second page of the spectral sequence

declarations.name: Dualizing.abutsTo_spectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BJC], the convergence.** For `K` in `D⁺(A)` the spectral sequence has an
infinity page at every bidegree and the terms `E_∞^{p, n-p}` are the successive quotients of a
finite decreasing filtration of `H^n_{Y ∩ Z}(K)`.

Boundedness of the spectral object comes from
`Stacks.Cohomology.LerayTruncation.isBounded_cohomologySpectralObjectFunctor_obj`, whose
hypothesis is left `t`-exactness of `RΓ_Y` — that is
`Dualizing.isGE_localCohomologyFunctorPlus_obj`. The abutment the generic theorem produces is
`H^n(RΓ_Y(RΓ_Z K))`, and `Dualizing.localCohomologyFunctorPlusCompIso` identifies it with
`H^n_{Y ∩ Z}(K)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem abutsTo_spectralSequence (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (ModuleCat.{v} A)) :
    SpectralSequence.AbutsTo ((spectralSequence.{u, v} A I J hI hJ).obj K)
      (fun n : ℤ ↦ (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) n).obj
        ((localCohomologyFunctorPlus.{u, v} A (I + J) (Submodule.FG.sup hI hJ)).obj K))
declarations.comment: the convergence of the spectral sequence

declarations.name: Dualizing.localCohomology_comp_spectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJC, all five clauses.** Let `A` be a ring, let `I, J ⊆ A` be finitely generated
ideals and set `Z = V(I)`, `Y = V(J)`. Then

1. `Z ∩ Y = V(I + J)`;
2. `RΓ_Y` carries an object with `I`-power-torsion cohomology to one with
   `(I + J)`-power-torsion cohomology, so that `RΓ_Y ∘ RΓ_Z` is a functor
   `D(A) → D_{(I + J)^∞-torsion}(A)`;
3. `RΓ_Y ∘ RΓ_Z ≅ RΓ_{Y ∩ Z}` as functors `D(A) → D_{(I + J)^∞-torsion}(A)`;
4. for `K` in `D⁺(A)` the second page of the spectral sequence of the composition is
   `E₂^{p, q} = H^p_Y(H^q_Z(K))`, naturally in `K`; and
5. that spectral sequence abuts to `H^{p + q}_{Y ∩ Z}(K)`.

Clauses (3) and (4) are isomorphisms of functors, so they appear here as `Nonempty`; the
isomorphisms themselves are `Dualizing.localCohomologyCompIso` and
`Dualizing.spectralSequencePageTwoIso`, each of which carries the tag for its own clause, as do
`PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_sup` for (1), `Dualizing.localCohomology_comp_torsion` for (2) and
`Dualizing.abutsTo_spectralSequence` for (5). Nothing here is Noetherian and no comparison of
the two models of local cohomology is involved: everything is the coreflection model `RΓ_{V(I)}`
of [Stacks, Tag 0A6Q].
declarations.statement:
theorem localCohomology_comp_spectralSequence :
    PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set A) =
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus ((I + J : Ideal A) : Set A) ∧
      (∀ K : PowerTorsionDerivedCategory.{u, v} A I hI,
        derivedPowerTorsionProperty A (I + J) (Submodule.FG.sup hI hJ)
          (((derivedPowerTorsionProperty A I hI).ι ⋙ localCohomologyFunctor A J hJ ⋙
            (derivedPowerTorsionProperty A J hJ).ι).obj K)) ∧
      Nonempty (localCohomologyFunctor.{u, v} A I hI ⋙
          localCohomologyOnPowerTorsion A I J hI hJ ≅
        localCohomologyFunctor A (I + J) (Submodule.FG.sup hI hJ)) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty (spectralSequence.{u, v} A I J hI hJ ⋙
          SpectralSequence.pageFunctor _ _ 2 2 ⋙ HomologicalComplex.eval _ _ (p, q) ≅
        localCohomologyFunctorPlus.{u, v} A I hI ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) q ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) 0 ⋙
              localCohomologyFunctorPlus.{u, v} A J hJ ⋙
                DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) p)) ∧
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory.Plus (ModuleCat.{v} A),
        SpectralSequence.AbutsTo ((spectralSequence.{u, v} A I J hI hJ).obj K)
          (fun n : ℤ ↦ (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) n).obj
            ((localCohomologyFunctorPlus.{u, v} A (I + J) (Submodule.FG.sup hI hJ)).obj K))
declarations.comment: all five clauses conjoined; the two isomorphisms of functors appear as `Nonempty`, the isomorphisms themselves being the declarations that carry the tag for those clauses

registrations.name: PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_sup
registrations.comment: intersection_of_zero_loci

declarations.name: Stacks.Discriminant.discriminantIdeal_properties
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJF.** The discriminant of a finite locally free morphism is locally
principal, its support consists of the images of the ramified points, and it is the unit ideal
sheaf exactly when the morphism is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem discriminantIdeal_properties :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsLocallyPrincipal (discriminantIdeal f) ∧
      (∀ y : Y, y ∈ (discriminantIdeal f).support ↔
        ∃ x : X, f x = y ∧ ¬ UnramifiedAt f x) ∧
      (Etale f ↔ discriminantIdeal f = ⊤)
declarations.comment: discriminant properties

declarations.name: Stacks.Discriminant.etale_iff_discriminantIdeal_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJF.** A finite locally free morphism is étale if and only if its
discriminant is empty.
declarations.statement: theorem etale_iff_discriminantIdeal_eq_top : Etale f ↔ discriminantIdeal f = ⊤

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.exists_isPrime_height_eq_one_of_mem_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
An element of the maximal ideal of a positive-dimensional Noetherian local ring is
contained in a prime ideal of height one.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isPrime_height_eq_one_of_mem_maximalIdeal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hdim : 1 ≤ ringKrullDim A) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    ∃ p : Ideal A, p.IsPrime ∧ f ∈ p ∧ p.height = 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.etaleAt_of_flat_of_unramifiedAt_codimensionOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJH.** A flat morphism of locally Noetherian schemes which is
quasi-finite at a point that is not the generic point of an irreducible component of its source
is étale at that point, provided it is unramified at every one-dimensional generization of the
point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem etaleAt_of_flat_of_unramifiedAt_codimensionOne
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [Flat f]
    (x : X) (hqf : quasiFiniteAt f x) (hgen : x ∉ genericPoints X)
    (hunr : ∀ x' : X, x' ⤳ x → ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x') = 1 → UnramifiedAt f x') :
    EtaleAt f x

declarations.name: Dualizing.isGorensteinLocalRing_iff_residueField_ext_vanishing
declarations.doc:
A Noetherian local ring is Gorenstein precisely when its
Ext groups from the residue field to the regular module vanish in high degrees.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGorensteinLocalRing_iff_residueField_ext_vanishing
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] :
    IsGorensteinLocalRing A ↔
      ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i →
        Subsingleton
          (DerivedCategory.Ext
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
              (ModuleCat.of A (Shrink.{u} (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))))
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A A)) i)

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.isGorenstein_subscheme_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor
declarations.doc:
**The closed subscheme cut out by an effective Cartier divisor on a Gorenstein scheme is
Gorenstein.**
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGorenstein_subscheme_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsGorenstein X] (D : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hD : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsGorenstein D.subscheme
declarations.comment: scheme-theoretic form: an effective Cartier divisor on a Gorenstein scheme

declarations.name: Dualizing.isGorensteinLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_iff
declarations.doc:
Quotienting a Noetherian local ring by a nonzerodivisor in its maximal ideal preserves and
reflects the Gorenstein property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGorensteinLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_iff
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (f : A) (hf : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (hfreg : f ∈ nonZeroDivisors A) :
    letI : Nontrivial (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (Ideal.span_le.2 (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hf))
        (inferInstance : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).IsMaximal).lt_top).ne
    letI : IsLocalRing (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    IsGorensteinLocalRing A ↔ IsGorensteinLocalRing (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f})

declarations.name: Dualizing.isGorensteinLocalRing_iff_of_flat
declarations.doc:
For a flat local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings, the target is Gorenstein if and only
if the source and the closed fibre are Gorenstein.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGorensteinLocalRing_iff_of_flat
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)] [Module.Flat A B] :
    let I := (maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A B)
    let _ : Nontrivial (B ⧸ I) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
        (IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_lt_top (algebraMap A B)).ne
    let _ : IsLocalHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) :=
      IsLocalHom.of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    let _ : IsLocalRing (B ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    IsGorensteinLocalRing B ↔
      (IsGorensteinLocalRing A ∧
        IsGorensteinLocalRing (B ⧸ I))

declarations.name: Dualizing.isGorensteinRing_tensorProduct_of_essFiniteType_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJN, clause (A).** Let `k` be a field, `R` a Noetherian `k`-algebra and
`K/k` an extension of fields which is finitely generated as a field extension. If `R` is
Gorenstein, then `R ⊗_k K` is Gorenstein.

The extension `K/k` is a localization of a global complete intersection `C` over `k`; base
changing `C` along `k → R` gives a relative global complete intersection `R → R ⊗_k C`, so
`R ⊗_k C` is Gorenstein by Tag 0DWA, and `R ⊗_k K` is a localization of `R ⊗_k C`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGorensteinRing_tensorProduct_of_essFiniteType_fieldExtension
    {k : Type u} {R : Type v} {K : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing R] [Field K] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k K]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K]
    (hR : IsGorensteinRing R) :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing (R ⊗[k] K) :=
      Algebra.EssFiniteType.isNoetherianRing R (R ⊗[k] K)
    IsGorensteinRing (R ⊗[k] K)
declarations.comment: gorenstein_field_extension

declarations.name: Dualizing.gorensteinProperty_localization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJN, clause (B).** The property of a map from a field to a Noetherian
ring that its target is Gorenstein can be checked after localizing at every prime.
declarations.statement:
public theorem gorensteinProperty_localization (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      P (algebraMap k R) ↔ IsGorensteinRing R) :
    ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, P (algebraMap k (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))) ↔
        P (algebraMap k R)

declarations.name: Dualizing.gorensteinProperty_regularAscent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJN, clause (C).** For flat maps `A → B → C` of Noetherian rings with
`B → C` regular, if every fibre of `A → B` is Gorenstein then so is every fibre of `A → C`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem gorensteinProperty_regularAscent (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      P (algebraMap k R) ↔ IsGorensteinRing R) :
    ∀ (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.Flat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber B))) →
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.asIdeal.ResidueField (q.asIdeal.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber C))

declarations.name: Dualizing.gorensteinProperty_faithfullyFlatDescent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJN, clause (D).** For flat maps `A → B → C` of Noetherian rings with
`B → C` faithfully flat, if every fibre of `A → C` is Gorenstein then so is every fibre of
`A → B`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem gorensteinProperty_faithfullyFlatDescent (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      P (algebraMap k R) ↔ IsGorensteinRing R) :
    ∀ (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.FaithfullyFlat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber C))) →
        ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber B))

declarations.name: Dualizing.gorensteinProperty_groundFieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJN, clause (E).** Gorensteinness of the target is unchanged when the
ground field is replaced by a separable algebraic extension of it inside the target: the
condition does not refer to the ground field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem gorensteinProperty_groundFieldExtension (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      P (algebraMap k R) ↔ IsGorensteinRing R) :
    ∀ (k K R : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k K] [Algebra k R] [Algebra K R] [IsScalarTower k K R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] [Algebra.IsSeparable k K],
      P (algebraMap k R) → P (algebraMap K R)

declarations.name: Dualizing.gorensteinTarget_satisfies_formalFiberAxioms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJN.** Gorensteinness of the target of a map from a field to a
Noetherian ring satisfies properties (A)--(E) of [Stacks, Tag 0BIR]: it is preserved by finitely
generated field extension of the ground field, is detected by the localizations at the primes of
the target, passes through a composition of flat maps whose second map is regular, descends
through a faithfully flat second map, and is unchanged upon replacing the ground field by a
separable algebraic extension of it inside the target. Gorensteinness of the target is the
property `Dualizing.gorensteinTarget`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem gorensteinTarget_satisfies_formalFiberAxioms :
    (∀ (k K R : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R] [Algebra k K]
      [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K],
      gorensteinTarget.{u} (algebraMap k R) →
        gorensteinTarget.{u}
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := k) (A := R) (B := K)).toRingHom) ∧
    (∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
          gorensteinTarget.{u} (algebraMap k (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))) ↔
        gorensteinTarget.{u} (algebraMap k R)) ∧
    (∀ (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.Flat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        gorensteinTarget.{u} (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber B))) →
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.asIdeal.ResidueField (q.asIdeal.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        gorensteinTarget.{u} (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber C))) ∧
    (∀ (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.FaithfullyFlat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        gorensteinTarget.{u} (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber C))) →
        ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
          gorensteinTarget.{u} (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber B))) ∧
    (∀ (k K R : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k K] [Algebra k R] [Algebra K R] [IsScalarTower k K R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] [Algebra.IsSeparable k K],
      gorensteinTarget.{u} (algebraMap k R) → gorensteinTarget.{u} (algebraMap K R))
declarations.comment: all five clauses conjoined, stated through the `RingMapProperty` interface at the concrete property `Dualizing.gorensteinTarget`, whose value on a map is Gorensteinness of the target together with the Noetherian structure that Gorensteinness presupposes

registrations.name: Dualizing.IsGorensteinRing
registrations.comment: gorenstein_local and gorenstein_ground_field: this predicate is defined by the condition at every prime localization and takes no ground field as input

declarations.name: localCompleteIntersectionProperty_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJP, clause (A).** Being a local complete intersection is preserved by
base change along a finitely generated extension of the ground field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem localCompleteIntersectionProperty_fieldExtension (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      P (algebraMap k R) ↔ IsLocalCompleteIntersectionRing R) :
    ∀ (k K R : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R] [Algebra k K]
      [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K],
      P (algebraMap k R) →
        P (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := k) (A := R) (B := K)).toRingHom

declarations.name: localCompleteIntersectionProperty_localization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJP, clause (B).** Being a local complete intersection can be checked
after localizing at every prime.
declarations.statement:
public theorem localCompleteIntersectionProperty_localization (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      P (algebraMap k R) ↔ IsLocalCompleteIntersectionRing R) :
    ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, P (algebraMap k (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))) ↔
        P (algebraMap k R)

declarations.name: localCompleteIntersectionProperty_regularAscent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJP, clause (C).** For flat maps `A → B → C` of Noetherian rings with
`B → C` regular, if every fibre of `A → B` is a local complete intersection then so is every
fibre of `A → C`.

The fibre of `A → C` at a prime `𝔭` is the base change `D = (κ(𝔭) ⊗_A B) ⊗_B C` of the fibre of
`A → B` along `B → C`, which is flat, so
`LocalCompleteIntersection.isLocalCompleteIntersectionRing_of_flat_of_fiber` reduces the claim to
the fibres of `κ(𝔭) ⊗_A B → D`. At a prime `Q` of `κ(𝔭) ⊗_A B` lying over `𝔮 ⊆ B` that fibre is
`κ(Q) ⊗_{κ(𝔮)} (κ(𝔮) ⊗_B C)`; the extension `κ(𝔮) → κ(Q)` is bijective, so the geometric
regularity of `κ(𝔮) → κ(𝔮) ⊗_B C` makes it regular, hence a local complete intersection.
declarations.statement:
public theorem localCompleteIntersectionProperty_regularAscent (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      P (algebraMap k R) ↔ IsLocalCompleteIntersectionRing R) :
    ∀ (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.Flat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber B))) →
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.asIdeal.ResidueField (q.asIdeal.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber C))

declarations.name: localCompleteIntersectionProperty_faithfullyFlatDescent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJP, clause (D).** For flat maps `A → B → C` of Noetherian rings with
`B → C` faithfully flat, if every fibre of `A → C` is a local complete intersection then so is
every fibre of `A → B`.

The fibre of `A → C` at a prime `𝔭` is the base change along `B → C` of the fibre of `A → B`, and
that base change is faithfully flat, so
`LocalCompleteIntersection.isLocalCompleteIntersectionRing_of_faithfullyFlat` applies.
declarations.statement:
public theorem localCompleteIntersectionProperty_faithfullyFlatDescent
    (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      P (algebraMap k R) ↔ IsLocalCompleteIntersectionRing R) :
    ∀ (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.FaithfullyFlat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber C))) →
        ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber B))

declarations.name: localCompleteIntersectionProperty_groundFieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJP, clause (E).** Being a local complete intersection is unchanged
when the ground field is replaced by a separable algebraic extension of it inside the target: the
condition does not refer to the ground field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem localCompleteIntersectionProperty_groundFieldExtension (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      P (algebraMap k R) ↔ IsLocalCompleteIntersectionRing R) :
    ∀ (k K R : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k K] [Algebra k R] [Algebra K R] [IsScalarTower k K R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] [Algebra.IsSeparable k K],
      P (algebraMap k R) → P (algebraMap K R)

declarations.name: localCompleteIntersectionProperty_satisfies_formalFiberAxioms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJP.** The property of a map from a field to a Noetherian ring that its target is a
local complete intersection satisfies properties (A)--(E) of [Stacks, Tag 0BIR]: it is preserved
by finitely generated field extension, is local on the target, passes through a composition of
flat maps when the second map is regular, descends through a faithfully flat second map, and is
unchanged upon replacing the ground field by a separable algebraic extension.

The five clauses are `localCompleteIntersectionProperty_fieldExtension`,
`localCompleteIntersectionProperty_localization`,
`localCompleteIntersectionProperty_regularAscent`,
`localCompleteIntersectionProperty_faithfullyFlatDescent` and
`localCompleteIntersectionProperty_groundFieldExtension`. The shape is that of
`cohenMacaulayProperty_satisfies_formalFiberAxioms` ([Stacks, Tag 0BJ9]) and of
`Dualizing.gorensteinProperty_satisfies_formalFiberAxioms` ([Stacks, Tag 0BJN]).
declarations.statement:
public theorem localCompleteIntersectionProperty_satisfies_formalFiberAxioms
    (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hP : ∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      P (algebraMap k R) ↔ IsLocalCompleteIntersectionRing R) :
    (∀ (k K R : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R] [Algebra k K]
      [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K],
      P (algebraMap k R) →
        P (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := k) (A := R) (B := K)).toRingHom) ∧
    (∀ (k R : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        P (algebraMap k (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))) ↔ P (algebraMap k R)) ∧
    (∀ (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.Flat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber B))) →
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.asIdeal.ResidueField (q.asIdeal.Fiber C)) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber C))) ∧
    (∀ (A B C : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
      [Algebra A B] [Algebra B C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
      [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsNoetherianRing C]
      [Module.Flat A B] [Module.FaithfullyFlat B C],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber C))) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
        P (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber B))) ∧
    (∀ (k K R : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k K] [Algebra k R] [Algebra K R] [IsScalarTower k K R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] [Algebra.IsSeparable k K],
      P (algebraMap k R) → P (algebraMap K R))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyCutoff
declarations.doc:
The local cohomology finiteness cutoff
`s_{A,I}(M) = min_{p ∉ V(I), q ∈ V(I), p ⊆ q} (depth(Mₚ) + dim((A / p)ₒ))`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def localCohomologyCutoff (A : Type*) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] : ℕ∞

declarations.name: Module.localCohomologyCutoff_map_eq
declarations.doc:
For a finite homomorphism of Noetherian rings, extension of an ideal does not change the
local cohomology finiteness cutoff of a finite module if the source is universally catenary.
declarations.statement:
theorem localCohomologyCutoff_map_eq
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] [Module.Finite A B]
    (I : Ideal A) (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module B M]
    [IsScalarTower A B M] [Module.Finite B M] (hA : Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary A) :
    Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyCutoff B (Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) I) M =
      Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyCutoff A I M

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyCutoff_adicCompletion_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BJT.** Completion at the maximal ideal cannot increase the local cohomology
finiteness cutoff of a finite module over a universally catenary Noetherian local ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem localCohomologyCutoff_adicCompletion_le
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (hA : Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary A) :
    localCohomologyCutoff (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)
        (I.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)))
        (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) M) ≤
      localCohomologyCutoff A I M
declarations.comment: cutoff_completion_le

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.min_succ_le_localCohomologyCutoff_adicCompletion
declarations.doc:
If the formal fibres of a universally catenary Noetherian local ring
satisfy `(Sₙ)`, the cutoff after completion is at least the minimum of the
original cutoff and `n + 1`.
declarations.statement:
public lemma min_succ_le_localCohomologyCutoff_adicCompletion
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (n : ℕ) (hcatenary : Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary A)
    (hformal : FormalFibersHavePropertySk A n) :
    min ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) (localCohomologyCutoff A I M) ≤
      localCohomologyCutoff
        (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)
        (I.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)))
        (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) M)
declarations.comment: cutoff_completion_lower_bound_of_serre

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.finite_lt_and_not_finite_localCohomologyCutoff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJU.** Let `A` be a Gorenstein Noetherian local ring, let `I ⊆ A` be
an ideal, let `Z = V(I)` and let `M` be a finite `A`-module. Let `s = s_{A,I}(M)` be the cutoff
of Tag 0BJR. Then `H^i_Z(M)` is finite for every `i < s`, and `H^s_Z(M)` is not finite.

This is a special case of Satz 1 of Faltings, and it is obtained here as the special case
`omega = A[0]` of Faltings' finiteness criterion of Tag 0EFD, Gorensteinness of a Noetherian
local ring being precisely the statement that `A[0]` is a dualizing complex.

The first conjunct expresses `i < s` through a natural number `n` with `n < s` and `i ≤ n`; this
covers every degree when `s = ⊤`. The second conjunct is hypothesized on `s` being a natural
number, as it must be: the cutoff is an infimum in `ℕ∞` and there is no degree `⊤`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_lt_and_not_finite_localCohomologyCutoff
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hA : Dualizing.IsGorensteinLocalRing A) (I : Ideal A)
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M] :
    (∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℕ∞) < localCohomologyCutoff A I M → ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ (n : ℤ) →
        Module.Finite A
          (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)) ∧
      (∀ s : ℕ, localCohomologyCutoff A I M = (s : ℕ∞) →
        ¬ Module.Finite A
          (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
              (ModuleCat.of A M)) (s : ℤ)))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_of_lt_localCohomologyCutoff_of_formalFibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJV, finiteness below the cutoff.** Let `A` be a universally
catenary Noetherian ring whose local rings have Cohen–Macaulay formal fibres, let `I ⊆ A` be an
ideal, let `Z = V(I)` and let `M` be a finite `A`-module. Then `H^i_Z(M)` is a finite
`A`-module in every degree `i` strictly below the cutoff `s = s_{A,I}(M)` of Tag 0BJR.

The degrees `i < s` are expressed through a natural number `n` with `n < s` and `i ≤ n`, which
for `s = ⊤` gives finiteness in every degree.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_of_lt_localCohomologyCutoff_of_formalFibers
    (hA : Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary A)
    (hformal : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
      FormalFibersAreCohenMacaulay (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : ℕ∞) < localCohomologyCutoff A I M) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ (n : ℤ)) :
    Module.Finite A
      (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)
declarations.comment: finiteness in the degrees below the cutoff

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.not_finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_localCohomologyCutoff_of_formalFibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJV, non-finiteness at the cutoff.** In the situation of
`finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_of_lt_localCohomologyCutoff_of_formalFibers`, if the cutoff
`s = s_{A,I}(M)` is the natural number `s`, then `H^s_Z(M)` is *not* a finite `A`-module.

Were it finite it would join the finite modules in the degrees below `s` to make `H^i_Z(M)`
finite for all `i ≤ s`; testing that on the completion of the local ring at the prime at which
the cutoff is attained, Tag 0EFD would then force `s < s`. The hypothesis that the cutoff is a
natural number is needed as stated: the cutoff is an infimum in `ℕ∞` and there is no degree
`⊤`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem not_finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_localCohomologyCutoff_of_formalFibers
    (hA : Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary A)
    (hformal : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
      FormalFibersAreCohenMacaulay (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
    (s : ℕ) (hs : localCohomologyCutoff A I M = (s : ℕ∞)) :
    ¬ Module.Finite A
      (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) (s : ℤ))
declarations.comment: non-finiteness in the cutoff degree

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.finite_lt_and_not_finite_localCohomologyCutoff_of_formalFibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJV.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let `I ⊆ A` be an ideal, let
`Z = V(I) ⊆ Spec(A)` and let `M` be a finite `A`-module. Set `s = s_{A,I}(M)` as in Tag 0BJR.
Assume that `A` is universally catenary and that the formal fibres of the local rings of `A`
are Cohen–Macaulay. Then `H^i_Z(M)` is finite for `0 ≤ i < s`, and `H^s_Z(M)` is not finite.

This is a special case of Satz 2 of Faltings. The first conjunct expresses `i < s` through a
natural number `n` with `n < s` and `i ≤ n`, which covers every degree when `s = ⊤`; the second
is hypothesized on `s` being a natural number, as it must be.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_lt_and_not_finite_localCohomologyCutoff_of_formalFibers
    (hA : Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary A)
    (hformal : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
      FormalFibersAreCohenMacaulay (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℕ∞) < localCohomologyCutoff A I M → ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ (n : ℤ) →
        Module.Finite A
          (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)) ∧
      (∀ s : ℕ, localCohomologyCutoff A I M = (s : ℕ∞) →
        ¬ Module.Finite A
          (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
              (ModuleCat.of A M)) (s : ℤ)))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_of_lt_localCohomologyCutoff_of_serreFormalFibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJW, finiteness through a degree below the cutoff.** Let `A` be a
universally catenary Noetherian ring, let `I ⊆ A` be an ideal, let `Z = V(I)` and let `M` be a
finite `A`-module. Fix a natural number `n` strictly below the cutoff `s = s_{A,I}(M)` of Tag
0BJR and assume only that the formal fibres of the local rings of `A` satisfy Serre's condition
`(S_n)`. Then `H^i_Z(M)` is a finite `A`-module in every degree `i ≤ n`.

This is Tag 0BJV's finiteness clause with the Cohen–Macaulay hypothesis on the formal fibres
weakened to `(S_n)`, which is all the proof uses: the hypothesis enters only through the Tag
0BJT bound `lt_localCohomologyCutoff_adicCompletion_localization` at `k = n`. For `s = ⊤` the
statement gives finiteness in every degree, provided the formal fibres are `(S_n)` for the `n`
in question.
declarations.statement:
public theorem
    finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_of_lt_localCohomologyCutoff_of_serreFormalFibers
    (hA : Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary A) (n : ℕ)
    (hformal : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
      FormalFibersHavePropertySk (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) n)
    (hn : (n : ℕ∞) < localCohomologyCutoff A I M) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ (n : ℤ)) :
    Module.Finite A
      (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)
declarations.comment: finiteness through degree n when the formal fibres are (S_n)

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.not_finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_localCohomologyCutoff_of_serreFormalFibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJW, non-finiteness at the cutoff.** In the situation of
`finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_of_lt_localCohomologyCutoff_of_serreFormalFibers`, if the
cutoff `s = s_{A,I}(M)` is the natural number `s` and the formal fibres of the local rings of
`A` satisfy Serre's condition `(S_{s-1})`, then `H^s_Z(M)` is *not* a finite `A`-module.

Were it finite it would join the finite modules in the degrees below `s` — available from the
finiteness clause at `n = s - 1`, whose `(S_{s-1})` hypothesis is the one assumed here — to make
`H^i_Z(M)` finite for all `i ≤ s`; testing that on the completion of the local ring at the prime
at which the cutoff is attained, Tag 0EFD would then force `s < s`. The prime is produced by the
Tag 0BJT bound `exists_localCohomologyCutoff_adicCompletion_localization_eq` at `k = s - 1`,
which is the only place the formal-fibre hypothesis is used besides the finiteness clause. The
hypothesis that the cutoff is a natural number is needed as stated: the cutoff is an infimum in
`ℕ∞` and there is no degree `⊤`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem
    not_finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_localCohomologyCutoff_of_serreFormalFibers
    (hA : Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary A) (s : ℕ)
    (hformal : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
      FormalFibersHavePropertySk (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) (s - 1))
    (hs : localCohomologyCutoff A I M = (s : ℕ∞)) :
    ¬ Module.Finite A
      (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) (s : ℤ))
declarations.comment: non-finiteness in the cutoff degree when the formal fibres are (S_{s-1})

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.finite_lt_and_not_finite_localCohomologyCutoff_of_serreFormalFibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BJW.** In the situation of Tag 0BJV — `A` a Noetherian ring,
`I ⊆ A` an ideal, `Z = V(I) ⊆ Spec(A)`, `M` a finite `A`-module and `s = s_{A,I}(M)` the cutoff
of Tag 0BJR — assume `A` is universally catenary and make no assumption at all on the formal
fibres. Then both conclusions of Tag 0BJV survive under a Serre condition imposed one degree at
a time:

* given `n` with `s > n`, if the formal fibres of the local rings of `A` satisfy `(S_n)` then
  `H^i_Z(M)` is finite for `i ≤ n`;
* if `s` is a natural number and the formal fibres satisfy `(S_{s-1})` then `H^s_Z(M)` is not
  finite.

This is the whole remark in one statement; the two conjuncts are
`finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_of_lt_localCohomologyCutoff_of_serreFormalFibers` and
`not_finite_localCohomologyWithSupportIn_localCohomologyCutoff_of_serreFormalFibers`, and the
shape matches the combined carrier
`finite_lt_and_not_finite_localCohomologyCutoff_of_formalFibers` of Tag 0BJV, except that the
formal-fibre hypothesis is bound inside each conjunct because its Serre index depends on the
degree under discussion.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_lt_and_not_finite_localCohomologyCutoff_of_serreFormalFibers
    (hA : Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary A) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
          FormalFibersHavePropertySk (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) n) →
        (n : ℕ∞) < localCohomologyCutoff A I M → ∀ i : ℤ, i ≤ (n : ℤ) →
        Module.Finite A
          (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (ModuleCat.of A M)) i)) ∧
      (∀ s : ℕ, (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
          FormalFibersHavePropertySk (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) (s - 1)) →
        localCohomologyCutoff A I M = (s : ℕ∞) →
        ¬ Module.Finite A
          (localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
              (ModuleCat.of A M)) (s : ℤ)))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.forall_lt_depth_add_ringKrullDim_iff_forall_isCoherent_rightDerived
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BJY].** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian scheme, let `j : U → X` be the
inclusion of an open subscheme with complement `Z`, let `ℱ` be a coherent `𝒪_U`-module and let
`n ≥ 0` be an integer. Assume that `X` is universally catenary and that the formal fibres of
`𝒪_{X,z}` are `(Sₙ)` for every `z ∈ Z`. Then the following are equivalent:

* (a) for `x ∈ Supp(ℱ)` and `z ∈ Z ∩ closure {x}` we have
  `depth_{𝒪_{X,x}}(ℱ_x) + dim(𝒪_{closure {x}, z}) > n`;
* (b) `R^p j_* ℱ` is coherent for `0 ≤ p < n`.

The closure `closure {j(x)}` carries its reduced induced scheme structure, the closed subscheme
cut out by `Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal`, and a point `z ∈ Z ∩ closure {j(x)}` is a point
`y` of that subscheme whose image lies outside `j(U)`, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.range_subschemeι_vanishingIdeal_closure`. The depth is taken in the local ring
of `U` at `x`, which is that of `X` at `j(x)`. The inclusion is an arbitrary open immersion `j`,
which is the same statement: an open immersion is the inclusion of its open image composed with
an isomorphism.

The proof rewrites (a) pointwise by
`AlgebraicGeometry.ringKrullDim_stalk_vanishingIdeal_closure_eq_topCodim` into the condition of
`forall_lt_depth_add_topCodim_iff_forall_isCoherent_rightDerived`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem forall_lt_depth_add_ringKrullDim_iff_forall_isCoherent_rightDerived
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (F : U.Modules)
    [F.IsCoherent] (n : ℕ) (hX : Scheme.IsUniversallyCatenary X)
    (hformal : ∀ z : X, z ∉ Set.range j.base →
      Stacks.LocalCohomology.FormalFibersHavePropertySk (X.presheaf.stalk z) n) :
    (∀ x : U, x ∈ SheafOfModules.supp F →
        ∀ y : (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
            (Closeds.closure ({j.base x} : Set X))).subscheme,
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
            (Closeds.closure ({j.base x} : Set X))).subschemeι.base y ∉ Set.range j.base →
          (((n : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) <
            (Module.depth (U.presheaf.stalk x) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (U.presheaf.stalk x))
                (F.presheaf.stalk x) : WithBot ℕ∞) +
              ringKrullDim ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
                (Closeds.closure ({j.base x} : Set X))).subscheme.presheaf.stalk y))) ↔
      ∀ p : ℕ, p < n →
        (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).rightDerived p).obj F).IsCoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherenceFromPointClosures.isCoherent_pushforward_iff_forall_isAssociatedPoint
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BJZ].** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian scheme, let `j : U ⟶ X` be the
inclusion of an open subscheme and let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_U`-module. For `x ∈ U` let
`i_x : W_x → U` be the integral closed subscheme with generic point `x`. Then the following are
equivalent:

1. for all `x ∈ Ass(F)` the `𝒪_X`-module `j_* i_{x,*} 𝒪_{W_x}` is coherent;
2. `j_* F` is coherent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_pushforward_iff_forall_isAssociatedPoint {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (F : U.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    (∀ x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints F,
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj (pointClosureStructureSheaf x)).IsCoherent) ↔
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj F).IsCoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherenceFromPointClosures.isCoherent_pushforward_of_forall_isAssociatedPoint'
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BJZ], the implication (1) ⇒ (2).** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian scheme,
let `j : U ⟶ X` be the inclusion of an open subscheme and let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_U`-module. If
`j_* i_{x,*} 𝒪_{W_x}` is coherent for every `x ∈ Ass(F)`, then `j_* F` is coherent.

Coherence of a direct image is local on the target, and over an affine open of `X` the open
subscheme becomes Noetherian and quasi-affine, which is what the induction needs.

This is one direction of [Stacks, Tag 0BJZ]; the tag sits on the full equivalence
`isCoherent_pushforward_iff_forall_isAssociatedPoint`, in the module `CoherenceEquivalence` of
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.LocalCohomology.CoherentPushforwardCriterion`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_pushforward_of_forall_isAssociatedPoint' {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (F : U.Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (h : ∀ x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints F,
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj (pointClosureStructureSheaf x)).IsCoherent) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj F).IsCoherent
declarations.comment: (1) implies (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exact_lowDegreeSequence_and_nonempty_complementCohomology_iso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BK0] (2).** Let `R` be a Noetherian ring, let `I ⊆ R` be an ideal, let
`X = Spec R`, let `Z = V(I)` and let `U = X ∖ Z`.  Let `M` be an `R`-module and let `F` be a
sheaf of modules on `U` identified with `M̃|_U`.  Then the four-term sequence
`0 ⟶ H⁰_Z(M) ⟶ M ⟶ Γ(U, F) ⟶ H¹_Z(M) ⟶ 0`
built from the canonical map out of local cohomology, the restriction map and the connecting map
of the localization triangle is exact, and `H^p(U, F) ≅ H^{p+1}_Z(M)` as `R`-modules for every
`p ≥ 1`, with `H^p(U, F)` the cohomology of `F` on `U` read over `R`
(`Stacks.LocalCohomology.complementSheafCohomology`).

Neither half needs `M` finite or `F` coherent, which the source assumes.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_lowDegreeSequence_and_nonempty_complementCohomology_iso
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I.FG)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (F : (complementZeroLocus R I : Scheme).Modules)
    (e : F ≅ complementTilde R I M) :
    (∃ D : LocalizationTriangleData.{u, u} R I hI,
        Function.Injective (localCohomologyZeroToModule R I hI M) ∧
        Function.Exact (localCohomologyZeroToModule R I hI M)
          (restrictionToComplement D M F e) ∧
        Function.Exact (restrictionToComplement D M F e) (localizationBoundary D M F e) ∧
        Function.Surjective (localizationBoundary D M F e)) ∧
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p →
        Nonempty ((complementSheafCohomology R I p).obj F ≅
          localCohomologyModule R I hI M ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.coherent_complement_affine
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BK0].** Let `R` be a Noetherian ring, let `I ⊆ R` be an ideal, let
`X = Spec R`, let `Z = V(I)`, let `U = X ∖ Z` and let `j : U → X` be the inclusion.  Let `F` be a
coherent `𝒪_U`-module.  Then

1. there is a finite `R`-module `M` such that `F` is the restriction of `M̃` to `U`;
2. given `M` there is an exact sequence
   `0 ⟶ H⁰_Z(M) ⟶ M ⟶ Γ(U, F) ⟶ H¹_Z(M) ⟶ 0`
   and isomorphisms `H^p(U, F) ≅ H^{p+1}_Z(M)` for `p ≥ 1`;
3. given `M` and `p ≥ 0` the following are equivalent: `R^pj_*F` is coherent, `H^p(U, F)` is a
   finite `R`-module, and `H^{p+1}_Z(M)` is a finite `R`-module;
4. if the equivalent conditions of (3) hold for `p = 0` then `M` may be taken to be `Γ(U, F)`,
   which is then a finite `R`-module whose associated sheaf restricts to `F` on `U` and which
   satisfies `H⁰_Z(Γ(U, F)) = H¹_Z(Γ(U, F)) = 0`.

Clauses (2), (3) and (4) are stated for every finite `M` identifying `F` with `M̃|_U`, which is
what "given `M`" means: the identification is part of the data and clause (1) produces one.
`H^p(U, F)` is the cohomology of `F` on `U` read over `R`
(`Stacks.LocalCohomology.complementSheafCohomology`) and `j` is the inclusion of `U`; clause
(4)'s hypothesis is condition (c) of clause (3) in degree zero.  The
hypothesis `hI : I.FG` is implied by `[IsNoetherianRing R]` through
`Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing`.

Each clause is also registered on the declaration that proves it; nothing new is proved here.
declarations.statement:
theorem coherent_complement_affine
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I.FG)
    (F : (complementZeroLocus R I : Scheme).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    (∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} R, Module.Finite R M ∧ Nonempty (F ≅ complementTilde R I M)) ∧
      ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R, Module.Finite R M → ∀ e : F ≅ complementTilde R I M,
        ((∃ D : LocalizationTriangleData.{u, u} R I hI,
              Function.Injective (localCohomologyZeroToModule R I hI M) ∧
              Function.Exact (localCohomologyZeroToModule R I hI M)
                (restrictionToComplement D M F e) ∧
              Function.Exact (restrictionToComplement D M F e)
                (localizationBoundary D M F e) ∧
              Function.Surjective (localizationBoundary D M F e)) ∧
            ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p →
              Nonempty ((complementSheafCohomology R I p).obj F ≅
                localCohomologyModule R I hI M ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) ∧
          (∀ p : ℕ,
            [(((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (complementZeroLocus R I).ι).rightDerived p).obj
                F).IsCoherent,
              Module.Finite R ((complementSheafCohomology R I p).obj F),
              Module.Finite R (localCohomologyModule R I hI M ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))].TFAE) ∧
          (Module.Finite R (localCohomologyModule R I hI M 1) →
            Module.Finite R (complementGlobalSections R I F) ∧
              Nonempty (F ≅ complementTilde R I (complementGlobalSections R I F)) ∧
              IsZero (localCohomologyModule R I hI (complementGlobalSections R I F) 0) ∧
              IsZero (localCohomologyModule R I hI (complementGlobalSections R I F) 1))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.moduleFinite_complementCohomologyBase_iff_isCoherent
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BK0] (3), the equivalence of (a) and (b).** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring,
`I ⊆ A` an ideal, `X = Spec A`, `Z = V(I)`, `U = X ∖ Z` and `j : U → X` the inclusion.  For an
`A`-module `M` and any `p ≥ 0` the higher direct image `R^pj_*(M̃|_U)` is coherent if and only if
`H^p(U, M̃)` is a finite `A`-module.

By clause (1) of the same tag every coherent `𝒪_U`-module is isomorphic to a restriction `M̃|_U`
with `M` finite, so this is that clause's equivalence; no finiteness of `M` is needed for the
equivalence itself.

The cohomology of `U` as computed by `complementCohomology` — the derived functor of the sections
over `U` of sheaves of modules on the *ambient* `X` — is identified with the cohomology of the
restriction on the open subscheme `U` by `derivedSectionsOnOpenIso`, which is [Stacks, Tag 01E1]
(2); the latter is what [Stacks, Tag 01XK] over the affine base `X` turns into coherence of the
higher direct image.
declarations.statement:
public theorem moduleFinite_complementCohomologyBase_iff_isCoherent [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal (ToType A)) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (p : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite A (complementCohomologyBase I M p) ↔
      (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroLocusCompl I).ι).rightDerived p).obj
        ((tilde M).restrict (zeroLocusCompl I).ι)).IsCoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.isCoherent_rightDerived_iff_finite_localCohomology
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BK0] (3), the equivalence of (a) and (c).** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring,
`I ⊆ A` an ideal, `X = Spec A`, `Z = V(I)`, `U = X ∖ Z` and `j : U → X` the inclusion. For a
finite `A`-module `M` and any `p ≥ 0` the higher direct image `R^pj_*(M̃|_U)` is coherent if and
only if the local cohomology `H^{p+1}_Z(M)` is a finite `A`-module.
