This is the composite of the tag's (a) ⟺ (b), which is
`moduleFinite_complementCohomologyBase_iff_isCoherent`, with its (b) ⟺ (c), which is
`finite_complementCohomologyBase_iff_finite_localCohomology`; the intermediate module is
`H^p(U, M̃)` in both.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCoherent_rightDerived_iff_finite_localCohomology [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M] (p : ℕ) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroLocusCompl I).ι).rightDerived p).obj
        ((tilde M).restrict (zeroLocusCompl I).ι)).IsCoherent ↔
      Module.Finite A (Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A
        (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj M) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteModule_tilde_restrict_zeroLocusCompl
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK0 (1).** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let `I ⊆ A` be an ideal and
let `U = Spec A \ V(I)`. A coherent `𝒪_U`-module is the restriction to `U` of the sheaf `M̃`
attached to a finite `A`-module `M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteModule_tilde_restrict_zeroLocusCompl {A : CommRingCat.{u}}
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (F : (zeroLocusCompl I).toScheme.Modules)
    [F.IsCoherent] :
    ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} A, Module.Finite A M ∧
      Nonempty ((tilde M).restrict (zeroLocusCompl I).ι ≅ F)

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.exact_localCohomology_sequence_span_singleton
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK0 (2) for a principal ideal.**  Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let
`f : A` and write `X = Spec A`, `Z = V(f)` and `U = X ∖ Z`.  For an `A`-module `M` there is a
connecting map `H⁰(U, M̃) ⟶ H¹_Z(M)` for which the sequence

`0 ⟶ H⁰_Z(M) ⟶ H⁰(X, M̃) ⟶ H⁰(U, M̃) ⟶ H¹_Z(M) ⟶ 0`

is exact, and `H^p(U, M̃) ≅ H^{p+1}_Z(M)` for every `p ≥ 1`, with `H^i_Z(M)` the algebraic
local cohomology of `M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_localCohomology_sequence_span_singleton [IsNoetherianRing A] (f : A)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) :
    ∃ (d : (globalToBase A).obj
          ((complementCohomology (Ideal.span {f}) 0).obj (tildeSheaf M)) ⟶
        (localCohomologySpanSingleton A f 1).obj M)
      (hir : localCohomologyToGlobalSections f M ≫ (globalToBase A).map
        ((complementRestriction (Ideal.span {f}) 0).app (tildeSheaf M)) = 0)
      (hrd : (globalToBase A).map
        ((complementRestriction (Ideal.span {f}) 0).app (tildeSheaf M)) ≫ d = 0),
      Mono (localCohomologyToGlobalSections f M) ∧ (ShortComplex.mk _ _ hir).Exact ∧
        (ShortComplex.mk _ _ hrd).Exact ∧ Epi d ∧
        ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → Nonempty ((globalToBase A).obj
          ((complementCohomology (Ideal.span {f}) p).obj (tildeSheaf M)) ≅
            (localCohomologySpanSingleton A f (p + 1)).obj M)
declarations.comment: (2), principal ideal

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.finite_complementCohomologyBase_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK0 (3), the equivalence of (b) and (c)**, with cohomology with
support in place of local cohomology.  Let `I` be an ideal of a ring `A`, let `X = Spec A`, let
`Z = V(I)` and let `U = X ∖ Z`.  For a finite `A`-module `M` and any `p ≥ 0` the `A`-module
`H^p(U, M̃)` is finite if and only if `H^{p+1}_Z(X, M̃)` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_complementCohomologyBase_iff (I : Ideal A) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    [Module.Finite A M] (p : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite A (complementCohomologyBase I M p) ↔
      Module.Finite A (cohomologyWithSupportBase I M (p + 1))
declarations.comment: (3), (b) ⟺ (c), with cohomology with support in place of local cohomology

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.finite_localCohomology_iff_span_singleton
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK0 (3) for a principal ideal, the equivalence of (b) and (c).**  Let
`A` be a Noetherian ring, let `f : A`, let `X = Spec A`, let `Z = V(f)` and let `U = X ∖ Z`.  For
a finite `A`-module `M` and any `p ≥ 0` the `A`-module `H^p(U, M̃)` is finite if and only if the
local cohomology `H^{p+1}_Z(M)` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_localCohomology_iff_span_singleton [IsNoetherianRing A] (f : A)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M] (p : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite A (complementCohomologyBase (Ideal.span {f}) M p) ↔
      Module.Finite A ((localCohomologySpanSingleton A f (p + 1)).obj M)
declarations.comment: (3), (b) ⟺ (c), principal ideal

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.isZero_cohomologyWithSupport_of_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK0 (4), the vanishing.**  Let `I` be an ideal of a ring `A`, let
`X = Spec A`, let `Z = V(I)` and let `U = X ∖ Z`.  If the canonical map `M ⟶ Γ(U, M̃)` is an
isomorphism — which is what taking `M = Γ(U, ℱ)` achieves — then `H⁰_Z(X, M̃) = 0` and
`H¹_Z(X, M̃) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomologyWithSupport_of_isIso (I : Ideal A) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (h : IsIso (toComplementSections I M)) :
    IsZero (cohomologyWithSupportBase I M 0) ∧ IsZero (cohomologyWithSupportBase I M 1)
declarations.comment: (4), the vanishing, for a module whose canonical map to the sections over the complement is an isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.isZero_localCohomology_of_isIso_span_singleton
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK0 (4) for a principal ideal, the vanishing.**  Let `A` be a
Noetherian ring, let `f : A`, let `X = Spec A`, let `Z = V(f)` and let `U = X ∖ Z`.  If the
canonical map `M ⟶ Γ(U, M̃)` is an isomorphism then the local cohomology modules `H⁰_Z(M)` and
`H¹_Z(M)` are zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_localCohomology_of_isIso_span_singleton [IsNoetherianRing A] (f : A)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (h : IsIso (toComplementSections (Ideal.span {f}) M)) :
    IsZero ((localCohomologySpanSingleton A f 0).obj M) ∧
      IsZero ((localCohomologySpanSingleton A f 1).obj M)
declarations.comment: (4), the vanishing, principal ideal, for a module whose canonical map to the sections over the complement is an isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.exact_cohomologyWithSupport_sequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK0 (2)**, with cohomology with support in place of local cohomology.
For an ideal `I` of a ring `A` and an `A`-module `M`, write `X = Spec A`, `Z = V(I)` and
`U = X ∖ Z`.  There is a connecting map `H^n(U, M̃) ⟶ H^{n+1}_Z(X, M̃)` for which the sequence

`0 ⟶ H⁰_Z(X, M̃) ⟶ Γ(X, M̃) ⟶ Γ(U, M̃) ⟶ H¹_Z(X, M̃) ⟶ 0`

is exact and `H^p(U, M̃) ⟶ H^{p+1}_Z(X, M̃)` is an isomorphism for every `p ≥ 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_cohomologyWithSupport_sequence (I : Ideal A) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) :
    ∃ delta : ∀ n : ℕ, complementCohomology I n ⟶ cohomologyWithSupport I (n + 1),
      Mono ((supportInclusion I 0).app (tildeSheaf M)) ∧
      (ComposableArrows.mk₃ ((supportInclusion I 0).app (tildeSheaf M))
        ((complementRestriction I 0).app (tildeSheaf M))
        ((delta 0).app (tildeSheaf M))).Exact ∧
      Epi ((delta 0).app (tildeSheaf M)) ∧
      ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → IsIso ((delta p).app (tildeSheaf M))
declarations.comment: (2), with cohomology with support in place of local cohomology

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.finite_complementCohomologyBase_iff_finite_localCohomology
declarations.doc:
**The finiteness consequence of Stacks 0DWR, in every degree.** For a finite module `M` over
a Noetherian ring the `A`-module `H^p(U, M̃)` on `U = Spec A ∖ V(I)` is finite exactly when the
local cohomology `H^{p+1}_{V(I)}(M)` is, for every `p ≥ 0`.

In degree zero this is the four-term exact sequence of Stacks 0DWR, which presents `Γ(U, M̃)` as
an extension of `H¹_{V(I)}(M)` by a quotient of `M`; in degrees above zero it is the isomorphism
above.

This is **Stacks 0BK0 (3), the equivalence of (b) and (c)**, for an arbitrary ideal `I` of a
Noetherian ring `A` (the tag's own hypothesis on `A`, not an additional one) and every `p ≥ 0`:
no finite generation of `I` beyond what `A` Noetherian already gives, and no restriction to a
principal ideal, is needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_complementCohomologyBase_iff_finite_localCohomology
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M] (p : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite A (complementCohomologyBase I M p) ↔
      Module.Finite A (Stacks.LocalCohomology.localCohomologyWithSupportIn.{u, u} A
        (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj M) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.exact_lowDegreeSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BK0, the low-degree sequence.** Let `I` be a finitely generated ideal of a
commutative ring `A`, let `U = Spec A \ V(I)`, let `M` be an `A`-module and let `F` be a sheaf of
modules on `U` identified with the restriction to `U` of the sheaf associated to `M`. Then the
four-term sequence
`0 ⟶ H⁰_I(M) ⟶ M ⟶ Γ(U, F) ⟶ H¹_I(M) ⟶ 0`
is exact: the map out of degree-zero local cohomology is injective, the sequence is exact at `M`
and at `Γ(U, F)`, and the connecting map onto `H¹_I(M)` is surjective.

Every ideal of a Noetherian ring is finitely generated, by `Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing`, so
this covers the Noetherian hypothesis of the source; and it does not assume `M` finite or `F`
coherent, which the source does.

The same four-term sequence is the first half of clause (2) of Stacks 0DWR, which assumes only
that `I` is finitely generated. The second half of that clause, the comparison
`H^p(U, F) ≅ H^{p+1}_I(M)` in degrees `p ≥ 1`, `A`-linearly and for the same `F` and `M`, is
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.nonempty_complementSheafCohomology_iso_localCohomologyModule`, under the
same hypothesis `I.FG`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exact_lowDegreeSequence (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} A)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{max u v} (complementZeroLocus A I : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)
    (e : F ≅ complementTilde A I M) :
    Function.Injective (localCohomologyZeroToModule A I hI M).hom ∧
      Function.Exact (localCohomologyZeroToModule A I hI M)
        (restrictionToComplement (localizationTriangleData.{v} A I hI) M F e) ∧
      Function.Exact (restrictionToComplement (localizationTriangleData.{v} A I hI) M F e)
        (localizationBoundary (localizationTriangleData.{v} A I hI) M F e) ∧
      Function.Surjective (localizationBoundary (localizationTriangleData.{v} A I hI) M F e)
declarations.comment: low_degree_sequence

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.finite_iso_restrict_and_isZero_localCohomology_globalSectionsModule
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BK0] (4).** Let `I` be a finitely generated ideal of `A`, let
`U = Spec A \ V(I)`, let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_U`-module and let `M` be a finite `A`-module
with `F ≅ M̃|_U`.  If the equivalent conditions of clause (3) hold in degree zero, in the form
`H¹_{V(I)}(M)` finite, then `N = Γ(U, F)` is itself an admissible choice for `M`: it is a finite
`A`-module, `F` is the restriction of `Ñ` to `U`, and `H⁰_{V(I)}(N) = H¹_{V(I)}(N) = 0`.

Finiteness of `N` comes from the four-term sequence of clause (2), which presents `Γ(U, F)` as an
extension of `H¹_{V(I)}(M)` by a quotient of `M`.  The isomorphism `F ≅ Ñ|_U` is the counit of
the tilde–Gamma adjunction, and the two vanishing statements are the degeneration of the
four-term sequence at the extension `N`, whose restriction map `N ⟶ Γ(U, F)` is the identity.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_iso_restrict_and_isZero_localCohomology_globalSectionsModule
    (F : (complementZeroLocus A I : Scheme).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M] (e : F ≅ complementTilde A I M)
    (hfin : Module.Finite A (localCohomologyModule A I hI M 1)) :
    Module.Finite A (complementGlobalSections A I F) ∧
      Nonempty (F ≅ complementTilde A I (complementGlobalSections A I F)) ∧
      IsZero (localCohomologyModule A I hI (complementGlobalSections A I F) 0) ∧
      IsZero (localCohomologyModule A I hI (complementGlobalSections A I F) 1)

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isCoherent_pushforward_structureSheaf_of_completion_associatedPrime_dim
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BK1].** Let `X` be an integral locally Noetherian scheme and let `j : U ⟶ X`
be the inclusion of a nonempty open subscheme with complement `Z`. Assume that for every `z ∈ Z`
and every associated prime `𝔭` of the completed local ring `𝒪^∧_{X,z}` one has
`dim(𝒪^∧_{X,z} ⧸ 𝔭) ≥ 2`. Then `j_*𝒪_U` is coherent.

The proof is the source's. The reduction to the punctured spectra of the local rings along the
complement is `Stacks.LocalCohomology.puncturedSpectrumReduction`, and at a point `z` of the
complement the punctured spectrum of `𝒪_{X,z}` has coherent direct image by
`isCoherent_pushforward_structureSheaf_puncturedSpectrum`, whose hypothesis is `hdim` at `z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_pushforward_structureSheaf_of_completion_associatedPrime_dim
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    [Nonempty U]
    (hdim : ∀ z : X, z ∉ Set.range j.base →
      ∀ p : Ideal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk z)) (X.presheaf.stalk z)),
        IsAssociatedPrimeStacks
          (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk z)) (X.presheaf.stalk z))
          (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk z)) (X.presheaf.stalk z)) p →
        (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (AdicCompletion
          (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk z)) (X.presheaf.stalk z) ⧸ p)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj (SheafOfModules.unit.{u} U.ringCatSheaf)).IsCoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ClosedImmersionCoherence.isCoherent_pushforward_pointClosure_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK2.** Coherence of the direct image to `X` of the structure sheaf of
the reduced closure of `{x}` in `U` is equivalent to coherence of its direct image to the reduced
closure of `{j x}` in `X`: the two iterated direct images agree, and the remaining vertical arrow
is a closed immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_pushforward_pointClosure_iff {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsLocallyNoetherian U] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (x : U)
    (j' : (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subscheme ⟶
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme)
    (comm : j' ≫ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subschemeι =
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subschemeι ≫ j) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subschemeι).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
            (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subscheme.ringCatSheaf))).IsCoherent ↔
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j').obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subscheme.ringCatSheaf)).IsCoherent
declarations.comment: coherence equivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_isOpenImmersion_pointClosure
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK2.** For an open immersion `j : U ⟶ X` and a point `x` of `U`, the
reduced closure of `{x}` in `U` is an open subscheme of the reduced closure of `{j x}` in `X`,
compatibly with the two closed immersions: there is an open immersion `j'` making the square of
canonical inclusions commute.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpenImmersion_pointClosure {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian U] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (x : U) :
    let W := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subscheme
    let Z := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme
    ∃ j' : W ⟶ Z, IsOpenImmersion j' ∧
      j' ≫ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subschemeι =
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subschemeι ≫ j
declarations.comment: commutative square of closures

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_of_pointClosureSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK2.** The square of point closures is cartesian: the reduced closure
of `{x}` in `U` is exactly the part of the reduced closure of `{j x}` in `X` lying over `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_of_pointClosureSquare {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (x : U)
    (j' : (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subscheme ⟶
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme)
    (comm : j' ≫ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subschemeι =
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subschemeι ≫ j) :
    Set.range j'.base = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subschemeι.base ⁻¹' Set.range j.base
declarations.comment: cartesianness of the square of closures

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPointClosureIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK2.** The canonical comparison of the two iterated direct images of
the structure sheaf of the reduced closure of `{x}` around the commutative square of point
closures: pushing forward first to `U` and then to `X` agrees with pushing forward first to the
closure of `{j x}` and then to `X`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pushforwardPointClosureIso {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) (x : U)
    (j' : (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subscheme ⟶
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme)
    (comm : j' ≫ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subschemeι =
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subschemeι ≫ j) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subschemeι).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
            (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subscheme.ringCatSheaf)) ≅
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subschemeι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j').obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
            (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set U))).subscheme.ringCatSheaf))
declarations.comment: direct-image comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackPointClosureIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BK2.** The comparison of direct images of the structure sheaf of a
point closure in the inverse image direction: the restriction to the open subscheme `V` of the
direct image of `𝒪_Z` along the closure of `{V.ι x}` in `X` is the direct image of `𝒪_W` along
the closure of `{x}` in `V`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pullbackPointClosureIso {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (V : X.Opens) (x : V.toScheme)
    (j' : (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set V.toScheme))).subscheme ⟶
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({V.ι.base x} : Set X))).subscheme)
    (comm : j' ≫ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({V.ι.base x} : Set X))).subschemeι =
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set V.toScheme))).subschemeι ≫ V.ι) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({V.ι.base x} : Set X))).subschemeι).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit.{u} (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({V.ι.base x} : Set X))).subscheme.ringCatSheaf)) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set V.toScheme))).subschemeι).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit.{u} (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({x} : Set V.toScheme))).subscheme.ringCatSheaf)
declarations.comment: inverse-image comparison

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentPushforwardCriterion.not_isCoherent_pushforward_of_isAssociatedPrime_completedStalk_le_one
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BK3], the implication (1) ⇒ (2), in contrapositive form at a single point,
for an associated quotient of dimension at most one.** Let `j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion of
schemes with `X` locally Noetherian, let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_U`-module and let `x` be a
point of `U`. Suppose there is a monomorphism `i_{x,*} 𝒪_{W_x} ⟶ F`, and suppose `z` is a point
of the reduced closure of `{j x}` whose image in `X` lies outside `U` such that the completion
`𝒪^∧_{closure {x}, z}` has an associated prime `𝔭` with
`dim(𝒪^∧_{closure {x}, z} ⧸ 𝔭) ≤ 1`. Then `j_* F` is not coherent.

This is the failure of clause (2) of the source at `x` and `z` obstructing clause (1), with the
dimension hypothesis exactly as the negation of that clause delivers it. The monomorphism still
replaces the source's `x ∈ Ass(F)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isCoherent_pushforward_of_isAssociatedPrime_completedStalk_le_one {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (x : U)
    {F : U.Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (φ : pointClosureStructureSheaf x ⟶ F) [Mono φ]
    {I : X.IdealSheafData}
    (hI : I = Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X)))
    (z : I.subscheme) (hz : I.subschemeι z ∉ j.opensRange)
    {p : PrimeSpectrum (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z)}
    (hp : IsAssociatedPrimeStacks (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z)
      (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z) p.asIdeal)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z ⧸ p.asIdeal) ≤ 1) :
    ¬ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj F).IsCoherent
declarations.comment: (1) implies (2), contrapositive at one point, given a monomorphism from the structure sheaf of the point closure

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentPushforwardCriterion.two_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_completedStalk_of_isCoherent_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BK3], the implication (1) ⇒ (2).** Let `j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion of
schemes with `X` locally Noetherian and let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_U`-module whose direct
image `j_* F` is coherent. Then for every point `x` of `U` admitting a monomorphism
`i_{x,*} 𝒪_{W_x} ⟶ F`, every point `z` of the reduced closure of `{j x}` whose image in `X` lies
outside `U`, and every associated prime `𝔭` of the completion `𝒪^∧_{closure {x}, z}`, one has
`dim(𝒪^∧_{closure {x}, z} ⧸ 𝔭) ≥ 2`.

This is clause (2) of the source, asserted at every triple rather than at one fixed in advance,
and with the source's own dimension bound. The monomorphism replaces the source's
`x ∈ Ass(F)`, which enters the argument only through the map it produces; it is the one
hypothesis of the source's statement that is not yet discharged.
declarations.statement:
theorem two_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_completedStalk_of_isCoherent_pushforward
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    {F : U.Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj F).IsCoherent) :
    ∀ (x : U) (φ : pointClosureStructureSheaf x ⟶ F), Mono φ →
      ∀ I : X.IdealSheafData,
        I = Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X)) →
        ∀ z : I.subscheme, I.subschemeι z ∉ j.opensRange →
          ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z),
            IsAssociatedPrimeStacks (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z)
              (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z) p.asIdeal →
            2 ≤ ringKrullDim (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z ⧸ p.asIdeal)
declarations.comment: (1) implies (2), given a monomorphism from the structure sheaf of the point closure

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentPushforwardCriterion.not_isCoherent_pushforward_of_isAssociatedPrime_completedStalk
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BK3], the implication (1) ⇒ (2), in contrapositive form at a single point.**
Let `j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion of schemes with `X` locally Noetherian, let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_U`-module and let `x` be a point of `U`. Write `W_x` for the reduced closure
of `{x}` in `U` and `closure {x}` for the reduced closure of `{j x}` in `X`. Suppose there is a
monomorphism `i_{x,*} 𝒪_{W_x} ⟶ F`, and suppose `z` is a point of `closure {x}` whose image in
`X` lies outside `U` such that the completion `𝒪^∧_{closure {x}, z}` has an associated prime `𝔭`
with `dim(𝒪^∧_{closure {x}, z} ⧸ 𝔭) = 1`. Then `j_* F` is not coherent.

This is the failure of clause (2) of the source at `x` and `z` obstructing clause (1). The
monomorphism replaces the source's `x ∈ Ass(F)`, which enters the argument only through the map
it produces; and the associated quotient is assumed one-dimensional rather than at most
one-dimensional. See the module documentation for why neither restriction is avoidable here.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isCoherent_pushforward_of_isAssociatedPrime_completedStalk {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (x : U)
    {F : U.Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (φ : pointClosureStructureSheaf x ⟶ F) [Mono φ]
    {I : X.IdealSheafData}
    (hI : I = Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X)))
    (z : I.subscheme) (hz : I.subschemeι z ∉ j.opensRange)
    {p : PrimeSpectrum (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z)}
    (hp : IsAssociatedPrimeStacks (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z)
      (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z) p.asIdeal)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (I.subscheme.completedLocalRingCat z ⧸ p.asIdeal) = 1) :
    ¬ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj F).IsCoherent
declarations.comment: (1) implies (2), contrapositive at one point, for a one-dimensional associated quotient of the completion and given a monomorphism from the structure sheaf of the point closure

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomology.isCoherent_pushforward_iff_forall_two_le_ringKrullDim
declarations.doc:
**Kollár's criterion.** Let `j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion with `X`
locally Noetherian and let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_U`-module. Then `j_*F` is coherent if and only
if for every associated point `x` of `F`, every point `w` of the reduced closure of `{j x}` in
`X` whose image lies outside the image of `j`, and every associated prime `𝔭` of the completed
local ring of that closure at `w`, one has `2 ≤ dim` of the corresponding quotient.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_pushforward_iff_forall_two_le_ringKrullDim
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (F : U.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj F).IsCoherent ↔
      ∀ x : U, x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints F →
        ∀ w : (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme,
          (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
            (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subschemeι.base w ∉ Set.range j.base →
          ∀ p : Ideal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
              (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme.presheaf.stalk w))
            ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
              (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme.presheaf.stalk w)),
            IsAssociatedPrimeStacks
              (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
                  (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme.presheaf.stalk w))
                ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
                  (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme.presheaf.stalk w))
              (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
                  (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme.presheaf.stalk w))
                ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
                  (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme.presheaf.stalk w)) p →
            (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (AdicCompletion
              (maximalIdeal ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
                (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme.presheaf.stalk w))
              ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
                (Closeds.closure ({j x} : Set X))).subscheme.presheaf.stalk w) ⧸ p)

declarations.name: Module.depth_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_of_mem_associatedPrimes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BK4**. Let `(R, 𝔪)` be a Noetherian local ring and `M` a finite `R`-module. If `𝔭`
is an associated prime of `M`, then `depth(M) ≤ dim(R/𝔭)`, the depth being taken along `𝔪`.

The source states this as `dim(R/𝔭) ≥ depth(M)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem depth_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_of_mem_associatedPrimes {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Finite R M] {p : Ideal R} (hp : p ∈ associatedPrimes R M) :
    (depth R (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) M : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p)

declarations.name: CochainComplex.isBounded_and_converges_of_eventually_isZero_of_eventually_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BK5.** Let `𝒜` be an abelian category and let `(K^•, F)` be a filtered complex of
`𝒜` such that, for every `n`, `H^n(F^pK^•) = 0` for `p ≫ 0` and `H^n(F^pK^•) ⟶ H^n(K^•)` is an
isomorphism for `p ≪ 0`. Let `E` be the spectral sequence of `(K^•, F)`, presented as in
`isBounded_and_converges_of_isDegreewiseFinite` by its pages `Z_r^{p,q}/D_r^{p,q}`, and let
`F^p H^n(K^•) = Im(H^n(F^pK^•) ⟶ H^n(K^•))`. Then:

1. `E` is bounded: for every `n` only finitely many `E_1^{p, n-p}` are nonzero;
2. the induced filtration on each `H^n(K^•)` is finite;
3. `E` converges to `H^*(K^•)`: it is regular, the stable cycles and boundaries exist and equality
   holds in (012S) and (012T), and the resulting canonical comparison
   `E_∞^{p, n-p} ≅ gr^p H^n(K^•)` of [Stacks, Tag 012V] is an isomorphism.

Boundedness is stated on the first page, where the source's proof establishes it: under these
hypotheses `E_0^{p, q} = gr^p K^{p+q}` need not vanish for `|p| ≫ 0` (take any acyclic complex
with a nowhere-stationary filtration by acyclic subcomplexes), so the source's spectral sequence
is bounded as a spectral sequence starting at `r = 1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isBounded_and_converges_of_eventually_isZero_of_eventually_isIso
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    (K : FilteredObject (CochainComplex A ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ)
    (F : ∀ (_p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F p n = Subobject.mk ((K.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n))
    (Z : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hZ : ∀ r p n : ℤ, Z r p n =
      F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1)))
    (D : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hD : ∀ r p n : ℤ, D r p n = Z (r - 1) (p + 1) n ⊔
      (Subobject.«exists» (K.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Z (r - 1) (p - r + 1) (n - 1)))
    (FH : ∀ (n _p : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.homology n))
    (hFH : ∀ n p : ℤ, FH n p =
      imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))
    (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence A 0)
    (hE : ∀ (r p q n : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (_ : n = p + q), (E.page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
      cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : D r p n ⊓ Z r p n ≤ Z r p n)))
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₀ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p₀ ≤ p →
      IsZero ((K.filtration.obj (op p)).homology n))
    (hiso : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p₁ : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ p₁ →
      IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)) :
    (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
    (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ FH n a = ⊤ ∧ FH n b = ⊥) ∧
    (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r), b ≤ r →
      (E.page r hr).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0) ∧
    (∀ p n : ℤ,
      IsGLB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
          F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1)) ⊔
            F (p + 1) n)
        (kernelSubobject (K.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n) ∧
      IsLUB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
          F p n ⊓ (Subobject.«exists» (K.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (F (p - r) (n - 1)) ⊔
            F (p + 1) n)
        (imageSubobject (K.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n)) ∧
    (∀ p n : ℤ,
      let C := (Subobject.pullback (K.X.iCycles n)).obj (F p n)
      let N := kernelSubobject (K.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n
      let B := imageSubobject (K.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n
      ∃ (a : (C : A) ⟶ (N : A))
        (b : (C : A) ⟶ image (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))
        (e : cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≅
          cokernel (image.preComp
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.diagram.map
              (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))),
        C.arrow ≫ K.X.iCycles n = a ≫ N.arrow ∧
        C.arrow ≫ K.X.homologyπ n =
          b ≫ image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n) ∧
        a ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≫ e.hom =
          b ≫ cokernel.π (image.preComp
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.diagram.map
              (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
              (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.KInjectiveProduct.product_isKInjective
declarations.doc: Statement 1. A product of K-injective complexes is K-injective.
declarations.statement: alias product_isKInjective

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.KInjectiveProduct.product_repr_derived
declarations.doc:
Statement 2. The product complex `∏ᶜ X` represents the product of the family `(I_t)`
in the derived category `D(A)`: for every complex `K`, the natural comparison map
`Hom_{D(A)}(K, ∏ᶜ X) → ∏ₜ Hom_{D(A)}(K, I_t)` induced by the projections is a bijection
(hence an isomorphism of abelian groups).
declarations.statement:
theorem product_repr_derived [HasDerivedCategory C]
    {T : Type} (X : T → CochainComplex C ℤ)
    [∀ n : ℤ, HasProduct fun t => (X t).X n] [HasProduct X]
    (hX : ∀ t, (X t).IsKInjective) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (derivedHomComparison X K)

declarations.name: DerivedCategory.exists_isDerivedLimit_of_forall_isGE
declarations.doc:
Let `𝒜` be an abelian category with countable products and enough injectives. Then any
inverse system `F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ D(𝒜)` of objects of `D⁺(𝒜)`, i.e. whose values `Kₙ = F.obj ⟨n⟩` are
bounded below, has a product `∏ Kₙ` in `D(𝒜)` and a derived limit `K = R lim Kₙ`: an object
sitting in a distinguished triangle `K ⟶ ∏ Kₙ ⟶ ∏ Kₙ ⟶ K⟦1⟧` whose middle map is
`(kₙ) ↦ (kₙ - fₙ₊₁(kₙ₊₁))`.

declarations.name: fibersHaveProperty_iff_localizations_at_primes_and_maximals
declarations.doc:
A fibre property which is local for localization may be checked on all maps of localizations
at primes lying over one another, or only on those obtained from maximal ideals of the target.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fibersHaveProperty_iff_localizations_at_primes_and_maximals
    (P : ∀ {k : Type u} {S : Type (max u v)} [Field k] [CommRing S], (k →+* S) → Prop)
    (hPiso : RespectsIsomorphisms P)
    (hP : IsLocalForLocalization P)
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsNoetherianRing B] :
    (FibersHaveProperty P A B ↔
      ∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime],
        letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (q.under A)) (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
          Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.under A) q
        FibersHaveProperty P (Localization.AtPrime (q.under A)) (Localization.AtPrime q)) ∧
    ((∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime],
        letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (q.under A)) (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
          Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.under A) q
        FibersHaveProperty P (Localization.AtPrime (q.under A)) (Localization.AtPrime q)) ↔
      ∀ (m : Ideal B) [m.IsMaximal],
        letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (m.under A)) (Localization.AtPrime m) :=
          Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (m.under A) m
        FibersHaveProperty P (Localization.AtPrime (m.under A)) (Localization.AtPrime m))

declarations.name: fibersHaveProperty_adicCompletion_of_isPRing
declarations.doc:
If `A` is a `P`-ring, `P` is local for localization, and `P` descends
along faithfully flat maps in flat towers of Noetherian rings, then all fibres of the map from
`A` to its completion along any ideal have property `P`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fibersHaveProperty_adicCompletion_of_isPRing
    (P : RingMapProperty.{u, u})
    (hlocal : IsLocalForLocalization (fun f => P f))
    (hdescent : ∀ {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
      [Algebra R S] [Algebra S T] [Algebra R T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsNoetherianRing T]
      [Module.Flat R S] [Module.FaithfullyFlat S T],
      FibersHaveProperty (fun f => P f) R T →
        FibersHaveProperty (fun f => P f) R S)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hA : IsPRing P A) (I : Ideal A) :
    FibersHaveProperty (fun f => P f) A (AdicCompletion I A)

declarations.name: isPRing_henselization
declarations.doc:
A henselization of a pair over a `P`-ring is again a `P`-ring when `P` is local on the
target, ascends along regular maps, descends along faithfully flat maps, and is preserved by
separable algebraic extensions of the ground field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPRing_henselization :
    ∀ (P : RingMapProperty.{max u v, max u v}),
    (∀ (k R : Type (max u v)) [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum R, P (algebraMap k (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ↔
        P (algebraMap k R)) →
    (∀ (R S T : Type (max u v))
      [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
      [Algebra R S] [Algebra S T] [Algebra R T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsNoetherianRing T]
      [Module.Flat R S] [Module.Flat S T],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        P.Holds (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber S))) →
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.asIdeal.ResidueField (q.asIdeal.Fiber T)) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        P.Holds (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber T))) →
    (∀ (R S T : Type (max u v))
      [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
      [Algebra R S] [Algebra S T] [Algebra R T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsNoetherianRing T]
      [Module.Flat R S] [Module.FaithfullyFlat S T],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        P.Holds (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber T))) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        P.Holds (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber S))) →
    (∀ (k K R : Type (max u v))
      [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k K] [Algebra K R] [Algebra k R] [IsScalarTower k K R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R],
      Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K → Algebra.IsSeparable k K →
        P (algebraMap k R) → P (algebraMap K R)) →
    ∀ {A : Type u} {Ah : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
      (I : Ideal A),
      HenselianPair Ah (I.map (algebraMap A Ah)) →
      (∀ (B : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing B) (J : Ideal B),
        HenselianPair B J →
          ∀ f : A →+* B, I ≤ J.comap f →
            ∃! g : Ah →+* B,
              g.comp (algebraMap A Ah) = f ∧ I.map (algebraMap A Ah) ≤ J.comap g) →
      IsPRingAt.{u, v, v} P A →
      IsPRingAt.{v, u, u} P Ah

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.isDerivedLimit_derivedHom_of_isHomotopyColimit
declarations.doc:
If `K` is a homotopy colimit of a sequential system of perfect derived
objects `Kₙ`, then `RHomₐ(K, E)` is a derived inverse limit of the inverse system
`E ⊗ᴸ Kₙᵛ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedLimit_derivedHom_of_isHomotopyColimit
    (Ksys : ℕ ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)) [HasCoproduct Ksys.obj]
    (hperfect : ∀ n : ℕ, IsPerfect (Ksys.obj n))
    (K E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} A)) (hK : IsHomotopyColimit Ksys K)
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ (dualTensorSystem A Ksys E).obj (Opposite.op n)] :
    IsDerivedLimit (dualTensorSystem A Ksys E)
      ((derivedHomAdjunctionOverRing A).hom.obj (Opposite.op K, E))

declarations.name: koszulPowerComplexes_form_inverseSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BKC.** The Koszul complexes on the positive powers of a finite
sequence form an inverse system. The displayed formula says that its transition maps are the
maps of Koszul complexes induced by multiplying the `i`-th basis vector by the appropriate
power of `f i`. The system is compatible both with its canonical maps from `A` and, under the
natural identifications in degree zero, with the inverse system of quotients by the ideals
generated by the powered sequences.
declarations.statement:
public theorem koszulPowerComplexes_form_inverseSystem
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A) :
    let K : ℕ → ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℕ := fun n ↦
      Koszul.seqComplex (fun i ↦ f i ^ (n + 1))
    let Q : ℕ → ModuleCat.{u} A := fun n ↦
      ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ f i ^ (n + 1)))
    ∃ (τ : ∀ (m n : ℕ), n ≤ m → (K m ⟶ K n))
      (σ : ∀ (m n : ℕ), n ≤ m → (Q m ⟶ Q n))
      (e : ∀ n, (K n).homology 0 ≅ Q n)
      (η : ∀ n, (ChainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A) ⟶ K n),
      (∀ n, τ n n (le_refl n) = 𝟙 (K n)) ∧
      (∀ (k m n : ℕ) (hkm : m ≤ k) (hmn : n ≤ m),
        τ k m hkm ≫ τ m n hmn = τ k n (hmn.trans hkm)) ∧
      (∀ n, σ n n (le_refl n) = 𝟙 (Q n)) ∧
      (∀ (k m n : ℕ) (hkm : m ≤ k) (hmn : n ≤ m),
        σ k m hkm ≫ σ m n hmn = σ k n (hmn.trans hkm)) ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (hmn : n ≤ m) (j : ℕ) (v : Fin j → Fin r → A),
        (τ m n hmn).f j
            ⟨ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti A j v, Koszul.ιMulti_mem j v⟩ =
          ⟨ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti A j
              (fun k i ↦ f i ^ (m - n) * v k i),
            Koszul.ιMulti_mem j (fun k i ↦ f i ^ (m - n) * v k i)⟩) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A),
        (η n).f 0 a =
          a • ⟨ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti A 0 (fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i),
            Koszul.ιMulti_mem 0 (fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i)⟩) ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (hmn : n ≤ m), η m ≫ τ m n hmn = η n) ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (hmn : n ≤ m),
        ModuleCat.ofHom
              (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ f i ^ (m + 1))).mkQ ≫
            σ m n hmn =
          ModuleCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ f i ^ (n + 1))).mkQ) ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (hmn : n ≤ m),
        (e m).inv ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (τ m n hmn) 0 ≫ (e n).hom =
          σ m n hmn) ∧
      ∀ n,
        (HomologicalComplex.singleObjHomologySelfIso
              (ComplexShape.down ℕ) 0 (ModuleCat.of A A)).inv ≫
            HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (η n) 0 ≫ (e n).hom =
          ModuleCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ f i ^ (n + 1))).mkQ

declarations.name: AdicFilteredCompletion.exists_derivedCompletion_spectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BKD.** Let `I` be a finitely generated ideal, and let `K^•` be a decreasingly
filtered complex of `A`-modules. There is a filtered representative `M^•` of the derived
completion of `K^•` whose canonical spectral sequence consists of derived-complete modules from
its first page onward and has `E₁^{p,q} ≅ H^{p+q}((gr^pK^•)^∧)`. If the filtration of `K^•` is
finite in each degree, the spectral sequence is bounded and converges canonically to the
cohomology of `(K^•)^∧`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivedCompletion_spectralSequence
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [HasProductsOfShape ℕ (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A))]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    (K : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} A) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ) :
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A)) :=
      fun L ↦ IsDerivedComplete I L
    ∀ (completion : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A) ⥤ P.FullSubcategory),
      (completion ⊣ P.ι) →
    ∃ (M : CochainComplex.Filtered (ModuleCat.{v} A))
      (eTotal : DerivedCategory.Q.obj M.X ≅
        (completion ⋙ P.ι).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K.X))
      (eCohomology : ∀ n : ℤ, M.X.homology n ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) n).obj
          ((completion ⋙ P.ι).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K.X))),
      let E := CochainComplex.Filtered.spectralSequenceFunctor.obj M
      (∀ (r p q : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
        IsDerivedCompleteModule I ((E.page r (by omega)).X (p, q))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
        ((E.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) (p + q)).obj
            ((completion ⋙ P.ι).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((FilteredObject.gr p).obj K))))) ∧
      (K.filtration.IsDegreewiseFinite →
        (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧
          M.inducedFiltrationStep n a = ⊤ ∧ M.inducedFiltrationStep n b = ⊥) ∧
        (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r), b ≤ r →
          (E.page r hr).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0) ∧
        (∀ p n : ℤ,
          IsGLB (Set.range fun r : ℕ ↦
              CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M p n ⊓
                (Subobject.pullback (M.X.d n (n + 1))).obj
                  (CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M (p + r) (n + 1)) ⊔
                CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M (p + 1) n)
            (kernelSubobject (M.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M p n ⊔
              CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M (p + 1) n) ∧
          IsLUB (Set.range fun r : ℕ ↦
              CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M p n ⊓
                (Subobject.«exists» (M.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj
                  (CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M (p - r) (n - 1)) ⊔
                CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M (p + 1) n)
            (imageSubobject (M.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M p n ⊔
              CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M (p + 1) n)) ∧
        (∀ p n : ℤ,
          let C := (Subobject.pullback (M.X.iCycles n)).obj
            (CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M p n)
          let N := kernelSubobject (M.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓
            CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M p n ⊔
            CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M (p + 1) n
          let B := imageSubobject (M.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓
            CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M p n ⊔
            CochainComplex.filtrationSubobject M (p + 1) n
          ∃ (a : (C : ModuleCat.{v} A) ⟶ (N : ModuleCat.{v} A))
            (b : (C : ModuleCat.{v} A) ⟶ (M.inducedFiltrationStep n p : ModuleCat.{v} A))
            (hFH : M.inducedFiltrationStep n (p + 1) ≤ M.inducedFiltrationStep n p)
            (e : cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≅
              cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hFH)),
            C.arrow ≫ M.X.iCycles n = a ≫ N.arrow ∧
            C.arrow ≫ M.X.homologyπ n =
              b ≫ (M.inducedFiltrationStep n p).arrow ∧
            a ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≫ e.hom =
              b ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE _ _ hFH)))

declarations.name: AdicFilteredCompletion.exists_spectralSequence_derivedCompletion_homology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BKE.** For a finitely generated ideal `I` and `K ∈ D(A)`, the truncation
filtration gives a bounded cohomological spectral sequence `S₁^{p,q} ≅ H^{2p+q}(H^{-p}(K)^∧)`
converging to `H^{p+q}(K^∧)`. After the reindexing `p = -j`, `q = i + 2j` and a shift of the page
number by one it is a bounded spectral sequence of derived-complete modules with
`E₂^{i,j} ≅ H^i(H^j(K)^∧)` converging to `H^{i+j}(K^∧)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_spectralSequence_derivedCompletion_homology
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG) (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A)) :
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A)) :=
      fun L ↦ IsDerivedComplete I L
    ∃ (completion : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A) ⥤ P.FullSubcategory)
      (adj : completion ⊣ P.ι)
      (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} A) ℤ)
      (eK : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ K)
      (T : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} A) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ)
      (eUnderlying : T.X ≅ C)
      (eStep : ∀ p : ℤ, T.filtration.obj (op p) ≅ C.truncLE (-p))
      (eStep_ι : ∀ p : ℤ,
        (eStep p).hom ≫ C.ιTruncLE (-p) =
          T.filtration.ι.app (op p) ≫ eUnderlying.hom)
      (hT : T.filtration.IsDegreewiseFinite)
      (M : CochainComplex.Filtered (ModuleCat.{v} A))
      (eTotal : DerivedCategory.Q.obj M.X ≅ (completion ⋙ P.ι).obj K)
      (eCohomology : ∀ n : ℤ, M.X.homology n ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) n).obj
          ((completion ⋙ P.ι).obj K)),
      let S := CochainComplex.Filtered.spectralSequenceFunctor.obj M
      ∃ (E : E₂CohomologicalSpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{v} A))
      (eGr : ∀ p : ℤ,
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((FilteredObject.gr p).obj T) ≅
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) 0).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) (-p)).obj K))⟦p⟧)
      (e₁Filtered : ∀ p q : ℤ, (S.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) (p + q)).obj
          ((completion ⋙ P.ι).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((FilteredObject.gr p).obj T))))
      (e₁ : ∀ p q : ℤ, (S.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) (2 * p + q)).obj
          ((completion ⋙ P.ι).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) 0).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) (-p)).obj K))))
      (e₂ : ∀ i j : ℤ, (E.page 2).X (i, j) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) i).obj
          ((completion ⋙ P.ι).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) 0).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) j).obj K))))
      (reindex : ∀ (r i j : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
        (E.page r hr).X (i, j) ≅ (S.page (r - 1) (by omega)).X (-j, i + 2 * j))
      (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, Antitone (M.inducedFiltrationStep n)),
      (∀ (r p q : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
        IsDerivedCompleteModule I ((S.page r (by omega)).X (p, q))) ∧
      (∀ (r i j : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
        IsDerivedCompleteModule I ((E.page r hr).X (i, j))) ∧
      (∀ (r i j : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
        (reindex r i j hr).hom ≫ (S.page (r - 1) (by omega)).d
              (-j, i + 2 * j) (-(j - r + 1), (i + r) + 2 * (j - r + 1)) =
          (E.page r hr).d (i, j) (i + r, j - r + 1) ≫
            (reindex r (i + r) (j - r + 1) hr).hom) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((S.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, {i : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 2).X (i, n - i))}.Finite) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ M.inducedFiltrationStep n a = ⊤ ∧
        M.inducedFiltrationStep n b = ⊥) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ (r₀ : ℤ) (hr₀ : 1 ≤ r₀), ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r),
        (S.page r (by omega)).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0 ∧
        (S.page r (by omega)).d (p - r, q + r - 1) (p, q) = 0 ∧
        Nonempty ((S.page r (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
          cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (M.inducedFiltrationStep (p + q) (p + 1))
            (M.inducedFiltrationStep (p + q) p) (hF (p + q) (by omega))))) ∧
      ∀ i j : ℤ, ∃ (r₀ : ℤ) (hr₀ : 2 ≤ r₀), ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r),
        (E.page r (by omega)).d (i, j) (i + r, j - r + 1) = 0 ∧
        (E.page r (by omega)).d (i - r, j + r - 1) (i, j) = 0 ∧
        Nonempty ((E.page r (by omega)).X (i, j) ≅
          cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (M.inducedFiltrationStep (i + j) (-j + 1))
            (M.inducedFiltrationStep (i + j) (-j)) (hF (i + j) (by omega))))

declarations.name: CompletionSequences.derivedCompletion_principal_homology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BKG.** The two principal-completion short exact sequences, with their
canonical maps. `S` records the fixed mapping-cocone model, its comparison with the
completion unit, and the normalized truncation maps. The remaining clauses retain all
cohomology calculations, including both derived-limit realizations and the degree-one
vanishing for the quotient system.
declarations.statement:
public theorem derivedCompletion_principal_homology
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [HasProductsOfShape ℕ (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A))]
    (f : A) :
    let I : Ideal A := Ideal.span {f}
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A)) :=
      fun L ↦ IsDerivedComplete I L
    ∀ (completion : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A) ⥤ P.FullSubcategory)
      (adj : completion ⊣ P.ι),
      let completed := completion ⋙ P.ι
      ∃ S : PrincipalCompletionSequences A f completed adj.unit,
        (∀ M : ModuleCat.{v} A,
          let Mhat := completed.obj ((single A 0).obj M)
          let torsionRlim := moduleDerivedLimit A (powerTorsionSystem A M f)
          let quotientRlim := moduleDerivedLimit A (powerQuotientSystem A M f)
          ∃ (eT : FirstDerivedLimitComparison A (powerTorsionSystem A M f))
            (eQ : FirstDerivedLimitComparison A (powerQuotientSystem A M f)),
            IsDerivedLimit (powerTorsionSystem A M f ⋙ single A 0) torsionRlim ∧
            IsDerivedLimit (powerQuotientSystem A M f ⋙ single A 0) quotientRlim ∧
            Nonempty ((homology A (-1)).obj Mhat ≅ adicTateModule A M f) ∧
            (ShortComplex.mk (eT.iso.hom ≫ (S.moduleSequence M).inclusion)
              (S.moduleSequence M).projection
              (by rw [Category.assoc, (S.moduleSequence M).zero, comp_zero])).ShortExact ∧
            Nonempty ((homology A 1).obj Mhat ≅ (homology A 1).obj quotientRlim) ∧
            IsZero ((homology A 1).obj quotientRlim) ∧
            ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ -1 → n ≠ 0 → IsZero ((homology A n).obj Mhat)) ∧
        ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A)) (p : ℤ),
          (ShortComplex.mk ((S.truncation K p).inclusion S.shift)
            ((S.truncation K p).projection f S.shift
              (S.moduleSequence ((homology A (p + 1)).obj K)).tateIso)
            (S.truncation_zero K p)).ShortExact

declarations.name: Stacks.Injectives.exists_filtered_quasiIso_isKInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BKI.** A filtered complex in a Grothendieck abelian category has a
filtered resolution which is termwise injective and K-injective before and after
taking any filtration step or filtration quotient, and the comparison maps on all
of these complexes are quasi-isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_filtered_quasiIso_isKInjective [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w'} A]
    (K : CochainComplex.Filtered A) :
    ∃ (J : CochainComplex.Filtered A) (j : K ⟶ J),
      (∀ n : ℤ, Injective (J.X.X n)) ∧
      (∀ p n : ℤ, Injective ((J.filtration.obj (op p)).X n)) ∧
      (∀ p n : ℤ, Injective ((cokernel (J.filtration.ι.app (op p))).X n)) ∧
      (∀ (p p' : ℤ) (h : p ≤ p') n,
        Injective ((cokernel (J.filtration.diagram.map (opHomOfLE h))).X n)) ∧
      J.X.IsKInjective ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, (J.filtration.obj (op p)).IsKInjective) ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, (cokernel (J.filtration.ι.app (op p))).IsKInjective) ∧
      (∀ (p p' : ℤ) (h : p ≤ p'),
        (cokernel (J.filtration.diagram.map (opHomOfLE h))).IsKInjective) ∧
      QuasiIso j.hom ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (j.natTrans.app (op p))) ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (filtrationQuotientMap j p)) ∧
      ∀ (p p' : ℤ) (h : p ≤ p'), QuasiIso (filtrationSubquotientMap j h)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CohomologyPresheaf.cohomologyPresheafEvaluationIsoRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BKJ, the value on an open as cohomology of the open subspace.** The
value on `U` of the presheaf `U ↦ H^q(U, K)` is `H^q(U, K|_U)`, the degree-`q` cohomology of the
open subspace `U` with coefficients in the derived restriction of `K`, naturally in `K`.
declarations.statement:
public def cohomologyPresheafEvaluationIsoRestriction {X : TopCat.{u}}
    (O : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u}) (U : Opens X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} O)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wU} (SheafOfModules.{u} (resRing U O))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wP} (PresheafOfModules.{u} O.obj)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wG} AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (q : ℤ) :
    derivedSectionsPresheaf O ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (PresheafOfModules.{u} O.obj) q ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.evaluation O.obj (Opposite.op U) ⋙
          forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (O.obj.obj (Opposite.op U))) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ≅
      derivedRestriction O U ⋙ derivedSectionsOnOpenSubspace O U ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} q
declarations.comment: values on opens: the value of the presheaf on U is H^q(U, K|_U)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CohomologyPresheaf.cohomologyPresheafEvaluationIso
declarations.doc: The value on `U` of the cohomology presheaf is `H^q(U, K)`.
declarations.statement:
public def cohomologyPresheafEvaluationIso {X : TopCat.{u}}

    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} O)]

          forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (O.obj.obj (Opposite.op U))) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ≅
      Stacks.Cohomology.OpenSubspace.derivedSectionsOnOpen O U ⋙

declarations.comment: values on opens

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CohomologyPresheaf.sheafificationCohomologyPresheafIso
declarations.doc:
Sheafifying the presheaf `U ↦ H^q(U, K)` gives the `q`-th cohomology sheaf of `K`, naturally
in the derived object `K`.
declarations.statement:
public def sheafificationCohomologyPresheafIso {X : TopCat.{u}}
