declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.PrincipalQuotientTowerFormalFunctions.nonempty_iso_derivedSections_limit_derivedCompletion
declarations.doc:
**The displayed equality of [Stacks, Tag 0BLD].** Let `A` be a ring, `f ∈ A`, let `X` be a
scheme over `A` through `ρ : A ⟶ Γ(X, 𝒪_X)` and let `ℱ` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module whose
`f`-power torsion stabilizes. Let `completion` be a left adjoint to the inclusion of the objects
of `D(A)` that are derived complete for the ideal `(f)`, so that `(-)^∧ = completion ⋙ P.ι` is
derived `f`-adic completion as in [Stacks, Tag 0BKG]. Then

`RΓ(X, lim ℱ/f^(n+1)ℱ) ≅ RΓ(X, ℱ)^∧`,

the object `RΓ(X, lim ℱ/f^(n+1)ℱ)` is derived complete for `(f)`, and for every `p` its `p`-th
cohomology module is that of `RΓ(X, ℱ)^∧`.

This is `nonempty_iso_derivedSections_limit_quotientTower_derivedCompletion` (in the namespace
`PrincipalQuotientTowerCompletion`) with the countable products of `D(𝒪_X)` and of `D(A)` it
takes as instance binders supplied.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_derivedSections_limit_derivedCompletion
    (hℱ : (ℱ : X.Modules).IsQuasicoherent) (hstab : Stabilizes (mulF X ρ f ℱ)) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      fun L ↦ IsDerivedComplete (Ideal.span {f}) L
    ∀ (completion : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ P.FullSubcategory)
      (_ : completion ⊣ P.ι),
      let completed := completion ⋙ P.ι
      let Fhat : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
        (derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            (limit (quotientTower X ρ f ℱ)))
      Nonempty (Fhat ≅ completed.obj (derivedSectionsModule X ρ ℱ)) ∧
        IsDerivedComplete (Ideal.span {f}) Fhat ∧
        ∀ p : ℤ, Nonempty
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p).obj Fhat ≅
            (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p).obj
              (completed.obj (derivedSectionsModule X ρ ℱ)))
declarations.comment: the displayed equality `RΓ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) = RΓ(X, ℱ)^∧`, with derived f-adic completion presented as in Stacks 0BKG by an arbitrary left adjoint to the inclusion of the derived-complete objects; also derived completeness of `RΓ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ)` and the identification `Hᵖ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) = Hᵖ(RΓ(X, ℱ)^∧)`. Unconditional: the countable products of D(𝒪_X) and D(A) are supplied, not assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.PrincipalQuotientTowerFormalFunctions.exists_shortExact_middleColumn_quotients
declarations.doc:
**The middle column of the diagram of [Stacks, Tag 0BLD], in the form of [Stacks, Tag 0H3E].**
With `A`, `f`, `X` and `ℱ` as in the source, let `E^` be a derived limit of the `f`-power Koszul
tower `ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_X} (𝒪_X --f^(n+1)--> 𝒪_X)`. Then `E^ ≅ lim ℱ/f^(n+1)ℱ`, and for every `p` there is
a short exact sequence

`0 ⟶ R¹lim Hᵖ⁻¹(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ 0`,

whose inclusion descends the connecting morphism of the Milnor triangle and whose projection is
characterized by the limit projections, and whose outer terms are isomorphic to those of the
corresponding sequence for the Koszul tower.

This is `PrincipalQuotientTower.exists_shortExact_homology_derivedSections_limit_quotientTower`
with the countable products of `D(𝒪_X)` and of `D(A)` it takes as instance binders supplied; the
statement names them, since it mentions products and derived limits.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_middleColumn_quotients
    (hℱ : (ℱ : X.Modules).IsQuasicoherent) (hstab : Stabilizes (mulF X ρ f ℱ)) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
    letI := Stacks.Algebraization.hasProductsOfShape_nat_derivedCategory_modules X
    letI : HasProductsOfShape ℕ (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      Stacks.DerivedProducts.hasProductsOfShape_derivedCategory
    ∀ (Ehat : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace))),
      IsDerivedLimit (Ksys (mulF X ρ f ℱ)) Ehat →
    let Fhat : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)) :=
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        (limit (quotientTower X ρ f ℱ))
    let F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
      Csys (mulF X ρ f ℱ) ⋙ derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ
    let G : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
      Ksys (mulF X ρ f ℱ) ⋙ derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ
    let Y : ℕ → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) := fun n ↦ F.obj (op n)
    let d : (∏ᶜ Y) ⟶ ∏ᶜ Y := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π Y n - Pi.π Y (n + 1) ≫ F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
    Nonempty (Ehat ≅ Fhat) ∧
      ∃ (a : (derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ).obj Fhat ⟶ ∏ᶜ Y)
        (b : (∏ᶜ Y) ⟶ ((derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ).obj Fhat)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        let T := Triangle.mk a d b
        T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) ∧
          ∀ p : ℤ,
            let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p
            let H₁ := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) (p - 1)
            let homologySystem : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} A := F ⋙ H
            let shiftedHomologySystem : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} A := F ⋙ H₁
            let P : ModuleCat.{u} A :=
              ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (op n)
            let δ : P ⟶ P := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
              Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (op n)) n -
                Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (op n)) (n + 1) ≫
                  shiftedHomologySystem.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
            ∃ (e : H₁.obj (∏ᶜ Y) ≅ P)
              (i : cokernel δ ⟶ H.obj ((derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ).obj Fhat))
              (q : H.obj ((derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ).obj Fhat) ⟶
                limit homologySystem)
              (w : i ≫ q = 0),
              e.hom = piComparison H₁ Y ∧
                cokernel.π δ ≫ i = e.inv ≫
                  DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.δ T (p - 1) p (by omega) ∧
                (∀ n : ℕ, q ≫ limit.π homologySystem (op n) =
                  H.map a ≫ H.map (Pi.π Y n)) ∧
                (ShortComplex.mk i q w).ShortExact ∧
                Nonempty (limit homologySystem ≅ limit (G ⋙ H)) ∧
                Nonempty (cokernel δ ≅
                  CompletionSequences.firstDerivedLimit A (G ⋙ H₁))
declarations.comment: the middle column of the diagram: the short exact sequence `0 ⟶ R¹lim Hᵖ⁻¹(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ 0` at the ordinary limit, together with the isomorphism of a derived limit of the f-power Koszul tower with `lim ℱ/fⁿℱ`. Unconditional: the countable products of D(𝒪_X) and D(A) are supplied, not assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.PrincipalQuotientTowerFormalFunctions.exists_diagram_derivedSections_limit_quotientTower
declarations.doc:
**The commutative diagram of [Stacks, Tag 0BLD].** Let `A` be a ring, `f ∈ A`, let `X` be a
scheme over `A` through `ρ : A ⟶ Γ(X, 𝒪_X)` and let `ℱ` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module whose
`f`-power torsion stabilizes. Let `completion` be a left adjoint to the inclusion of the objects
of `D(A)` that are derived complete for `(f)`, so that `(-)^∧ = completion ⋙ P.ι` is derived
`f`-adic completion as in [Stacks, Tag 0BKG]. Then for every `p` there is a commutative diagram

```
                     0                              0
                     ↑                              ↑
0 ⟶  Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^   ⟶  lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ)  ⟶  T_f(Hᵖ⁺¹(X, ℱ))  ⟶  0
                     ↑                              ↑              ‖
0 ⟶ H⁰(Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^∧) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶  T_f(Hᵖ⁺¹(X, ℱ))  ⟶  0
                     ↑                              ↑
      R¹lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ)[fⁿ]  ≅  R¹lim Hᵖ⁻¹(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ)
                     ↑                              ↑
                     0                              0
```

with exact rows and columns, where `Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^ = lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ)/fⁿHᵖ(X, ℱ)` is the ordinary `f`-adic
completion and `T_f(-)` is the `f`-adic Tate module. The right-hand column is the identity: the
two projections to `T_f(Hᵖ⁺¹(X, ℱ))` agree after the middle vertical map.

This is `PrincipalQuotientTowerDiagram.exists_formalFunctionsDiagram` with the countable products
of `D(𝒪_X)` and of `D(A)` it takes as instance binders supplied.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_diagram_derivedSections_limit_quotientTower (p : ℤ) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
    let Hq : ℤ → ModuleCat.{u} A := fun q ↦
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) q).obj (derivedSectionsModule X ρ ℱ)
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      fun L ↦ IsDerivedComplete (Ideal.span {f}) L
    ∀ (completion : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ P.FullSubcategory)
      (_ : completion ⊣ P.ι),
      let completed := completion ⋙ P.ι
      let ordinaryCompletion := limit (CompletionSequences.powerQuotientSystem A (Hq p) f)
      let tate := CompletionSequences.adicTateModule A (Hq (p + 1)) f
      let h0Completion := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
        (completed.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (Hq p)))
      let torsionR1 := CompletionSequences.firstDerivedLimit A
        (PrincipalTorsionTower.powerTorsionSystem A (Hq p) f)
      let limitQuotientCohomology := limit (quotientCohomology X ρ f ℱ p)
      let previousQuotientR1 := CompletionSequences.firstDerivedLimit A
        (quotientCohomology X ρ f ℱ (p - 1))
      let sectionsCohomology := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p).obj
        (limitQuotientSections X ρ f ℱ)
      ∃ (topIn : ordinaryCompletion ⟶ limitQuotientCohomology)
        (topOut : limitQuotientCohomology ⟶ tate)
        (htop : topIn ≫ topOut = 0)
        (middleIn : h0Completion ⟶ sectionsCohomology)
        (middleOut : sectionsCohomology ⟶ tate)
        (hmiddle : middleIn ≫ middleOut = 0)
        (leftIn : torsionR1 ⟶ h0Completion) (leftOut : h0Completion ⟶ ordinaryCompletion)
        (hleft : leftIn ≫ leftOut = 0)
        (columnIn : previousQuotientR1 ⟶ sectionsCohomology)
        (columnOut : sectionsCohomology ⟶ limitQuotientCohomology)
        (hcolumn : columnIn ≫ columnOut = 0)
        (bottom : torsionR1 ≅ previousQuotientR1),
        (ShortComplex.mk topIn topOut htop).ShortExact ∧
          (ShortComplex.mk middleIn middleOut hmiddle).ShortExact ∧
          (ShortComplex.mk leftIn leftOut hleft).ShortExact ∧
          (ShortComplex.mk columnIn columnOut hcolumn).ShortExact ∧
          middleIn ≫ columnOut = leftOut ≫ topIn ∧
          middleOut = columnOut ≫ topOut ∧
          bottom.hom ≫ columnIn = leftIn ≫ middleIn
declarations.comment: the commutative diagram with exact rows and columns, in full: the top row `0 ⟶ Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^ ⟶ lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ T_f(Hᵖ⁺¹(X, ℱ)) ⟶ 0`, the middle row `0 ⟶ H⁰(Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^∧) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ T_f(Hᵖ⁺¹(X, ℱ)) ⟶ 0`, the left column `0 ⟶ R¹lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ)[fⁿ] ⟶ H⁰(Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^∧) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^ ⟶ 0`, the middle column `0 ⟶ R¹lim Hᵖ⁻¹(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ 0`, the bottom isomorphism `R¹lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ)[fⁿ] ≅ R¹lim Hᵖ⁻¹(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ)`, the identity right column, and the commutativity of the three squares. Unconditional: the countable products of D(𝒪_X) and D(A) are supplied, not assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.PrincipalQuotientTowerFormalFunctions.exists_shortExact_topRow_quotients
declarations.doc:
**The top row of the diagram of [Stacks, Tag 0BLD].** With `A`, `f`, `X` and `ℱ` as in the
source, for every `p` there is a short exact sequence

`0 ⟶ Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^ ⟶ lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ T_f(Hᵖ⁺¹(X, ℱ)) ⟶ 0`,

where `Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^ = lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ)/fⁿHᵖ(X, ℱ)` is the ordinary `f`-adic completion and `T_f(-)` the
`f`-adic Tate module. This is `PrincipalQuotientTowerDiagram.exists_shortExact_topRow` with its
countable products supplied.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_topRow_quotients (p : ℤ) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
    let Hq : ℤ → ModuleCat.{u} A := fun q ↦
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) q).obj (derivedSectionsModule X ρ ℱ)
    ∃ (topIn : limit (CompletionSequences.powerQuotientSystem A (Hq p) f) ⟶
        limit (quotientCohomology X ρ f ℱ p))
      (topOut : limit (quotientCohomology X ρ f ℱ p) ⟶
        CompletionSequences.adicTateModule A (Hq (p + 1)) f)
      (htop : topIn ≫ topOut = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk topIn topOut htop).ShortExact
declarations.comment: the top row of the diagram: the short exact sequence `0 ⟶ Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^ ⟶ lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ T_f(Hᵖ⁺¹(X, ℱ)) ⟶ 0`. Unconditional: no reflector onto the derived-complete objects and no countable products are assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.PrincipalQuotientTowerFormalFunctions.exists_shortExact_middleRow_quotients
declarations.doc:
**The middle row of the diagram of [Stacks, Tag 0BLD].** With `A`, `f`, `X` and `ℱ` as in the
source and `(-)^∧` derived `f`-adic completion presented by an arbitrary left adjoint to the
inclusion of the derived-complete objects, for every `p` there is a short exact sequence

`0 ⟶ H⁰(Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^∧) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ T_f(Hᵖ⁺¹(X, ℱ)) ⟶ 0`.

This is `PrincipalQuotientTowerDiagram.exists_shortExact_middleRow` with its countable products
supplied.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_middleRow_quotients (p : ℤ) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
    let Hq : ℤ → ModuleCat.{u} A := fun q ↦
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) q).obj (derivedSectionsModule X ρ ℱ)
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      fun L ↦ IsDerivedComplete (Ideal.span {f}) L
    ∀ (completion : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ P.FullSubcategory)
      (_ : completion ⊣ P.ι),
      ∃ (middleIn : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
          ((completion ⋙ P.ι).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (Hq p))) ⟶
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p).obj
            (limitQuotientSections X ρ f ℱ))
        (middleOut : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p).obj
            (limitQuotientSections X ρ f ℱ) ⟶
          CompletionSequences.adicTateModule A (Hq (p + 1)) f)
        (hmiddle : middleIn ≫ middleOut = 0),
        (ShortComplex.mk middleIn middleOut hmiddle).ShortExact
declarations.comment: the middle row of the diagram: the short exact sequence `0 ⟶ H⁰(Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^∧) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ T_f(Hᵖ⁺¹(X, ℱ)) ⟶ 0`, with `(-)^∧` the derived f-adic completion presented as in Stacks 0BKG by an arbitrary left adjoint to the inclusion of the derived-complete objects. Unconditional: no countable products are assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.PrincipalQuotientTowerFormalFunctions.exists_shortExact_leftColumn_quotients
declarations.doc:
**The left column of the diagram of [Stacks, Tag 0BLD].** With `A`, `f`, `X` and `ℱ` as in the
source and `(-)^∧` derived `f`-adic completion presented by an arbitrary left adjoint to the
inclusion of the derived-complete objects, for every `p` there is a short exact sequence

`0 ⟶ R¹lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ)[fⁿ] ⟶ H⁰(Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^∧) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^ ⟶ 0`.

This is `PrincipalQuotientTowerDiagram.exists_shortExact_leftColumn` with its countable products
supplied.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_leftColumn_quotients (p : ℤ) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
    let Hq : ℤ → ModuleCat.{u} A := fun q ↦
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) q).obj (derivedSectionsModule X ρ ℱ)
    let P : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      fun L ↦ IsDerivedComplete (Ideal.span {f}) L
    ∀ (completion : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ P.FullSubcategory)
      (_ : completion ⊣ P.ι),
      ∃ (leftIn : CompletionSequences.firstDerivedLimit A
            (PrincipalTorsionTower.powerTorsionSystem A (Hq p) f) ⟶
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
            ((completion ⋙ P.ι).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (Hq p))))
        (leftOut : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
            ((completion ⋙ P.ι).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj (Hq p))) ⟶
          limit (CompletionSequences.powerQuotientSystem A (Hq p) f))
        (hleft : leftIn ≫ leftOut = 0),
        (ShortComplex.mk leftIn leftOut hleft).ShortExact
declarations.comment: the left column of the diagram: the short exact sequence `0 ⟶ R¹lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ)[fⁿ] ⟶ H⁰(Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^∧) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, ℱ)^ ⟶ 0`, with `(-)^∧` the derived f-adic completion presented as in Stacks 0BKG by an arbitrary left adjoint to the inclusion of the derived-complete objects. Unconditional: no countable products are assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.PrincipalQuotientTowerFormalFunctions.nonempty_iso_firstDerivedLimit_torsion_quotients
declarations.doc:
**The bottom isomorphism of the diagram of [Stacks, Tag 0BLD].** With `A`, `f`, `X` and `ℱ` as
in the source, for every `p`

`R¹lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ)[fⁿ] ≅ R¹lim Hᵖ⁻¹(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ)`.

This is `PrincipalQuotientTowerDiagram.nonempty_iso_firstDerivedLimit_torsion` with its countable
products supplied.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_firstDerivedLimit_torsion_quotients (p : ℤ) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A)
    let Hq : ℤ → ModuleCat.{u} A := fun q ↦
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) q).obj (derivedSectionsModule X ρ ℱ)
    Nonempty (CompletionSequences.firstDerivedLimit A
        (PrincipalTorsionTower.powerTorsionSystem A (Hq p) f) ≅
      CompletionSequences.firstDerivedLimit A (quotientCohomology X ρ f ℱ (p - 1)))
declarations.comment: the bottom isomorphism of the diagram: `R¹lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ)[fⁿ] ≅ R¹lim Hᵖ⁻¹(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ)`. Unconditional: no reflector onto the derived-complete objects and no countable products are assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.Algebraization.PrincipalQuotientTower.exists_shortExact_homology_derivedSections_limit_quotientTower
declarations.doc:
**Formal sections for a principal ideal on a scheme: the middle column of the diagram.**
Let `A` be a ring, `f ∈ A`, let `X` be a scheme over `A` through `ρ : A ⟶ Γ(X, 𝒪_X)` and let `ℱ`
be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module whose `f`-power torsion stabilizes. Let `E^` be a derived limit
of the `f`-power Koszul tower `ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_X} (𝒪_X --f^(n+1)--> 𝒪_X)`. Then `E^` is isomorphic to the
ordinary inverse limit `lim ℱ/f^(n+1)ℱ`, and for every `p` the cohomology of
`RΓ(X, lim ℱ/f^(n+1)ℱ)` over `A` sits in a short exact sequence

`0 ⟶ R¹lim Hᵖ⁻¹(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ 0`,

whose inclusion descends the connecting morphism of the Milnor triangle and whose projection is
characterized by the limit projections, and whose outer terms are isomorphic to the outer terms of
the corresponding sequence for the Koszul tower.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_homology_derivedSections_limit_quotientTower
    (hstab : Stabilizes (mulF X ρ f ℱ))
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ (Csys (mulF X ρ f ℱ)).obj ⟨n⟩]
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦
      (Csys (mulF X ρ f ℱ) ⋙ derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ).obj ⟨n⟩]
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ (Ksys (mulF X ρ f ℱ)).obj ⟨n⟩]
    (Ehat : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)))
    (hEhat : IsDerivedLimit (Ksys (mulF X ρ f ℱ)) Ehat) :
    let Fhat : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)) :=
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        (limit (quotientTower X ρ f ℱ))
    let F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
      Csys (mulF X ρ f ℱ) ⋙ derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ
    let G : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
      Ksys (mulF X ρ f ℱ) ⋙ derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ
    let Y : ℕ → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) := fun n ↦ F.obj (op n)
    let d : (∏ᶜ Y) ⟶ ∏ᶜ Y := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
      Pi.π Y n - Pi.π Y (n + 1) ≫ F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
    Nonempty (Ehat ≅ Fhat) ∧
      ∃ (a : (derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ).obj Fhat ⟶ ∏ᶜ Y)
        (b : (∏ᶜ Y) ⟶ ((derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ).obj Fhat)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        let T := Triangle.mk a d b
        T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) ∧
          ∀ p : ℤ,
            let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p
            let H₁ := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) (p - 1)
            let homologySystem : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} A := F ⋙ H
            let shiftedHomologySystem : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} A := F ⋙ H₁
            let P : ModuleCat.{u} A :=
              ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (op n)
            let δ : P ⟶ P := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
              Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (op n)) n -
                Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (op n)) (n + 1) ≫
                  shiftedHomologySystem.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
            ∃ (e : H₁.obj (∏ᶜ Y) ≅ P)
              (i : cokernel δ ⟶ H.obj ((derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ).obj Fhat))
              (q : H.obj ((derivedSectionsOver X.toRingedSpace ρ).obj Fhat) ⟶
                limit homologySystem)
              (w : i ≫ q = 0),
              e.hom = piComparison H₁ Y ∧
                cokernel.π δ ≫ i = e.inv ≫
                  DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.δ T (p - 1) p ∧
                (∀ n : ℕ, q ≫ limit.π homologySystem (op n) =
                  H.map a ≫ H.map (Pi.π Y n)) ∧
                (ShortComplex.mk i q w).ShortExact ∧
                Nonempty (limit homologySystem ≅ limit (G ⋙ H)) ∧
                Nonempty (cokernel δ ≅
                  CompletionSequences.firstDerivedLimit A (G ⋙ H₁))
declarations.comment: the middle column of the diagram, for a quasi-coherent module on a scheme: the short exact sequence `0 ⟶ R¹lim Hᵖ⁻¹(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ lim Hᵖ(X, ℱ/fⁿℱ) ⟶ 0` at the ordinary limit, together with the isomorphism of a derived limit of the f-power Koszul tower with `lim ℱ/fⁿℱ`. The displayed equality `RΓ(X, lim ℱ/fⁿℱ) = RΓ(X, ℱ)^∧` and the remaining rows and columns of the diagram are not covered

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.LocalLefschetzSituation
declarations.doc: The standing data and hypotheses of the local Lefschetz situation.
declarations.statement: public structure LocalLefschetzSituation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation
declarations.doc:
The standing data of the local Lefschetz situation: a Noetherian local ring `A` together
with an element `f` of its maximal ideal.
declarations.statement: structure LocalLefschetzSituation

registrations.name: Stacks.puncturedSpectrum
registrations.comment: the punctured spectra

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.faithful_finiteEtaleRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLG.** In the local Lefschetz situation, base change of finite étale
covers from the punctured spectrum of `A` to the punctured spectrum of `A / fA` is faithful,
provided either that `dim (A / 𝔭) ≥ 2` for every minimal prime `𝔭` of `A` with `f ∉ 𝔭`, or
that every connected component of `U` meets `U₀`.
declarations.statement:
lemma faithful_finiteEtaleRestriction (S : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u})
    (h :
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum S.A, IsMinimalPrime p.asIdeal →
        S.f ∉ p.asIdeal → 2 ≤ ringKrullDim (S.A ⧸ p.asIdeal)) ∨
      (∀ c : ConnectedComponents S.U,
        ∃ x : S.U₀, ConnectedComponents.mk (S.U₀ToU.base x) = c)) :
    (finiteEtaleBaseChange S.U₀ToU).Faithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finite_extension_of_completion
declarations.doc:
A finite cover of the punctured spectrum which extends over the completed
spectrum extends over the original local spectrum, compatibly with both given
covers.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_finite_extension_of_completion
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (V : Scheme.{u}) (pi : V ⟶ (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).toScheme)
    [IsFinite pi] :
    let Ahat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
    let Xhat := Spec (.of Ahat)
    let completionMap : Xhat ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A Ahat))
    let Uhat := pullback (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).ι completionMap
    let UhatToU : Uhat ⟶ (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).toScheme := pullback.fst _ _
    let Vhat := pullback pi UhatToU
    let pihat : Vhat ⟶ Uhat := pullback.snd _ _
    ∀ (Yhat : Scheme.{u}) (fhat : Yhat ⟶ Xhat) [IsFinite fhat]
      (ghat : Vhat ⟶ Yhat),
      IsPullback pihat ghat
          (pullback.snd (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).ι completionMap) fhat →
        (∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (g : V ⟶ Y) (h : Yhat ⟶ Y),
          IsFinite f ∧
            IsPullback pi g (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).ι f ∧
            IsPullback fhat h completionMap f ∧
            (pullback.fst pi UhatToU ≫ g = ghat ≫ h))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleRestriction_of_completion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLI.** In the local Lefschetz situation assume that `A` is henselian,
or more generally that `(A, fA)` is a henselian pair. If restriction of finite étale covers from
the punctured spectrum of the `𝔪`-adic completion to its closed fibre is fully faithful, then
restriction from `U` to `U₀` is fully faithful.
declarations.statement:
theorem fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleRestriction_of_completion
    (S : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u})
    (hS : HenselianLocalRing S.A ∨ HenselianPair S.A S.principalIdeal)
    (h : let X' := Spec (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.A) S.A))
      let completionMap : X' ⟶ S.X :=
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap S.A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S.A) S.A)))
      let U'ToU := pullback.fst S.UOpen.ι completionMap
      let U'₀ToU' := pullback.snd S.U₀ToU U'ToU
      Nonempty (finiteEtaleBaseChange U'₀ToU').FullyFaithful) :
    Nonempty (finiteEtaleBaseChange S.U₀ToU).FullyFaithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleRestriction_of_three_le_depth_of_henselianLocalRing_or
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BLJ].** In the local Lefschetz situation assume that `A` has depth at least
`3` and that `A` is henselian or, more generally, that the pair `(A, (f))` is henselian. Then
`FÉt_U ⟶ FÉt_{U₀}` is fully faithful.

The henselian hypothesis `hS` is the source's disjunction. This is the source's proof: depth at
least `3` forces `H¹_𝔪(A) = H²_𝔪(A) = 0` by [Stacks, Tag 0AVZ], through
`Stacks.LocalCohomology.isZero_localCohomology_of_lt_depth`, so the annihilation hypothesis of
Stacks 0BM6 holds with any exponent and
`fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleRestriction_of_annihilated_of_henselian` applies.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleRestriction_of_three_le_depth_of_henselianLocalRing_or
    (S : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u})
    (hS : HenselianLocalRing S.A ∨ HenselianPair S.A S.principalIdeal)
    (hdepth : 3 ≤ Module.depth S.A (maximalIdeal S.A) S.A) :
    Nonempty (finiteEtaleBaseChange S.U₀ToU).FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: for an arbitrary Noetherian local ring `A` of depth at least `3`, with `A` henselian or `(A, (f))` a henselian pair

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteEtale_extension_iff_globalSections_finiteEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLK.** For a Noetherian local ring of depth at least two, a finite
étale scheme over the punctured spectrum extends to a finite étale scheme over the whole
spectrum if and only if its ring of global sections is finite étale over the ring.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_finiteEtale_extension_iff_globalSections_finiteEtale
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (V : Scheme.{u}) (π : V ⟶ (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).toScheme)
    [IsFinite π] [Etale π]
    (hdepth : 2 ≤ Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A) :
    (∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (g : V ⟶ Y),
      IsFinite f ∧ Etale f ∧ IsPullback π g (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).ι f) ↔
      letI : Algebra A Γ(V, ⊤) :=
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
          (π ≫ (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).ι).appTop).hom.toAlgebra
      Module.Finite A Γ(V, ⊤) ∧ Algebra.Etale A Γ(V, ⊤)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteEtale_extension_iff_completion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLL.** A finite étale cover of the punctured spectrum of a
Noetherian local ring extends over the spectrum exactly when its base change to the adic
completion extends over the completed spectrum.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_finiteEtale_extension_iff_completion
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (V : Scheme.{u}) (pi : V ⟶ (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).toScheme)
    [IsFinite pi] [Etale pi] :
    let Ahat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
    let Xhat := Spec (.of Ahat)
    let completionMap : Xhat ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A Ahat))
    let Uhat := pullback (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).ι completionMap
    let UhatToU : Uhat ⟶ (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).toScheme :=
      pullback.fst _ _
    let Vhat := pullback pi UhatToU
    let pihat : Vhat ⟶ Uhat := pullback.snd _ _
    (∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (g : V ⟶ Y),
      IsFinite f ∧ Etale f ∧
        IsPullback pi g (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).ι f) ↔
      ∃ (Yhat : Scheme.{u}) (fhat : Yhat ⟶ Xhat) (ghat : Vhat ⟶ Yhat),
        IsFinite fhat ∧ Etale fhat ∧
          IsPullback pihat ghat (pullback.snd (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A).ι completionMap)
            fhat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_three_le_depth_self
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BLM].** In the local Lefschetz situation let `V` be finite étale over `U` and
assume (1) `A` has depth at least `3`, and (2) `V ×_U U₀` is `Y₀ ×_{X₀} U₀` for some `Y₀ → X₀`
finite étale. Then `V = Y ×_X U` for some `Y → X` finite étale.

This is the source's proof. Depth at least `3` forces `H¹_𝔪(A) = H²_𝔪(A) = 0` by
[Stacks, Tag 0AVZ] (`Stacks.LocalCohomology.subsingleton_localCohomologyModule_of_lt_depth`), so
both are annihilated by `f ^ 0`, and the conclusion is [Stacks, Tag 0BLS] at `S`, which is
`exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_localCohomology_annihilated`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_three_le_depth_self
    (S : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u})
    (hdepth : 3 ≤ Module.depth S.A (maximalIdeal S.A) S.A)
    (V : Scheme.{u}) (pi : V ⟶ S.U) [IsFinite pi] [Etale pi]
    (Y₀ : Scheme.{u}) (f₀ : Y₀ ⟶ S.X₀) [IsFinite f₀] [Etale f₀]
    (g₀ : pullback pi S.U₀ToU ⟶ Y₀)
    (h₀ : IsPullback (pullback.snd pi S.U₀ToU) g₀ S.U₀Open.ι f₀) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (p : Y ⟶ S.X) (g : V ⟶ Y),
      IsFinite p ∧ Etale p ∧ IsPullback pi g S.UOpen.ι p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_three_le_depth
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BLM]** In the local Lefschetz situation let `V` be finite étale over `U` and
assume (1) `A` has depth at least `3`, and (2) `V ×_U U₀` is `Y₀ ×_{X₀} U₀` for some
`Y₀ → X₀` finite étale.  Then `V = Y ×_X U` for some `Y → X` finite étale.

This is the source's proof.  Depth at least `3` forces `H¹_𝔪(A) = H²_𝔪(A) = 0` by
[Stacks, Tag 0AVZ], which is the whole content supplied here, and the conclusion is then
[Stacks, Tag 0BLS] at the situation `S`.

That last step is the hypothesis `hLiftFromHypersurface`, stated in the unrestricted form the
source gives [Stacks, Tag 0BLS], universally quantified over all local Lefschetz situations, with
its own annihilation hypothesis intact — it is not specialised to `S`, says nothing about depth,
and does not grant this statement's conclusion.  It holds by
`exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_localCohomology_annihilated`.  The `f`-adically complete case is
`exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_three_le_depth_of_isAdicComplete` above, where it is
discharged.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_three_le_depth
    (S : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u})
    (hdepth : 3 ≤ Module.depth S.A (maximalIdeal S.A) S.A)
    (hLiftFromHypersurface : ∀ T : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u},
      (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : localCohomologyModule T.A (maximalIdeal T.A)
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (maximalIdeal T.A)) (ModuleCat.of T.A T.A) 1,
        T.f ^ n • x = 0) →
      (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : localCohomologyModule T.A (maximalIdeal T.A)
        (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (maximalIdeal T.A)) (ModuleCat.of T.A T.A) 2,
        T.f ^ n • x = 0) →
      ∀ (W : Scheme.{u}) (ρ : W ⟶ T.U), IsFinite ρ → Etale ρ →
      ∀ (Z₀ : Scheme.{u}) (q₀ : Z₀ ⟶ T.X₀), IsFinite q₀ → Etale q₀ →
      ∀ e₀ : pullback ρ T.U₀ToU ⟶ Z₀,
        IsPullback (pullback.snd ρ T.U₀ToU) e₀ T.U₀Open.ι q₀ →
        ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (q : Z ⟶ T.X) (e : W ⟶ Z),
          IsFinite q ∧ Etale q ∧ IsPullback ρ e T.UOpen.ι q)
    (V : Scheme.{u}) (pi : V ⟶ S.U) [IsFinite pi] [Etale pi]
    (Y₀ : Scheme.{u}) (f₀ : Y₀ ⟶ S.X₀) [IsFinite f₀] [Etale f₀]
    (g₀ : pullback pi S.U₀ToU ⟶ Y₀)
    (h₀ : IsPullback (pullback.snd pi S.U₀ToU) g₀ S.U₀Open.ι f₀) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (p : Y ⟶ S.X) (g : V ⟶ Y),
      IsFinite p ∧ Etale p ∧ IsPullback pi g S.UOpen.ι p
declarations.comment: the unrestricted Stacks 0BLS is carried as a named general hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.exists_finiteEtale_lift_of_three_le_depth
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BLM]** In the local Lefschetz situation let `V` be finite étale over `U`
and assume (1) `A` has depth at least `3`, and (2) `V ×_U U₀` is `Y₀ ×_{X₀} U₀` for some
`Y₀ → X₀` finite étale. Then `V = Y ×_X U` for some `Y → X` finite étale.

The reduction to the complete case is by Tag 0BLL, as in the source's proof of Tag 0BLS
(`AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_isAdicCompleteCase`):
the completion `Â` has the same depth (Tag 07NW) and is `f`-adically complete, and the base change
of `Y₀` to `Spec (Â / fÂ)` witnesses hypothesis (2) for the base change of `V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_lift_of_three_le_depth
    (hdepth : 3 ≤ Module.depth S.A (maximalIdeal S.A) S.A)
    (V : Scheme.{u}) (pi : V ⟶ S.U) [IsFinite pi] [Etale pi]
    (Y₀ : Scheme.{u}) (f₀ : Y₀ ⟶ S.X₀) [IsFinite f₀] [Etale f₀]
    (g₀ : pullback pi S.U₀ToU ⟶ Y₀)
    (h₀ : IsPullback (pullback.snd pi S.U₀ToU) g₀ S.U₀Open.ι f₀) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (p : Y ⟶ S.X) (g : V ⟶ Y),
      IsFinite p ∧ Etale p ∧ IsPullback pi g S.UOpen.ι p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.HasLargeMissingComponents.mono
declarations.doc:
The dimension condition passes to smaller opens: a minimal prime in the smaller open lies in
the larger one.
declarations.comment: stability of the dimension hypothesis under shrinking `U'`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.faithful_finiteEtaleBaseChange_of_hasLargeMissingComponents
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLN.** In the local Lefschetz situation let `U'` be an open of `X`
with `U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U`. If every minimal prime of `A` lying in `U'` but not in `U₀` has
`dim (A / 𝔭) ≥ 2`, then base change of finite étale covers along `U₀ ⟶ U'` is faithful.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_finiteEtaleBaseChange_of_hasLargeMissingComponents
    (S : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u}) {W : S.X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ S.UOpen)
    (r : S.U₀ ⟶ W.toScheme) (hr : r ≫ W.ι = S.U₀ToU ≫ S.UOpen.ι)
    (hdim : S.HasLargeMissingComponents W) :
    (finiteEtaleBaseChange r).Faithful
declarations.comment: faithfulness of restriction from an open `U'` with `U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.exists_hasLargeMissingComponents
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLN.** In the local Lefschetz situation there is an open `U'` of `X`
with `U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U` satisfying the dimension hypothesis: remove from `U` the one-dimensional
irreducible components of `X` that do not meet `U₀`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hasLargeMissingComponents (S : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u}) :
    ∃ W : S.X.Opens, W ≤ S.UOpen ∧ S.U₀Open ≤ S.X₀ToX ⁻¹ᵁ W ∧
      S.HasLargeMissingComponents W
declarations.comment: existence of an open `U'` with `U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U` satisfying the dimension hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.exists_le_faithful_finiteEtaleBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLN.** The opens `U'` with `U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U` for which restriction of
finite étale covers to `U₀` is faithful are cofinal among all opens between `U₀` and `U`: this
is what makes restriction from `colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U} FÉt_{U'}` to `FÉt_{U₀}` faithful.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_le_faithful_finiteEtaleBaseChange (S : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u})
    {V : S.X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ S.UOpen) (hVU₀ : S.U₀Open ≤ S.X₀ToX ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    ∃ (W : S.X.Opens) (hWU₀ : S.U₀Open ≤ S.X₀ToX ⁻¹ᵁ W),
      W ≤ V ∧ (finiteEtaleBaseChange (S.homToOpen hWU₀)).Faithful
declarations.comment: cofinality of the faithful neighbourhoods of `U₀` in `U`, the criterion for faithfulness of restriction from the colimit over all such neighbourhoods

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.exists_le_finiteEtaleBaseChange_map_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLN.** Two morphisms of finite étale covers of an open `U'` with
`U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U` which agree after base change to `U₀` already agree after base change to some
smaller open `U''` with `U₀ ⊆ U'' ⊆ U'`. This is faithfulness of the restriction functor
`colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U} FÉt_{U'} ⟶ FÉt_{U₀}` written out on representatives.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_le_finiteEtaleBaseChange_map_eq (S : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u})
    {V : S.X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ S.UOpen) (hVU₀ : S.U₀Open ≤ S.X₀ToX ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    {A B : FiniteEtaleOver V.toScheme} (a b : A ⟶ B)
    (hab : (finiteEtaleBaseChange (S.homToOpen hVU₀)).map a =
      (finiteEtaleBaseChange (S.homToOpen hVU₀)).map b) :
    ∃ (W : S.X.Opens) (_ : S.U₀Open ≤ S.X₀ToX ⁻¹ᵁ W) (hWV : W ≤ V),
      (finiteEtaleBaseChange (S.X.homOfLE hWV)).map a =
        (finiteEtaleBaseChange (S.X.homOfLE hWV)).map b
declarations.comment: faithfulness of restriction from the colimit over the opens between `U₀` and `U`, written out on representatives of the filtered colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.finiteEtaleColimitFullyFaithful_puncturedSpectrum_of_isAdicComplete
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BLP].** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0BLF] — a Noetherian local ring `(A, 𝔪)`
and `f ∈ 𝔪`, with `U = Spec(A) ∖ {𝔪}` the punctured spectrum and `U₀ = U ∩ V(f)` the closed
subscheme of `U` cut out by `f 𝒪_U` — assume

1. `A` is `f`-adically complete,
2. `f` is a nonzerodivisor, and
3. `H¹_𝔪(A/fA)` is a finite `A`-module.

Then the restriction functor `colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U open} FÉt_{U'} ⟶ FÉt_{U₀}` is fully faithful.

The proof is the source's: [Stacks, Tag 0EKV]
(`Stacks.FundamentalGroup.completionFullyFaithfulComplete_puncturedSpectrum_principal`) gives full
faithfulness of the completion functor `colim_{U'} Coh(𝒪_{U'}) ⟶ Coh(U, f𝒪_U)` on finite locally
free objects, and [Stacks, Tag 0ELA]
(`Stacks.FundamentalGroup.finiteEtaleColimitFullyFaithful_of_completionFullyFaithfulComplete`)
turns that into the conclusion.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteEtaleColimitFullyFaithful_puncturedSpectrum_of_isAdicComplete
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (f : A)
    (hf : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {f}) A)
    (hnzd : f ∈ nonZeroDivisors A)
    (hfinite : Module.Finite A (localCohomologyModule A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
      (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) 1)) :
    FiniteEtaleColimitFullyFaithful
      (complementZeroLocus A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) : Scheme)
      (idealSheafNearVanishing A (Ideal.span {f}) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))
declarations.comment: the full statement, proved from the tag's three hypotheses through 0EKV and 0ELA

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleBaseChange_to_puncturedSpectrum
declarations.doc:
Restriction from the spectrum of a local ring `A` to its punctured spectrum is fully faithful
on finite étale covers, provided the punctured spectrum of a strict henselization of `A` is
connected.
declarations.statement:
theorem fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleBaseChange_to_puncturedSpectrum
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (κsep : Type u) [Field κsep]
    [Algebra (maximalIdeal A).ResidueField κsep]
    [IsSepClosure (maximalIdeal A).ResidueField κsep]
    (Ash : Type u) [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash] [Algebra A Ash]
    (hAsh : Stacks.StrictHenselization.IsStrictHenselization A κsep Ash)
    (hconnected : _root_.IsConnected ({closedPoint Ash}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum Ash))) :
    Nonempty (finiteEtaleBaseChange (puncturedSpectrum A).ι).FullyFaithful

declarations.name: Stacks.PuncturedSpectrum.isConnected_puncturedSpectrum_of_two_le_depth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLR (first assertion).** The same statement in the
complement-of-the-closed-point spelling, which is the one the source uses.

declarations.name: Stacks.PuncturedSpectrum.isConnected_puncturedSpectrum_henselization_of_two_le_depth

declarations.statement:
theorem isConnected_puncturedSpectrum_henselization_of_two_le_depth

declarations.name: Stacks.PuncturedSpectrum.isConnected_puncturedSpectrum_strictHenselization_of_two_le_depth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLR (third assertion).** The punctured spectrum of a strict
henselization of a Noetherian local ring of depth at least two is connected.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConnected_puncturedSpectrum_strictHenselization_of_two_le_depth
    (A Ash : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash] [Algebra A Ash]
    (κsep : Type v) [Field κsep] [Algebra (ResidueField A) κsep]
    [IsSepClosure (ResidueField A) κsep] [IsHenselization A κsep Ash]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.LocalLefschetzSituation.exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_localCohomology_annihilated
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BLS].** In the local Lefschetz situation let `V` be finite étale over `U` and
assume (1) `H¹_𝔪(A)` and `H²_𝔪(A)` are annihilated by a power of `f`, and (2) `V ×_U U₀` is
`Y₀ ×_{X₀} U₀` for some `Y₀ → X₀` finite étale. Then `V = Y ×_X U` for some `Y → X` finite étale.

The proof is the source's. Stacks 0BLL reduces the existence of the extension to the case of an
`f`-adically complete base, which is
`…LocalLefschetzSituation.exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_isAdicCompleteCase`, and the annihilation
hypothesis is inherited by the `𝔪`-adic completion through Stacks 0ALZ, which is
`…LocalLefschetzSituation.annihilated_completion`. In the complete case `(A, fA)` is a henselian
pair by Stacks 0ALJ (`IsAdicComplete.henselianRing` and `henselianPair_of_henselianRing`); that
henselian pair feeds Stacks 09ZS, lifting `Y₀` to a finite étale `Y → X`, and is also hypothesis
(2) of Stacks 0BM6, which supplies the full faithfulness of restriction that the descent step
needs, as `fullyFaithful_finiteEtaleRestriction_of_annihilated_of_henselian`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_localCohomology_annihilated
    (S : LocalLefschetzSituation.{u})
    (h1 : ∃ n, ∀ x : localCohomologyModule S.A (maximalIdeal S.A)
      (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (maximalIdeal S.A)) (ModuleCat.of S.A S.A) 1,
      S.f ^ n • x = 0)
    (h2 : ∃ n, ∀ x : localCohomologyModule S.A (maximalIdeal S.A)
      (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing (maximalIdeal S.A)) (ModuleCat.of S.A S.A) 2,
      S.f ^ n • x = 0)
    (V : Scheme.{u}) (pi : V ⟶ S.U) [IsFinite pi] [Etale pi]
    (Y₀ : Scheme.{u}) (f₀ : Y₀ ⟶ S.X₀) [IsFinite f₀] [Etale f₀]
    (g₀ : pullback pi S.U₀ToU ⟶ Y₀)
    (h₀ : IsPullback (pullback.snd pi S.U₀ToU) g₀ S.U₀Open.ι f₀) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (p : Y ⟶ S.X) (g : V ⟶ Y),
      IsFinite p ∧ Etale p ∧ IsPullback pi g S.UOpen.ι p
declarations.comment: Hⁱ_𝔪(A) is local cohomology in the coreflection model of Stacks 0A6Q; V₀ = Y₀ ×_{X₀} U₀ and V = Y ×_X U are recorded as cartesian squares

declarations.name: Stacks.LocalCohomologySequence.isCoherent_rightDerived_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BLT].** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian scheme, let `j : U → X` be the
inclusion of an open subscheme and let `n ≥ 0`.  If `R^p j_* 𝒪_U` is coherent for `0 ≤ p < n`,
then so is `R^p j_* ℱ` for `0 ≤ p < n` and every finite locally free `𝒪_U`-module `ℱ`.

The inclusion is taken to be an arbitrary open immersion `j`, which is the same statement: an
open immersion is the inclusion of its open image composed with an isomorphism.

The question is local on `X`: coherence of a higher direct image along the quasi-compact
quasi-separated `j` may be checked on every affine open `V` of `X`, for the restricted morphism
`j ∣_ V` and the restricted module, by
`…ProperCohomologyFinite.isCoherent_rightDerivedPlus_of_forall_isAffineOpen`.  That case is
`isCoherent_rightDerived_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_affine`, `V.toScheme` being affine and locally
Noetherian; its hypothesis on the structure sheaf is the tag's hypothesis restricted to `V` by
[Stacks, Tag 01E5], and its finite local freeness is the restriction of `ℱ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCoherent_rightDerived_of_isFiniteLocallyFree {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (n : ℕ)
    (hO : ∀ p : ℕ, p < n →
      (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).rightDerived p).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit U.ringCatSheaf)).IsCoherent)
    (F : U.Modules) (hF : Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFree F) :
    ∀ p : ℕ, p < n →
      (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).rightDerived p).obj F).IsCoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.FundamentalGroup.finiteEtaleColimitEquivalence_puncturedSpectrum_of_isAdicComplete
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BLV].** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0BLF] — `(A, 𝔪)` a Noetherian local ring,
`f ∈ 𝔪`, `U = Spec(A) ∖ {𝔪}` the punctured spectrum of `A` and `U₀ = U ∩ V(f)` the punctured
spectrum of `A/fA` — assume

1. `A` is `f`-adically complete,
2. `f` is a nonzerodivisor, and
3. `H¹_𝔪(A/fA)` and `H²_𝔪(A/fA)` are finite `A`-modules.

Then the restriction functor `colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U} FÉt_{U'} ⟶ FÉt_{U₀}` is an equivalence.

The colimit is directed, so the functor is an equivalence exactly when the two conjuncts below
hold. The first is that it is fully faithful, in the form
`Stacks.FundamentalGroup.FiniteEtaleColimitFullyFaithful`: morphisms between restrictions to
`U₀` come from a smaller neighbourhood, and morphisms agreeing on `U₀` agree on a smaller
neighbourhood. The second is that it is essentially surjective: every finite étale cover of `U₀`
is the restriction of a finite étale cover of some open `U'` with `U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteEtaleColimitEquivalence_puncturedSpectrum_of_isAdicComplete
    (hf : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hcomplete : IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span {f}) A) (hnzd : f ∈ nonZeroDivisors A)
    (hH1 : Module.Finite A (localCohomologyModule A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
      (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) 1))
    (hH2 : Module.Finite A (localCohomologyModule A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
      (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) 2)) :
    FiniteEtaleColimitFullyFaithful (complementZeroLocus A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) : Scheme)
        (idealSheafNearVanishing A (Ideal.span {f}) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)) ∧
      ∀ C : FiniteEtaleOver
        (idealSheafNearVanishing A (Ideal.span {f}) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)).subscheme,
      ∃ (W : Neighborhood (complementZeroLocus A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) : Scheme)
          (idealSheafNearVanishing A (Ideal.span {f}) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)))
        (V : FiniteEtaleOver (Neighborhood.open _ _ W).toScheme),
        Nonempty ((finiteEtaleBaseChange (Neighborhood.toSchemeHom _ _ W)).obj V ≅ C)
declarations.comment: (A, 𝔪) Noetherian local, f ∈ 𝔪, U the punctured spectrum of A, U₀ = U ∩ V(f); if A is f-adically complete, f is a nonzerodivisor and H¹_𝔪(A/fA), H²_𝔪(A/fA) are finite A-modules, then restriction colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U open} FÉt_{U'} → FÉt_{U₀} is an equivalence: it is fully faithful on the directed colimit, and every finite étale cover of U₀ is the restriction of a finite étale cover of some open U' with U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleColimitEquivalence_puncturedSpectrum_of_propertySk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLW.**  Let `(A, 𝔪)` be a complete local Noetherian ring and let
`f ∈ 𝔪` be nonzero.  Assume `A_f` satisfies Serre's condition `(S₂)` and every irreducible
component of `Spec A` has dimension at least `4`.  Then the restriction functor

```
colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U open} FÉt_{U'} ⟶ FÉt_{U₀}
```

is an equivalence, where `U = Spec A ∖ {𝔪}` and `U₀ = U ∩ V(f)`.

This is Stacks 0DXY under its hypothesis (2)(a).  Its hypothesis (1) is available: a complete
local Noetherian ring has a dualizing complex by Stacks 0BFR, and it is `f`-adically complete
because `f A` is contained in the maximal ideal, with respect to which it is complete.  The
dimension bound of (2)(a) is on the components of `Spec A` not contained in `V(f)`, so the bound
on all of them is more than enough.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteEtaleColimitEquivalence_puncturedSpectrum_of_propertySk
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal A) A]
    (hf : f ∈ maximalIdeal A) (_hfne : f ≠ 0)
    (hS2 : PropertySkRing (Localization.Away f) 2)
    (hdim : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, IsMinimalPrime p.asIdeal →
      (4 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p.asIdeal)) :
    FiniteEtaleColimitFullyFaithful (complementZeroLocus A (maximalIdeal A) : Scheme)
        (idealSheafNearVanishing A (Ideal.span {f}) (maximalIdeal A)) ∧
      ∀ C : FiniteEtaleOver
        (idealSheafNearVanishing A (Ideal.span {f}) (maximalIdeal A)).subscheme,
      ∃ (W : Neighborhood (complementZeroLocus A (maximalIdeal A) : Scheme)
          (idealSheafNearVanishing A (Ideal.span {f}) (maximalIdeal A)))
        (V : FiniteEtaleOver (Neighborhood.open _ _ W).toScheme),
        Nonempty ((finiteEtaleBaseChange (Neighborhood.toSchemeHom _ _ W)).obj V ≅ C)
declarations.comment: the equivalence of the remark, from the tag's own hypotheses: `A` complete local Noetherian, `f ∈ 𝔪` nonzero, `A_f` satisfying `(S₂)`, and every irreducible component of `Spec A` of dimension at least 4; nothing beyond them is assumed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleColimitEquivalence_puncturedSpectrum_of_isIntegrallyClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BLW, the example at the end of the remark.**  The hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleColimitEquivalence_puncturedSpectrum_of_propertySk` hold when `A`
is a complete local normal domain of dimension at least `4` and `f ∈ 𝔪` is nonzero, so the
restriction functor `colim_{U₀ ⊆ U' ⊆ U} FÉt_{U'} ⟶ FÉt_{U₀}` is an equivalence in that case.

A localization of a normal domain at a set of nonzero elements is again a normal domain, so `A_f`
and each of its local rings is an integrally closed domain; Serre's criterion then gives `(S₂)`
for `A_f`.  The only minimal prime of a domain is `(0)`, and `A / (0) = A` has dimension at
least `4`, which is the dimension bound on the irreducible components of `Spec A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteEtaleColimitEquivalence_puncturedSpectrum_of_isIntegrallyClosed
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal A) A]
    [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    (hdim : (4 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim A) (hf : f ∈ maximalIdeal A) (hfne : f ≠ 0) :
    FiniteEtaleColimitFullyFaithful (complementZeroLocus A (maximalIdeal A) : Scheme)
        (idealSheafNearVanishing A (Ideal.span {f}) (maximalIdeal A)) ∧
      ∀ C : FiniteEtaleOver
        (idealSheafNearVanishing A (Ideal.span {f}) (maximalIdeal A)).subscheme,
      ∃ (W : Neighborhood (complementZeroLocus A (maximalIdeal A) : Scheme)
          (idealSheafNearVanishing A (Ideal.span {f}) (maximalIdeal A)))
        (V : FiniteEtaleOver (Neighborhood.open _ _ W).toScheme),
        Nonempty ((finiteEtaleBaseChange (Neighborhood.toSchemeHom _ _ W)).obj V ≅ C)
declarations.comment: the example at the end of the remark: a complete local normal domain of dimension at least 4, with `f ∈ 𝔪` nonzero, satisfies the remark's hypotheses, so the equivalence holds for it; normality is `IsDomain` together with `IsIntegrallyClosed` and nothing beyond the remark's own hypotheses is assumed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.exists_iso_and_pages_derivedCompletion_globalSections
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0BLX].** Let `A` be a ring, `I ⊂ A` a finitely generated ideal, `𝒞` a site,
`𝒪` a sheaf of `A`-algebras — a ring map `ρ : A ⟶ Γ(𝒞, 𝒪)` — `𝓘 = I𝒪` the ideal sheaf `I`
generates and `ℱ` a sheaf of `𝒪`-modules. Write `ℱ^∧` for the derived completion of `ℱ` along
`I𝒪` and `(-)^∧` for the derived completion along `I` on `D(A)`. Then

1. `RΓ(𝒞, ℱ)^∧ = RΓ(𝒞, ℱ^∧)` in `D(A)`;
2. there is a bounded cohomological spectral sequence with
   `E₂^{i,j} = H^i(H^j(𝒞, ℱ)^∧)` converging to `H^{i+j}(RΓ(𝒞, ℱ)^∧)`, every term of which is a
   derived complete `A`-module;
3. `ℱ^∧` has a bounded below representative, and the second spectral sequence of
   [Stacks, Tag 015J] for `Γ(𝒞, -)` at it has `E₂^{p,q} = H^p(𝒞, H^q(ℱ^∧))` and abuts to
   `H^{p+q}(RΓ(𝒞, ℱ^∧))`.

By (1) the two abutments are the cohomology of the two sides of one object of `D(A)`, which is
the source's `H^*(RΓ(𝒞, ℱ)^∧) = H^*(𝒞, ℱ^∧)`: all three parts are read with one and the same
derived global sections functor
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.derivedGlobalSectionsOverUnbounded` on the unbounded `D(𝒪)`.

Both derived completion functors are conclusions rather than hypotheses. On the sheaf side the
reflector of [Stacks, Tag 099F] onto the objects of `D(𝒪)` derived complete along `I𝒪` is
produced from the generators of `I` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.isRightAdjoint_ι_isDerivedComplete_generatedIdealSheaf`; on the
module side the reflector of [Stacks, Tag 0920] onto the objects of `D(A)` derived complete along
`I` comes with the package of [Stacks, Tag 0BKE]. Each is existentially quantified, together with
its adjunction, because the library fixes no choice of either.

The hypotheses are the source's: `I` finitely generated, and `𝓘 = I𝒪`, which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.IsIdealSheafGeneratedBy` and determines `𝓘` uniquely. No
nilpotence, boundedness or finiteness enters: `I` being finitely generated, `I = (a_1, …, a_r)`
and `I𝒪` **is** the ideal sheaf generated by the global sections `ρ a_1, …, ρ a_r` of `𝒪`, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.exists_eq_generatedIdealSheaf_of_isIdealSheafGeneratedBy`, so the
statement is proved at the source's own `I𝒪`.

The three parts come from
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.nonempty_iso_derivedCompletion_derivedGlobalSections`,
`AdicFilteredCompletion.exists_spectralSequence_derivedCompletion_homology` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.exists_pages_derivedCompletion_globalSections`; the module
documentation says how they are matched up, the two reflections of `D(A)` being identified by
`CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isoOfReflection` and the two derived global sections functors by
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.nonempty_iso_derivedGlobalSectionsOverUnbounded_of_plus`.

The Cartan-Eilenberg resolution of part (3) is universally quantified, as it is in
[Stacks, Tag 015J] itself, and its existence is [Stacks, Tag 015I].
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_and_pages_derivedCompletion_globalSections
    (hI : I.FG) (h𝓘 : IsIdealSheafGeneratedBy A I X ρ 𝓘) :
    let Pm : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      fun L ↦ _root_.IsDerivedComplete I L
    let Ps : ObjectProperty
        (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))) :=
      IsDerivedComplete.{u, u, u, u} X 𝓘
    let RG := derivedGlobalSectionsOverUnbounded X A ρ
    let F0 := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) 0).obj F
    ∃ (completionSheaf :
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) ⥤
          Ps.FullSubcategory)
      (completion : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ Pm.FullSubcategory)
      (M : CochainComplex.Filtered (ModuleCat.{u} A))
      (E : E₂CohomologicalSpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{u} A))
      (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, Antitone (M.inducedFiltrationStep n))
      (Kc : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) ℤ)
      (_ : CochainComplex.plus
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) Kc),
      Nonempty (completionSheaf ⊣ Ps.ι) ∧
      Nonempty (completion ⊣ Pm.ι) ∧
      Nonempty ((completion ⋙ Pm.ι).obj (RG.obj F0) ≅
        RG.obj ((completionSheaf ⋙ Ps.ι).obj F0)) ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M.X ≅ (completion ⋙ Pm.ι).obj (RG.obj F0)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty (M.X.homology n ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj
          ((completion ⋙ Pm.ι).obj (RG.obj F0)))) ∧
      (∀ i j : ℤ, Nonempty ((E.page 2).X (i, j) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
          ((completion ⋙ Pm.ι).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
              ((siteCohomologyOver X A ρ j).obj F))))) ∧
      (∀ (r i j : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r), IsDerivedCompleteModule I ((E.page r hr).X (i, j))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, {i : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 2).X (i, n - i))}.Finite) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ p q : ℤ, p ≤ q ∧ M.inducedFiltrationStep n p = ⊤ ∧
        M.inducedFiltrationStep n q = ⊥) ∧
      (∀ i j : ℤ, ∃ (r₀ : ℤ) (hr₀ : 2 ≤ r₀), ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r),
        (E.page r (by omega)).d (i, j) (i + r, j - r + 1) = 0 ∧
        (E.page r (by omega)).d (i - r, j + r - 1) (i, j) = 0 ∧
        Nonempty ((E.page r (by omega)).X (i, j) ≅
          cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (M.inducedFiltrationStep (i + j) (-j + 1))
            (M.inducedFiltrationStep (i + j) (-j)) (hF (i + j) (by omega))))) ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Kc ≅ (completionSheaf ⋙ Ps.ι).obj F0) ∧
      ∀ (Ires : Kc.CartanEilenbergResolution)
        [HomologicalComplex₂.HasTotal
          ((((moduleGlobalSectionsOver X A ρ).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Ires.bicomplex)
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)],
        (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty
          ((((((moduleGlobalSectionsOver X A ρ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Ires.bicomplex).homology q).homology p ≅
            (siteCohomologyOver X A ρ p).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                  (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) q).obj
                ((completionSheaf ⋙ Ps.ι).obj F0)))) ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty ((HomologicalComplex₂.total
            ((((moduleGlobalSectionsOver X A ρ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Ires.bicomplex) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homology n ≅
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj
            (RG.obj ((completionSheaf ⋙ Ps.ι).obj F0)))
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, at the source's own hypotheses — `A` a ring, `I ⊂ A` a finitely generated ideal, `𝒞` a site, `𝒪` a sheaf of `A`-algebras, `ℱ` a sheaf of `𝒪`-modules and `I𝒪` the ideal sheaf `I` generates: the identity `RΓ(𝒞,ℱ)^∧ = RΓ(𝒞,ℱ^∧)` in `D(A)` together with both spectral sequences, `E₂^{i,j} = H^i(H^j(𝒞,ℱ)^∧)` and `E₂^{p,q} = H^p(𝒞, H^q(ℱ^∧))`, converging to `H^*(RΓ(𝒞,ℱ)^∧) = H^*(𝒞,ℱ^∧)`. The derived completion along `I𝒪` ([Stacks, Tag 099F]) and the derived completion along `I` ([Stacks, Tag 0920]) are both produced, each with its reflector adjunction, and a bounded below representative of `ℱ^∧` is produced as well

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtaleCovers
declarations.doc:
The category `FÉt` of Stacks 0BLY over a big fppf site: an object is a finite étale
morphism `U ⟶ T` of the big fppf category over `S`, and a morphism is a commutative square.
declarations.statement: abbrev FiniteEtaleCovers : Type _
declarations.comment:
the category FÉt of the section: objects are the finite étale morphisms of the
  big fppf category over S, morphisms are the commutative squares

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleProjection
declarations.doc:
The functor `p : FÉt ⟶ (Sch/S)_fppf` of Stacks 0BLY, sending a finite étale morphism
`U ⟶ T` to its base `T`.
declarations.statement: def finiteEtaleProjection : FiniteEtaleCovers B S hS ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS
declarations.comment: the functor p of the section, sending a finite étale cover to its base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleProjection_isFibered
declarations.doc:
**Condition (1) of Stacks 026F for `FÉt`.** The functor `p : FÉt ⟶ (Sch/S)_fppf` is a
fibred category: the strongly cartesian lift of a morphism `f : T ⟶ T'` with target the finite
étale cover `U ⟶ T'` is the base change `U ×_{T'} T ⟶ T`, again finite étale.
declarations.statement:
instance finiteEtaleProjection_isFibered :
    (finiteEtaleProjection B S hS).IsFibered
declarations.comment:
condition (1) of Stacks 026F: `p` is a fibred category. Condition (2), that the
  presheaves Mor(x, y) are fppf sheaves, is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleProjection_isMorSheaf`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleProjection_isStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0BLZ.** The functor `p : FÉt ⟶ (Sch/S)_fppf` of Stacks 0BLY defines a stack over
the big fppf site of `S`: it satisfies the three conditions of Stacks 026F.

Condition (1) is `AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleProjection_isFibered`, condition (2) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleProjection_isMorSheaf` and condition (3) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleProjection_hasEffectiveDescent`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteEtaleProjection_isStack :
    Functor.IsStack (finiteEtaleProjection B S hS) (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleProjection_isMorSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Condition (2) of Stacks 026F for `FÉt`.** The presheaves `Mor(x, y)` of Stacks 02ZB
attached to two finite étale covers of one and the same base are sheaves for the fppf
topology: locally equal morphisms of `FÉt` are equal, and morphisms of `FÉt` given
compatibly over a covering sieve of the base glue.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteEtaleProjection_isMorSheaf (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (x y : (finiteEtaleProjection B S hS).Fiber U) :
    Functor.IsMorSheaf (finiteEtaleProjection B S hS) (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) U x y
declarations.comment:
condition (2) of Stacks 026F: the presheaves Mor(x, y) are fppf sheaves, so
  locally equal morphisms of `FÉt` are equal and morphisms given compatibly over a covering
  sieve glue. Condition (1) is `AlgebraicGeometry.finiteEtaleProjection_isFibered`.
